title: Robust Standard Errors for Bayesian Posterior Functionals via the Infinitesimal Jackknife
authors: Nanyu Luo, Feng Ji
abstract: Quantitative research in the social and behavioral sciences relies heavily on nonlinear posterior functionals such as indirect effects, standardized coefficients, effect sizes, intraclass correlations, and multilevel variance-explained measures. The posterior standard deviation (PostSD) is the default uncertainty summary for these quantities, yet it presupposes a correctly specified model. When the working model is wrong, as is common with behavioral data that exhibit heavy tails and heteroskedasticity, PostSD can severely underestimate the frequentist standard error. The nonparametric bootstrap offers robustness but requires repeated MCMC refits, while the delta method demands a separate analytic gradient derivation for every new functional. The infinitesimal jackknife standard error (Giordano & Broderick, 2023) sidesteps both limitations: it approximates the bootstrap variance through influence functions computed from a single MCMC run, applies to any posterior functional without modification, and requires no analytic derivatives. We discuss the use the IJSE methodology at both the observation level and the cluster level and evaluate it through four simulation studies covering six functionals from mediation analysis, ANOVA, and multilevel modeling, which are commonly used in the social and behavioral sciences. Under misspecification, PostSD substantially underestimated the true standard error across all settings, whereas IJSE closely tracked the bootstrap at a fraction of the computational cost. Under correct specification all three methods agreed, confirming that IJSE introduces no distortion when the model is right. These results show IJSE as a practical, general-purpose tool for robust uncertainty quantification in Bayesian workflows throughout the social and behavioral sciences
zh_title: 基于无穷小刀切法的贝叶斯后验函数稳健标准误估计
translation: 社会科学与行为科学中的定量研究严重依赖于非线性后验函数，如间接效应、标准化系数、效应量、组内相关系数和多层方差解释度量。后验标准差（PostSD）是这些量的默认不确定性总结，但它预设了模型设定是正确的。当工作模型错误时（这在具有重尾和异方差的行为数据中很常见），PostSD可能会严重低估频率论标准误。非参数自助法提供了稳健性，但需要重复进行MCMC拟合，而Delta法则要求为每个新函数单独推导解析梯度。无穷小刀切法（Giordano & Broderick, 2023）规避了这两个限制：它通过从单次MCMC运行计算的影响函数来近似自助法方差，适用于任何后验函数且无需解析导数。我们讨论了在观测值级别和聚类级别使用IJSE方法，并通过涵盖中介分析、方差分析和多层建模中常用的六个函数的四项模拟研究对其进行了评估。在模型设定错误的情况下，PostSD在所有设置中都大幅低估了真实标准误，而IJSE以极小的计算成本紧密跟踪了自助法的结果。在模型设定正确的情况下，所有三种方法结果一致，证实了IJSE在模型正确时不会引入偏差。这些结果表明，IJSE是社会科学和行为科学中贝叶斯工作流进行稳健不确定性量化的实用、通用工具。
tldr: 提出了一种利用无穷小刀切法（IJSE）计算贝叶斯后验函数稳健标准误的方法，该方法无需解析求导，计算高效，且在模型设定错误时表现优于传统后验标准差。
ai_comments: 该研究引入的无穷小刀切法（IJSE）巧妙地解决了贝叶斯分析在模型设定错误时标准差估计不准的问题，且在计算效率上远优于非参数自助法，具有极高的实用价值。其创新点在于将复杂的统计推断转化为基于影响函数的计算，无需针对每个函数进行求导，是贝叶斯工作流中稳健性评估的重要工具。
motivation: 在社会科学研究中，当贝叶斯模型设定错误时，传统的后验标准差（PostSD）往往会严重低估频率论标准误，而自助法计算成本过高，Delta法则则需要繁琐的解析求导。
method: 采用无穷小刀切法（IJSE），利用单次MCMC运行中计算的影响函数来近似自助法方差，无需解析梯度，并扩展至观测值级别和聚类级别。
results: 模拟研究表明，在模型设定错误时，IJSE比PostSD能更准确地追踪自助法标准误；在模型设定正确时，IJSE与自助法和PostSD结果一致，且计算成本显著低于自助法。
conclusion: 无穷小刀切法（IJSE）是贝叶斯分析中一种稳健、通用且计算高效的标准误估计方法，特别是在模型可能存在设定错误的情况下，其性能优于传统的后验标准差（PostSD）。

title: Two-Sample Testing for Multivariate Cross-Correlation Functions with Applications to Gut-Brain Reward Learning
authors: Bhaskar Ray, Tùng Bùi, William Matthew Howe, Srijan Sengupta
abstract: Cross-correlation functions (CCFs) are classical tools for studying lead-lag relationships between paired time series, but they are most often used descriptively rather than inferentially. Motivated by mouse experiments on gut-brain interactions in reward learning, we carry out a two-sample hypothesis test for formal statistical inference on collections of subject-specific CCF curves. In our application, each experimental session yields two related CCFs describing the temporal association of dopamine activity with locomotor velocity and acceleration, which leads naturally to a multivariate functional data formulation. We treat each empirical CCF as a functional observation indexed by lag and test equality of mean multivariate CCF functions across groups using integrated and maximum-type global statistics, \(F_{\mathrm{int}}\) and \(F_{\max}\), constructed from pointwise Hotelling \(T^2\) statistics. The integrated test targets broad differences across the lag domain, whereas the maximum test is sensitive to local differences. Applied to free-feeding and intragastric infusion datasets, the proposed methods detect substantial differences in dopamine-locomotion coupling across brain region and biological sex in the free-feeding experiment, with more selective effects in the infusion setting. The proposed framework provides a flexible and rigorous FDA-based approach for comparing dynamic dependence structures across experimental conditions.
zh_title: 用于多变量互相关函数的两样本检验及其在肠-脑奖励学习中的应用
translation: 互相关函数（CCF）是研究成对时间序列间超前-滞后关系的经典工具，但它们通常用于描述而非推断。受肠-脑交互在奖励学习中作用的小鼠实验启发，我们对受试者特定的CCF曲线集合进行了两样本假设检验，以进行正式的统计推断。在我们的应用中，每个实验阶段产生两个相关的CCF，描述了多巴胺活动与运动速度和加速度之间的时间关联，这自然导致了多变量函数型数据的表述。我们将每个经验CCF视为由滞后索引的函数型观测，并使用由逐点Hotelling T^2统计量构建的集成型和最大型全局统计量（F_int和F_max）来测试各组间均值多变量CCF函数的相等性。集成测试针对滞后域上的广泛差异，而最大测试对局部差异敏感。应用于自由摄食和胃内输注数据集，所提出的方法在自由摄食实验中检测到了不同脑区和生物性别在多巴胺-运动耦合方面的显著差异，并在输注设置中表现出更具选择性的效应。所提出的框架为比较不同实验条件下的动态依赖结构提供了一种灵活且严谨的基于FDA的方法。
tldr: 提出了一种基于函数型数据分析的统计检验方法，用于比较不同实验组间多变量互相关函数（CCF）的差异，并揭示了肠-脑交互中的动态耦合特征。
ai_comments: 该论文将传统的互相关函数（CCF）分析方法与函数型数据分析（FDA）框架相结合，为研究时间序列间的动态依赖关系提供了严谨的统计推断工具。其创新点在于将多变量CCF视为函数型数据，并利用Hotelling T^2统计量构建了全局测试，特别适用于神经科学中复杂的因果关联研究。
motivation: 现有的互相关函数（CCF）多用于描述性分析而非推断，作者旨在为肠-脑奖励学习实验中获取的受试者特定CCF曲线集合开发一种正式的统计推断方法。
method: 将经验CCF视为索引为滞后的函数型观测，利用逐点Hotelling T^2统计量构建了用于测试组间均值多变量CCF函数是否相等的集成型（F_int）和最大型（F_max）全局统计量。
results: 在自由摄食和胃内输注实验中，该方法有效检测到了不同脑区和性别在多巴胺-运动耦合方面的显著差异，并在输注环境下表现出更具选择性的效应。
conclusion: 本文提出的基于FDA的统计框架为比较不同实验条件下的动态依赖结构提供了灵活且严谨的工具，成功揭示了肠-脑交互中多巴胺活动与运动行为耦合的显著差异。

title: Spherically Embedded Time Series with Unknown Trend and Periodic Components
authors: Jiazhen Xu, Han Lin Shang
abstract: Spherically embedded time series are time series with values naturally residing on or can be equivalently mapped to the sphere. Despite their ubiquity in diverse scientific fields, these data frequently exhibit complex non-stationarity driven by latent trend and periodic components. Traditional Euclidean time series methods fail to account for the intrinsic non-Euclidean geometry of the sphere, leaving a critical gap in rigorous methodologies for modelling and forecasting nonstationary spherically embedded time series. To address this methodological gap, we propose a unified geometric framework to analyse nonstationary spherically embedded time series. Central to our approach is a novel nonparametric spherical trend-periodicity decomposition model that uses an optimal-transport-based removal operation to sequentially extract the smooth trend and periodic components while preserving spherical topology. The resulting de-trended and de-seasonalised stationary residuals can be further modelled using a spherical autoregressive model, formalising a novel trend-periodic spherical autoregressive model. Theoretical foundations for the modelling procedure are established on the consistency under temporal dependence. Extensive simulations corroborate these theoretical guarantees and demonstrate the superior finite-sample predictive performance of the trend-periodic spherical autoregressive model. Finally, we validate the practical utility of our methodology through applications to electricity generation compositions and bike trip volume profiles, yielding significantly enhanced forecasting accuracy while providing interpretable insights into the underlying structural dynamics.
zh_title: 具有未知趋势和周期分量的球面嵌入时间序列分析
translation: 球面嵌入时间序列是指其值自然存在于球面上或可等价映射到球面上的时间序列。尽管这类数据在多个科学领域中普遍存在，但它们经常表现出由潜在趋势和周期分量驱动的复杂非平稳性。传统的欧几里得时间序列方法无法解释球面的内在非欧几里得几何特性，这使得在对非平稳球面嵌入时间序列进行建模和预测方面存在严重的方法论空白。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种统一的几何框架来分析非平稳球面嵌入时间序列。我们方法的核心是一个新颖的非参数球面趋势-周期分解模型，该模型使用基于最优传输的去除操作来顺序提取平滑的趋势和周期分量，同时保持球面拓扑结构。由此得到的去趋势和去季节化的平稳残差可以使用球面自回归模型进行进一步建模，从而形成了一个新颖的趋势-周期球面自回归模型。该建模过程的理论基础建立在时间相关性下的相合性之上。广泛的模拟实验证实了这些理论保证，并证明了趋势-周期球面自回归模型在有限样本下的卓越预测性能。最后，我们通过在电力生产构成和自行车出行量分布中的应用验证了该方法的实际效用，在提供潜在结构动力学可解释性的同时，显著提高了预测准确性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对球面嵌入时间序列的新型几何分析框架，通过最优传输分解趋势与周期性，并结合球面自回归模型提升了非平稳数据的预测精度。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将最优传输理论引入球面时间序列分析，解决了传统欧几里得方法在处理非平稳球面数据时的几何不匹配问题。其贡献在于构建了一个完整的统计框架，既保证了球面拓扑结构的完整性，又实现了对趋势和周期性的有效分解。局限性在于该方法计算复杂度可能较高，且对于极高维或大规模球面数据的扩展性有待进一步验证。
motivation: 现有的时间序列分析方法多基于欧几里得空间，无法处理球面数据固有的非欧几里得几何特性，导致在处理具有复杂非平稳趋势和周期性的球面时间序列时存在方法论空白。
method: 提出了一种基于最优传输的非参数球面趋势-周期分解模型，通过顺序提取平滑趋势和周期性成分，随后使用球面自回归模型对去趋势和去季节后的残差进行建模。
results: 理论上证明了该模型的相合性，模拟实验验证了其理论保证，且在电力生产构成和自行车出行分布的实际应用中，显著提高了预测精度并提供了更好的可解释性。
conclusion: 该论文提出的趋势-周期球面自回归模型，为分析具有复杂非平稳性的球面时间序列提供了一种严谨且高效的几何框架，在理论和应用层面均表现优异。

title: Confidence Intervals for Rate Estimation with Importance Sampling in Autonomous Vehicle Evaluation
authors: Aiyou Chen, Ruixuan Rachel Zhou, Joseph J. Lee, Nicholas Chamandy, Henning Hohnhold
abstract: Accounting for both rare events and complex sampling presents challenges when quantifying uncertainty for rate estimation in autonomous vehicle performance evaluation. In this paper, we introduce a statistical formulation of this problem and develop a unified compound Poisson model framework for unbiased rate estimation through the Horvitz Thompson estimator. Though asymptotic theory for the model is available, the inference of confidence intervals (CIs) in the presence of rare events requires new investigation. We also advocate for a new monotonicity criterion for rate CIs--summing the rates of disjoint types of events should produce not only a higher point estimate but also higher confidence bounds than for the individual rates--that facilitates interpretability in real applications. We propose a novel exponential bootstrap (EB) method for CI construction based on a fiducial argument; it satisfies the monotonicity property, while novel extensions of some existing methods do not. Comprehensive numerical studies show that EB performs well for a wide range of settings relevant to our applications. Fast implementation of EB based on saddlepoint approximation is also developed, which may be of independent interest.
comment: 27 pages, 9 figures, Accepted by the Annals of Applied Statistics
zh_title: 自动驾驶评估中重要性采样速率估计的置信区间研究
translation: 在自动驾驶性能评估中，同时处理稀有事件和复杂采样对于速率估计的不确定性量化构成了挑战。在本文中，我们引入了该问题的统计公式，并开发了一个统一的复合泊松模型框架，通过Horvitz Thompson估计量实现无偏速率估计。尽管该模型的渐近理论已存在，但在稀有事件存在的情况下，置信区间（CIs）的推断需要新的研究。我们还提倡一种新的速率置信区间单调性准则——即不相交事件类型的速率之和不仅应产生更高的点估计，还应产生比单个速率更高的置信界限——这有助于在实际应用中的可解释性。我们提出了一种基于置信论证的构建置信区间的指数自助法（EB）；它满足单调性属性，而现有方法的一些新扩展则不满足。综合数值研究表明，EB在与我们应用相关的广泛设置中表现良好。我们还开发了基于鞍点近似的EB快速实现方法，这可能具有独立的研究意义。
tldr: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶评估的指数自助法（EB），能有效处理稀有事件的速率估计，并构建满足单调性准则的高效置信区间。
ai_comments: 该论文针对自动驾驶评估中的稀有事件估计问题，提出了一种创新的指数自助法（EB），不仅解决了置信区间构建的统计挑战，还提出了单调性标准以增强结果的可解释性，具有很高的工程应用价值。
motivation: 自动驾驶评估中存在稀有事件和复杂采样问题，导致速率估计的置信区间推断面临挑战，且现有方法在单调性等可解释性需求上表现不足。
method: 构建复合泊松模型框架，利用Horvitz Thompson估计量进行无偏速率估计，并提出基于置信论证的指数自助法（EB）构建置信区间，同时采用鞍点近似实现快速计算。
results: 数值模拟研究表明，提出的EB方法在多种应用场景下表现稳健，且满足所提出的速率置信区间单调性准则。
conclusion: 提出了一种基于指数自助法（EB）的新型置信区间构建方法，该方法满足单调性准则，且通过鞍点近似实现了高效计算，优于现有方法。

title: Asset allocation using a Markov process of clustered efficient frontier coefficients states
authors: Nolan Alexander, William Scherer, Jamey Thompson
abstract: We propose a novel asset allocation model using a Markov process of states defined by clustered efficient frontier coefficients. While most research in Markov models of the market characterize regimes using return and volatility, we instead propose characterizing these states using efficient frontiers, which provide more information on the interactions of underlying assets that comprise the market. Efficient frontiers can be decomposed to their functional form, a square-root second-order polynomial defined by three coefficients, to provide a dimensionality reduction of the return vector and covariance matrix. Each month, the proposed model hierarchically clusters the monthly coefficients data up to the current month, to characterize the market states, then defines a Markov process on the sequence of states. To incorporate these states into portfolio optimization, for each state, we calculate the tangency portfolio using only return data in that state. We then take the expectation of these weights for each state, weighted by the probability of transitioning from the current state to each state. To empirically validate our proposed model, we employ three sets of assets that span the market, and show that our proposed model significantly outperforms benchmark portfolios.
zh_title: 基于有效前沿系数聚类状态马尔可夫过程的资产配置
translation: 我们提出了一种新颖的资产配置模型，该模型使用由聚类后的有效前沿系数定义的状态马尔可夫过程。虽然大多数关于市场马尔可夫模型的研究使用收益率和波动率来刻画机制，但我们转而提出使用有效前沿来刻画这些状态，因为有效前沿提供了构成市场的底层资产间相互作用的更多信息。有效前沿可以分解为其函数形式，即由三个系数定义的平方根二阶多项式，从而实现收益向量和协方差矩阵的降维。每个月，所提模型对截至当月的月度系数数据进行分层聚类以刻画市场状态，然后在状态序列上定义马尔可夫过程。为了将这些状态纳入投资组合优化，我们仅使用该状态下的收益数据计算切点投资组合。然后，我们根据从当前状态转换到各状态的概率，计算这些状态权重的期望值。为了实证验证所提模型，我们采用了三组跨市场的资产，结果表明所提模型显著优于基准投资组合。
tldr: 提出了一种利用有效前沿系数聚类来定义市场状态的马尔可夫资产配置模型，实证结果表明该方法优于传统基准。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于利用有效前沿系数替代传统的收益率和波动率来定义市场状态。这种方法通过降维提取了资产间相互作用的深层信息，为资产配置模型提供了一种新颖的视角。潜在局限在于聚类算法的稳定性及计算复杂性对大规模资产组合的影响。
motivation: 传统的马尔可夫市场模型多依赖于收益率和波动率，忽略了资产间更复杂的相互作用，因此作者提出利用包含更多市场信息的有效前沿系数来刻画市场状态。
method: 首先将有效前沿分解为三个系数以实现降维；接着对这些系数进行分层聚类以识别市场状态；然后构建基于状态转换的马尔可夫过程；最后结合状态转移概率计算各状态下的切点投资组合权重。
results: 在三组跨市场资产的实证检验中，该模型表现显著优于基准投资组合。
conclusion: 基于有效前沿系数的马尔可夫资产配置模型在实证中表现优于基准组合，证明了该方法捕捉市场状态转换的有效性。

title: Learning association from multiple intermediate events for dynamic prediction of survival: an application to cardiovascular disease prognosis
authors: Tonghui Yu, Liming Xiang
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases are major causes of mortality globally. They often co-occur and are interrelated, leading to partial-order relationships among their onset times. However, these onset times are subject to informative censoring due to the occurrence of death, posing significant challenges for survival prediction. In this article, we propose a novel copula-based framework that learns dependence among multiple correlated marginal components through a pseudo-likelihood for estimation. We adopt nonparametric marginals, alleviating the reliance on marginal distribution assumptions typically required in conventional copula models, and estimate the association between the onsets of intermediate cardiovascular diseases and death by solving a concordance estimating equation. Under this framework, a renewable risk assessment method is developed for dynamic survival prediction, leveraging information on disease onset times and the maximum follow-up duration. Our proposed method yields estimators with well-established properties, and its flexibility and predictive effectiveness are demonstrated through extensive simulation studies. We apply the method to data from a heart disease study, demonstrating the benefits of incorporating the associations among various cardiovascular diseases and their synergistic effects on mortality for dynamic prediction of overall survival.
zh_title: 通过多个中间事件的关联学习进行动态生存预测：在心血管疾病预后中的应用
translation: 心血管疾病是全球死亡的主要原因。它们经常同时发生且相互关联，导致其发病时间之间存在偏序关系。然而，这些发病时间由于死亡事件的发生而受到信息性删失的影响，给生存预测带来了巨大挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于Copula的框架，通过伪似然估计来学习多个相关边缘分量之间的依赖关系。我们采用了非参数边缘分布，减轻了传统Copula模型通常要求的边缘分布假设依赖，并通过求解一致性估计方程来估计中间心血管疾病发病与死亡之间的关联。在此框架下，开发了一种可更新的风险评估方法用于动态生存预测，利用疾病发病时间和最大随访持续时间的信息。我们提出的方法产生了具有良好确定性质的估计量，并通过广泛的仿真研究证明了其灵活性和预测有效性。我们将该方法应用于一项心脏病研究的数据，证明了将各种心血管疾病之间的关联及其对死亡的协同效应纳入动态预测所带来的益处。
tldr: 提出了一种基于Copula的动态生存预测框架，通过建模心血管疾病中间事件与死亡之间的关联，有效提升了复杂疾病预后的预测精度。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地利用Copula模型处理多个具有偏序关系的中间事件，有效解决了因死亡导致的删失问题。通过非参数边缘分布和伪似然估计，增强了模型的灵活性，在处理心血管疾病预后等复杂生存分析问题上具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。
motivation: 心血管疾病常相互关联且存在发病时间偏序，由于死亡事件导致的删失使得传统生存预测方法难以准确建模这些复杂依赖关系，因此需要一种能利用多个中间事件信息的方法来提升动态生存预测的准确性。
method: 提出了一种基于Copula的框架，利用伪似然进行参数估计，采用非参数边缘分布来降低模型假设限制，并通过求解一致性估计方程来计算中间疾病发病与死亡之间的关联，最终开发出可更新的风险评估方法进行动态预测。
results: 仿真研究证明了该方法具有良好的估计性质和灵活性。在实际心血管疾病数据集的应用中，该方法通过整合多疾病间的关联及其对死亡的协同效应，显著提升了整体生存动态预测的有效性。
conclusion: 该方法通过建模多种心血管疾病与死亡之间的依赖关系，实现了更准确的动态生存预测，验证了多事件关联信息对于提升预后模型性能的重要性。

title: Forecasting Tangency Portfolios and Investing in the Minimum Euclidean Distance Portfolio to Maximize Out-of-Sample Sharpe Ratios
authors: Nolan Alexander, William Scherer
abstract: We propose a novel model to achieve superior out-of-sample Sharpe ratios. While most research in asset allocation focuses on estimating the return vector and covariance matrix, the first component of our novel model instead forecasts the future tangency portfolio, and the second component then determines the optimal investment portfolio. First, to forecast the tangency portfolio, we forecast the efficient frontier by decomposing its functional form, a square root second-order polynomial, into three interpretable coefficients, which can then be used to calculate a forecasted tangency portfolio. These coefficients can be forecasted using vector autoregressions. Second, the model invests in the portfolio on the efficient frontier that is the minimum Euclidean distance from this forecasted tangency portfolio. A motivation for our approach is to address the limitation that the tangency portfolio only maximizes the Sharpe ratio when future returns and covariances are stationary, and can be directly estimated with historical data, which often does not hold in out-of-sample data. Our approach addresses this shortcoming in a novel way by forecasting the tangency portfolio, rather than estimating return and covariance. For empirical testing, we employ two sets of assets that span the market to demonstrate and validate the performance of this novel method.
zh_title: 预测切线组合并投资于最小欧几里得距离组合以最大化样本外夏普比率
translation: 我们提出了一种实现优越样本外夏普比率的新模型。虽然大多数资产配置研究集中于估计收益率向量和协方差矩阵，但我们新模型的第一部分转而预测未来的切线组合，第二部分则确定最优投资组合。首先，为了预测切线组合，我们将有效前沿的函数形式（一个平方根二阶多项式）分解为三个可解释的系数，这些系数随后可用于计算预测的切线组合。这些系数可以使用向量自回归进行预测。其次，该模型投资于有效前沿上与该预测切线组合欧几里得距离最小的组合。我们方法的动机是解决这样一个局限性：只有当未来收益率和协方差是平稳的且可以直接用历史数据估计时，切线组合才能最大化夏普比率，而这在样本外数据中往往不成立。我们的方法通过预测切线组合而不是估计收益率和协方差，以一种新颖的方式解决了这一缺陷。在实证测试中，我们采用了两组跨越市场的资产来展示和验证这种新方法的性能。
tldr: 通过直接预测切线组合并寻找有效前沿上的近邻组合，而非预测收益率和协方差，从而显著提高了资产配置的样本外夏普比率。
ai_comments: 该研究通过直接预测切线组合而非传统先估计收益率和协方差矩阵的方法，巧妙地规避了参数估计误差对投资组合表现的影响。这种从函数形式分解切线组合的创新视角，为资产配置研究提供了新的思路。但该方法在不同市场环境下的稳健性仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 传统资产配置方法依赖于收益率向量和协方差矩阵的估计，但当样本外数据不满足平稳性假设时，直接估计效果欠佳，导致夏普比率较低。
method: 首先将有效前沿的函数形式（二阶多项式）分解为三个系数并利用向量自回归进行预测，进而推导出预测的切线组合；随后，选择有效前沿上与该预测切线组合欧几里得距离最小的组合进行投资。
results: 通过两组市场资产的实证检验，验证了该模型在样本外能够获得优于传统方法的夏普比率。
conclusion: 通过直接预测切线组合及其最小欧几里得距离投资组合，该模型在样本外表现出优于传统资产配置方法的夏普比率，有效应对了市场非平稳性带来的挑战。

title: Bootstrap-Aggregated Method-of-Moments Estimation of the Copula Correlation Parameter for Marginal Survival Inference under Dependent Censoring
authors: Hyun-Soo Zhang, Inkyung Jung, Chung Mo Nam
abstract: In dependently censored survival data, the usual assumption of independent censoring or an incorrect specification of the correlation between the event and censoring times can bias marginal survival inference. Likelihood-based estimation of this dependence can be numerically unstable with large variance, and practical alternatives are limited. The proposed method uses generalized method-of-moments to estimate the copula correlation parameter of a Normal, Clayton, Gumbel, or Frank copula that links exponential, Weibull, or log-normal marginal survival times. Bootstrap-aggregation of simulated annealing is employed over candidate correlation ranges to obtain stable estimates. Simulations assess accuracy and uncertainty via mean absolute error, bootstrap confidence intervals, and empirical coverage. The method is applied to a double-blind randomized clinical trial with dependent censoring from early patient dropouts, where accurate marginal survival inference is needed to estimate the effect of a treatment on patient survival.
zh_title: 基于Bootstrap聚集矩估计法的相依删失下边缘生存推断的Copula相关参数估计
translation: 在相依删失的生存数据中，通常的独立删失假设或对事件时间与删失时间之间相关性的错误设定，可能会导致边缘生存推断出现偏差。基于似然函数的依赖性估计在数值上可能不稳定，且方差较大，目前可用的实用替代方法十分有限。本文提出的方法使用广义矩估计来估计连接指数、Weibull或对数正态边缘生存时间的Normal、Clayton、Gumbel或Frank Copula的相关参数。通过在候选相关性范围内对模拟退火进行自助聚集（Bootstrap-aggregation），以获得稳定的估计值。仿真研究通过平均绝对误差、Bootstrap置信区间和经验覆盖率评估了准确性和不确定性。该方法被应用于一项因早期患者脱落而存在相依删失的双盲随机临床试验中，在该试验中，准确的边缘生存推断对于评估治疗对患者生存的影响至关重要。
tldr: 提出了一种用于相依删失生存分析的稳健估计方法，利用Bootstrap聚集的矩估计解决Copula相关参数估计的数值不稳定问题。
ai_comments: 该论文针对生存分析中常见的相依删失问题，提出了一种稳健的Copula相关参数估计方法。其创新之处在于结合了广义矩估计（GMM）与自助聚集（Bootstrap-Aggregation）模拟退火算法，有效克服了传统极大似然估计在处理此类问题时可能出现的数值不稳定和高方差问题。该方法具有较好的通用性，适用于多种Copula模型和边缘分布，在临床试验数据分析中具有重要的应用价值。
motivation: 在相依删失的生存数据中，传统的独立删失假设或错误的依赖关系设定会导致边缘生存推断出现偏差。现有的基于似然函数的估计方法往往存在数值不稳定和方差大的问题，且缺乏实用的替代方案。
method: 使用广义矩估计（GMM）来估计连接指数、Weibull或对数正态边缘生存时间的Normal、Clayton、Gumbel或Frank Copula的相关参数；并利用自助聚集（Bootstrap-aggregation）模拟退火算法在候选相关性范围内获得稳定的估计值。
results: 通过仿真研究验证了该方法的准确性和不确定性，指标包括平均绝对误差、Bootstrap置信区间和经验覆盖率。该方法成功应用于存在早期患者脱落导致相依删失的双盲随机临床试验中，提供了准确的边缘生存推断。
conclusion: 所提出的基于Bootstrap聚集的矩估计方法为相依删失下的边缘生存推断提供了一种稳定且准确的替代方案，有效解决了参数估计的收敛与稳定性问题。

title: Financial Relativity: An Information-Geometric Interpretation of Asset Pricing
authors: Li Lin
abstract: Classical asset pricing relies on the risk-neutral measure $Q$ for valuation, yet its economic interpretation is typically anchored in a physical measure $P$. This creates an inherent asymmetry: pricing is governed by $Q$, while meaning resides in $P$, making it difficult to provide a unified account of asset pricing within a single conceptual framework. This paper proposes an alternative perspective based on information geometry, termed Financial Relativity. Its central principle is the relativity of probabilistic reference frames: $P$ and $Q$ have no intrinsic hierarchy, but instead represent geometric structures induced by different informational constraints. Terminal structural information shapes probability geometry, which in turn governs how information is expressed in prices. Within this framework, the risk-neutral measure is reinterpreted as a posterior probability geometry. Asset prices are characterized as geometric projections of terminal payoffs onto information subspaces, and their dynamics reflect the progressive manifestation of structural information under evolving geometry. We develop both discrete and continuous financial field equations to describe the formation of probability geometry and derive geodesic price dynamics in which volatility arises endogenously from posterior uncertainty. The framework provides a unified explanation for price fluctuations, event-driven behavior, and risk premia, and yields testable implications, including structural links between volatility and posterior variance and measures of price informational efficiency. By integrating structural information, probability measures, and price dynamics within a single geometric framework, the paper offers a coherent, extensible, and empirically tractable reinterpretation of asset pricing.
zh_title: 金融相对论：资产定价的信息几何诠释
translation: 经典的资产定价依赖于风险中性测度 Q 进行估值，但其经济解释通常锚定在物理测度 P 上。这产生了一种固有的不对称性：定价由 Q 支配，而意义存在于 P 中，这使得在单一概念框架内提供统一的资产定价解释变得困难。本文提出了一种基于信息几何的替代视角，称为“金融相对论”。其核心原则是概率参考系的相对性：P 和 Q 没有内在的等级之分，而是代表由不同信息约束诱导的几何结构。终端结构信息塑造了概率几何，进而支配信息如何在价格中体现。在此框架内，风险中性测度被重新解释为后验概率几何。资产价格被刻画为终端收益在信息子空间上的几何投影，其动态反映了在不断演变的几何结构下结构信息的逐步显现。我们开发了离散和连续的金融场方程来描述概率几何的形成，并推导了测地线价格动态，其中波动率内生于后验不确定性。该框架为价格波动、事件驱动行为和风险溢价提供了统一的解释，并产生了可检验的启示，包括波动率与后验方差之间的结构联系以及价格信息效率的度量。通过将结构信息、概率测度和价格动态整合在一个单一的几何框架中，本文为资产定价提供了一种连贯、可扩展且实证上可处理的重新诠释。
tldr: 本文通过信息几何构建了一个统一的金融框架，将传统资产定价中割裂的物理测度和风险中性测度整合，并从几何角度解释了价格动态与波动率。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入微分几何中的信息几何概念，为资产定价理论提供了一个全新的视角。它成功地将传统的风险中性测度与物理测度统一在一个几何框架下，克服了传统方法中两者割裂的问题。其创新之处在于将波动率内生化，并用测地线描述价格动态，具有很强的理论深度和潜在的实证应用价值。
motivation: 传统资产定价理论中物理测度（P）与风险中性测度（Q）存在概念上的不对称与割裂，缺乏一个统一的框架来解释资产定价的本质与动态。
method: 利用信息几何原理，将物理测度和风险中性测度视为不同信息约束下诱导的几何结构；建立离散和连续的金融场方程来描述概率几何的形成，并推导价格的测地线动态。
results: 成功将风险中性测度重新解释为后验概率几何；推导出价格的测地线动态，揭示了波动率源于后验不确定性，并为价格波动、事件驱动行为和风险溢价提供了统一解释。
conclusion: 通过信息几何构建的“金融相对论”成功统一了资产定价中的物理测度和风险中性测度，为理解价格波动、风险溢价及信息效率提供了一个连贯的几何框架。

title: Estimating treatment effects with competing intercurrent events in randomized controlled trials
authors: Sizhu Lu, Yanyao Yi, Yongming Qu, Huayu Karen Liu, Ting Ye, Peng Ding
abstract: The analysis of randomized controlled trials is often complicated by intercurrent events (IEs) -- events that occur after treatment initiation and affect either the interpretation or existence of outcome measurements. Examples include treatment discontinuation or the use of additional medications. In two recent clinical trials for systemic lupus erythematosus with complications of IEs, we classify the IEs into two broad categories: effect-informative (e.g., treatment discontinuation due to adverse events or lack of efficacy) and effect-uninformative (e.g., treatment discontinuation due to external factors such as pandemics or relocation). To define a clinically meaningful estimand, we adopt tailored strategies for each category of IEs. For effect-informative IEs, which are often informative about a patient's outcome, we use the composite variable strategy that assigns an outcome value indicative of treatment failure. For effect-uninformative IEs, we apply the hypothetical strategy, assuming their timing is conditionally independent of the outcome given treatment and baseline covariates, and hypothesizing a scenario in which such events do not occur. A central yet previously overlooked challenge is the presence of competing IEs, where the first IE censors all subsequent ones. Despite its ubiquity in practice, this issue has not been explicitly recognized or addressed in previous data analyses due to the lack of rigorous statistical methodology. In this paper, we propose a principled framework to formulate the estimand, establish its nonparametric identification and semiparametric estimation theory, and introduce weighting, outcome regression, and doubly robust estimators. We apply our methods to analyze the two systemic lupus erythematosus trials, demonstrating the robustness and practical utility of the proposed framework.
zh_title: 随机对照试验中具有竞争性期间事件的治疗效果估计
translation: 随机对照试验的分析经常受到期间事件（IEs）的困扰——这些事件发生在治疗开始后，影响结果测量的解释或存在。例如治疗中断或使用额外药物。在最近两项针对系统性红斑狼疮且伴有IEs并发症的临床试验中，我们将IEs分为两大类：效果信息性（例如，由于不良事件或缺乏疗效导致的治疗中断）和效果非信息性（例如，由于流行病或搬迁等外部因素导致的治疗中断）。为了定义具有临床意义的估计量，我们为每一类IE采用了专门的策略。对于通常能提供患者预后信息的“效果信息性IEs”，我们使用复合变量策略，将结果值指定为治疗失败。对于“效果非信息性IEs”，我们采用假设策略，假设其发生时间在给定治疗和基线协变量的情况下与结果条件独立，并假设此类事件不会发生。一个核心但此前被忽视的挑战是竞争性IEs的存在，即第一个IE会删失所有后续事件。尽管这在实践中普遍存在，但由于缺乏严谨的统计方法，该问题在以前的数据分析中并未得到明确的认识或解决。在本文中，我们提出了一个原则性框架来制定估计量，建立了其非参数识别和半参数估计理论，并引入了加权、结果回归和双重稳健估计量。我们将我们的方法应用于分析两项系统性红斑狼疮试验，证明了所提框架的稳健性和实际效用。
tldr: 本文提出了一种处理临床试验中复杂竞争性期间事件的新统计框架，通过分类策略和稳健估计方法，解决了以往研究中被忽视的偏差问题。
ai_comments: 该论文针对临床试验中常见的“竞争性期间事件”问题提出了系统的统计框架，弥补了现有研究的空白。其创新之处在于将期间事件分类并采用组合策略，为处理复杂试验数据提供了实用的工具，具有很高的临床应用价值。
motivation: 在随机对照试验中，期间事件（如停药）会干扰结果测量，且存在竞争性期间事件（即第一个事件删失后续事件）的问题，现有方法缺乏严谨的统计框架来处理此类复杂情况。
method: 提出了一种包含加权、结果回归和双重稳健估计的半参数统计框架。针对效果信息性事件采用复合变量策略，针对效果非信息性事件采用假设策略，并专门处理了竞争性期间事件导致的审查问题。
results: 论文通过理论推导证明了所提框架的可识别性，并利用两个系统性红斑狼疮临床试验数据验证了该方法，证明了其在处理竞争性期间事件时的稳健性和实用性。
conclusion: 作者提出的框架通过非参数识别和半参数估计，成功解决了随机对照试验中竞争性期间事件带来的偏差问题，为更准确地评估治疗效果提供了理论和实践依据。

title: On Data Thinning for Model Validation in Small Area Estimation
authors: Sho Kawano, Paul A. Parker, Zehang Richard Li
abstract: Small area estimation (SAE) produces estimates of population parameters for geographic and demographic subgroups with limited sample sizes. Such estimates are critical for informing policy decisions, ranging from poverty mapping to social program funding. Despite its widespread use, principled validation of SAE models remains challenging and general guidelines are far from well-established. Unlike conventional predictive modeling settings, validation data are rarely available in the SAE context. External validation surveys or censuses often do not exist, and access to individual-level microdata is often restricted, making standard cross-validation infeasible. In this paper, we propose a novel model validation scheme using only area-level direct survey estimates under the widely used Fay--Herriot model. Our approach is based on data thinning, which splits area-level observations into independent training and test components to enable out-of-sample validation. Our theoretical analysis reveals a fundamental tension inherent in thinning-based validating: performance metrics measured on the thinned training component targets a different quantity than that based on the full data, with the gap varying by model complexity. Increasing the information allocated for training reduces this gap but inflates the variance of the estimator. We formally characterize this bias-variance tradeoff and provide practical recommendations for the thinning parameters that balance these competing considerations for model comparison. We show that data thinning with these settings provides consistent and stable performance across heterogeneous sampling designs in design-based simulations using American Community Survey microdata.
zh_title: 关于小区域估计中模型验证的数据稀疏化研究
translation: 小区域估计（SAE）为样本量有限的地理和人口统计亚组生成总体参数估计。此类估计对于决策制定至关重要，范围涵盖从贫困地图编制到社会项目资助。尽管应用广泛，但 SAE 模型的原则性验证仍然具有挑战性，且尚未形成通用的指导方针。与传统的预测建模环境不同，SAE 环境下通常缺乏验证数据。外部验证调查或普查往往不存在，且对个人层面微观数据的访问通常受到限制，使得标准的交叉验证不可行。在本文中，我们提出了一种仅使用 Fay-Herriot 模型下的区域级直接调查估计的新型模型验证方案。我们的方法基于数据稀疏化，将区域级观测值拆分为独立的训练和测试组件，以实现样本外验证。我们的理论分析揭示了基于稀疏化的验证中固有的基本矛盾：在稀疏化训练组件上测量的性能指标与基于全数据的指标所针对的目标量不同，且差距随模型复杂度而变化。增加分配给训练的信息量会缩小这一差距，但会增加估计量的方差。我们正式描述了这种偏差-方差权衡，并为平衡这些相互竞争的模型比较考虑因素的稀疏化参数提供了实用建议。在基于美国社区调查微观数据的设计仿真中，我们展示了具有这些设置的数据稀疏化在异构采样设计中提供了稳健且一致的性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用数据稀疏化技术在小区域估计（SAE）中进行模型验证的新方法，解决了因缺乏外部验证数据而导致的问题，并优化了验证过程中的偏差-方差权衡。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的数据稀疏化（data thinning）方法来解决小区域估计（SAE）中模型验证困难的问题。其贡献在于通过理论分析揭示了验证过程中的偏差-方差权衡，并提供了实用的参数建议，填补了SAE模型验证方法论的空白。
motivation: 小区域估计（SAE）在缺乏外部验证数据或微观数据受限的情况下，传统的交叉验证方法难以实施，导致其缺乏原则性的模型验证手段。
method: 提出了一种基于数据稀疏化（data thinning）的验证方案，将区域级观测值拆分为独立的训练和测试组件，并分析了该过程中的偏差-方差权衡，从而为模型比较提供建议。
results: 理论分析揭示了稀疏化过程中的偏差-方差权衡；基于美国社区调查（ACS）微观数据的仿真实验表明，该方法在异构采样设计下表现出一致且稳定的验证性能。
conclusion: 数据稀疏化方案通过在训练和测试集之间合理分配信息，为小区域估计模型提供了有效且稳定的验证手段，特别是在缺乏外部验证数据的情况下。

title: Deep Penalty Methods: A Class of Deep Learning Algorithms for Solving High Dimensional Optimal Stopping Problems
authors: Yunfei Peng, Pengyu Wei, Wei Wei
abstract: We propose a deep learning algorithm for high dimensional optimal stopping problems. Our method is inspired by the penalty method for solving free boundary PDEs. Within our approach, the penalized PDE is approximated using the Deep BSDE framework proposed by \cite{weinan2017deep}, which leads us to coin the term "Deep Penalty Method (DPM)" to refer to our algorithm. We show that the error of the DPM can be bounded by the loss function and $O(\frac{1}λ)+O(λh) +O(\sqrt{h})$, where $h$ is the step size in time and $λ$ is the penalty parameter. This finding emphasizes the need for careful consideration when selecting the penalization parameter and suggests that the discretization error converges at a rate of order $\frac{1}{2}$. We validate the efficacy of the DPM through numerical tests conducted on a high-dimensional optimal stopping model in the area of American option pricing. The numerical tests confirm both the accuracy and the computational efficiency of our proposed algorithm.
zh_title: 深度罚函数法：一类用于求解高维最优停止问题的深度学习算法
translation: 我们提出了一种用于求解高维最优停止问题的深度学习算法。我们的方法受到求解自由边界偏微分方程（PDE）的罚函数法的启发。在我们的方法中，利用Weinan E等人提出的Deep BSDE框架来近似带罚项的PDE，因此我们将该算法命名为“深度罚函数法（DPM）”。我们证明了DPM的误差可以由损失函数以及O(1/λ)+O(λh)+O(sqrt(h))来界定，其中h为时间步长，λ为惩罚参数。这一发现强调了在选择惩罚参数时需要仔细考虑，并表明离散化误差以1/2的阶数收敛。我们通过在高维最优停止模型（美式期权定价领域）上的数值测试验证了DPM的有效性。数值测试证实了我们所提算法的准确性和计算效率。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于深度学习和罚函数法的DPM算法，有效解决了高维最优停止问题（如美式期权定价），并给出了理论误差界。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将罚函数法（Penalty Method）与深度BSDE框架相结合，为解决高维最优停止问题提供了一种高效的数值路径。其理论误差分析揭示了惩罚参数与离散化步长之间的权衡关系，具有重要的理论参考价值。局限性在于对惩罚参数的敏感性，需在实际应用中进行精细调优。
motivation: 现有方法在高维最优停止问题上存在“维度灾难”，且传统的偏微分方程数值解法难以处理高维情况，需要开发更高效的深度学习算法。
method: 提出深度罚函数法（DPM），利用罚函数法处理自由边界偏微分方程，并结合Deep BSDE框架进行深度学习近似求解。
results: 理论上证明了DPM的误差界与惩罚参数及时间步长有关，误差收敛阶为1/2；数值实验验证了该方法在高维美式期权定价中的高精度与计算高效性。
conclusion: Deep Penalty Method (DPM) 是一种求解高维最优停止问题的有效算法，在美式期权定价等实际应用中表现出良好的精度和计算效率。

title: $α$-robust utility maximization with intractable claims: A quantile optimization approach
authors: Xinyu Chen, Zuo Quan Xu
abstract: This paper studies an $α$-robust utility maximization problem where an investor faces an intractable claim -- an exogenous contingent claim with known marginal distribution but unspecified dependence structure with financial market returns. The $α$-robust criterion interpolates between worst-case ($α=0$) and best-case ($α=1$) evaluations, generalizing both extremes through a continuous ambiguity attitude parameter. For weighted exponential utilities, we establish via rearrangement inequalities and comonotonicity theory that the $α$-robust risk measure is law-invariant, depending only on marginal distributions. This transforms the dynamic stochastic control problem into a concave static quantile optimization over a convex domain. We derive optimality conditions via calculus of variations and characterize the optimal quantile as the solution to a two-dimensional first-order ordinary differential equation system, which is a system of variational inequalities with mixed boundary conditions, enabling numerical solution. Our framework naturally accommodates additional risk constraints such as Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall. Numerical experiments reveal how ambiguity attitude, market conditions, and claim characteristics interact to shape optimal payoffs.
zh_title: 具有不可处理索赔的α-鲁棒效用最大化：一种分位数优化方法
translation: 本文研究了一个α-鲁棒效用最大化问题，其中投资者面临一个不可处理的索赔——即一个具有已知边际分布但与金融市场收益的依赖结构未知的外部或有索赔。α-鲁棒准则在最坏情况（α=0）和最好情况（α=1）评估之间进行插值，通过一个连续的模糊态度参数概括了这两个极端。对于加权指数效用，我们通过重排不等式和共单调性理论证明了α-鲁棒风险度量具有法律不变性，仅取决于边际分布。这使得动态随机控制问题转化为凸域上的凹静态分位数优化。我们通过变分法推导了最优性条件，并将最优分位数刻画为二维一阶常微分方程组的解（该系统为具有混合边界条件的变分不等式系统），从而实现了数值求解。我们的框架自然地容纳了诸如风险价值（VaR）和预期亏损（ES）等额外的风险约束。数值实验揭示了模糊态度、市场条件和索赔特征如何相互作用以塑造最优收益。
tldr: 本文提出了一种处理未知依赖结构索赔的α-鲁棒效用最大化方法，通过分位数优化将复杂的动态问题转化为可数值求解的常微分方程组。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于引入了α-鲁棒标准来处理具有不确定依赖结构的复杂索赔（intractable claims），并成功将复杂的动态随机控制问题转化为静态的分位数优化问题。通过重排不等式和共单调性理论，将问题简化为ODE求解，为处理金融市场中的不确定性提供了稳健且可计算的框架。
motivation: 投资者在面临具有已知边际分布但与市场收益依赖结构未知的外部或有索赔时，需要一种能够平衡最坏情况和最好情况的稳健决策框架。
method: 利用重排不等式和共单调性理论证明风险度量的法律不变性，将动态随机控制问题转化为静态凹分位数优化，并通过变分法推导最优性条件，最终将其简化为二维一阶常微分方程系统进行求解。
results: 建立了α-鲁棒效用最大化的最优性条件，证明了问题可转化为二维一阶常微分方程组求解，并证实该框架能有效整合VaR和ES等风险约束。
conclusion: 通过将α-鲁棒效用最大化转化为分位数优化，该研究为处理具有未知依赖关系的金融索赔提供了一种有效、可数值求解的理论框架。

title: Dividend ratcheting and capital injection under the Cramér-Lundberg model: Strong solution and optimal strategy
authors: Chonghu Guan, Zuo Quan Xu
abstract:
We consider an optimal dividend payout problem for an insurance company whose surplus follows the classical Cramér-Lundberg model. The dividend rate is subject to a ratcheting constraint (i.e., it must be nondecreasing over time), and the company may inject capital at a proportional cost to avoid ruin. This problem gives rise to a stochastic control problem with a self-path-dependent control constraint, costly capital injections, and jump-diffusion dynamics. The associated Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation is a partial integro-differential variational inequality featuring both a nonlocal integral term and a gradient constraint.
  We develop a systematic probabilistic and PDE-based approach to solve this HJB equation. By discretizing the space of admissible dividend rates, we construct a sequence of approximating regime-switching systems of ordinary integro-differential equations. Through careful a priori estimates and a limiting argument, we prove the existence and uniqueness of a \emph{strong solution} in a suitable space. This regularity result is fundamental: it allows us to characterize the optimal dividend policy via a switching free boundary and to construct an explicit optimal feedback control strategy. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first complete solution -- comprising both the value function and an implementable optimal strategy -- for a dividend ratcheting problem with capital injection under the Cramér-Lundberg model. Our work advances the mathematical theory of optimal stochastic control beyond the standard viscosity solution framework, providing a rigorous foundation for dividend policy design in economics.
zh_title: Cramér-Lundberg模型下的股息棘轮与资本注入：强解与最优策略
translation: 我们考虑了一家盈余遵循经典Cramér-Lundberg模型的保险公司的最优股息支付问题。股息率受到棘轮约束（即随时间必须非递减），且公司可以按比例成本注入资本以避免破产。该问题产生了一个带有路径依赖控制约束、昂贵资本注入和跳跃扩散动力学的随机控制问题。相关的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) 方程是一个偏积分微分变分不等式，具有非局部积分项和梯度约束。我们开发了一种系统的基于概率和PDE的方法来求解该HJB方程。通过对容许股息率空间进行离散化，我们构建了一系列逼近的体制转换常微分积分方程组。通过仔细的先验估计和极限论证，我们证明了在适当空间中强解的存在唯一性。这一正则性结果是基础性的：它允许我们通过切换自由边界来刻画最优股息政策，并构建一个显式的最优反馈控制策略。据我们所知，这是Cramér-Lundberg模型下带有资本注入的股息棘轮问题的第一个完整解——包括价值函数和可实施的最优策略。我们的工作将最优随机控制的数学理论推进到了标准粘性解框架之外，为经济学中的股息政策设计提供了严格的基础。
tldr: 本文首次为Cramér-Lundberg模型下带有股息棘轮限制和资本注入的保险公司提供了完整的数学强解及可实施的最优控制策略。
ai_comments: 该论文在随机控制领域具有重要意义，因为它超越了传统的粘性解框架，通过构造强解解决了具有路径依赖约束和跳跃扩散动力学的复杂问题，为实际保险公司的股息策略提供了严格的理论支撑。
motivation: 研究保险公司在股息支付需满足非递减（棘轮）约束且允许通过注资避免破产的情形下，如何制定最优的股息支付策略。
method: 通过离散化容许股息率空间，构建一系列逼近的体制转换常微分积分方程组，并利用先验估计和极限论证证明了HJB方程强解的存在唯一性。
results: 证明了Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) 方程强解的存在唯一性，并通过切换自由边界表征了最优股息策略，构造了可实施的最优反馈控制策略。
conclusion: 本文成功证明了该随机控制问题强解的存在唯一性，并给出了明确的最优反馈控制策略，填补了Cramér-Lundberg模型下股息棘轮效应与资本注入结合问题的研究空白。

title: Holos: A Web-Scale LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for the Agentic Web
authors: Xiaohang Nie, Zihan Guo, Zicai Cui, Jiachi Yang, Zeyi Chen, Leheyi De, Yu Zhang, Junwei Liao, Bo Huang, Yingxuan Yang, Zhi Han, Zimian Peng, Linyao Chen, Wenzheng Tom Tang, Zongkai Liu, Tao Zhou, Botao Amber Hu, Shuyang Tang, Jianghao Lin, Weiwen Liu, Muning Wen, Yuanjian Zhou, Weinan Zhang
abstract: As large language models (LLM)-driven agents transition from isolated task solvers to persistent digital entities, the emergence of the Agentic Web, an ecosystem where heterogeneous agents autonomously interact and co-evolve, marks a pivotal shift toward Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). However, LLM-based multi-agent systems (LaMAS) are hindered by open-world issues such as scaling friction, coordination breakdown, and value dissipation. To address these challenges, we introduce Holos, a web-scale LaMAS architected for long-term ecological persistence. Holos adopts a five-layer architecture, with core modules primarily featuring the Nuwa engine for high-efficiency agent generation and hosting, a market-driven Orchestrator for resilient coordination, and an endogenous value cycle to achieve incentive compatibility. By bridging the gap between micro-level collaboration and macro-scale emergence, Holos hopes to lay the foundation for the next generation of the self-organizing and continuously evolving Agentic Web. We have publicly released Holos (accessible at https://holosai.io), providing a resource for the community and a testbed for future research in large-scale agentic ecosystems.
zh_title: Holos：面向Agentic Web的Web规模LLM多智能体系统
translation: 随着基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体从孤立的任务求解器向持久的数字实体转变，“Agentic Web”（智能体网络）——一个异构智能体自主交互和共同进化的生态系统——的出现，标志着迈向通用人工智能（AGI）的关键一步。然而，基于LLM的多智能体系统（LaMAS）受到扩展摩擦、协作崩溃和价值流失等开放世界问题的阻碍。为了解决这些挑战，我们推出了Holos，这是一个为长期生态持久性而构建的Web规模LaMAS。Holos采用五层架构，核心模块主要包括用于高效智能体生成和托管的Nuwa引擎、用于弹性协调的市场驱动型Orchestrator，以及用于实现激励兼容的内生价值循环。通过弥合微观协作与宏观涌现之间的鸿沟，Holos旨在为下一代自组织和持续进化的Agentic Web奠定基础。我们已经公开发布了Holos（可通过 https://holosai.io 访问），为社区提供资源，并为大规模智能体生态系统的未来研究提供测试平台。
tldr: Holos是一个创新的Web规模多智能体系统，通过市场驱动的协调和内生价值循环，解决了大规模智能体协作与持续演化的难题。
ai_comments: Holos通过引入市场机制和五层架构来解决多智能体系统在开放环境下的扩展性和协作难题，为Agentic Web的发展提供了一个具有实际参考意义的框架和测试平台。
motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统在面对开放世界时存在扩展困难、协作失效和价值流失等问题，难以支持长期的生态演化。
method: 提出了一个五层架构系统，核心包括用于高效生成与托管的Nuwa引擎、基于市场驱动的协调器，以及用于实现激励兼容的内生价值循环。
results: 构建了一个支持大规模、长期生态存在的Agentic Web平台，并向社区公开了系统以供研究和测试。
conclusion: Holos为构建大规模、可自我组织和持续进化的Agentic Web提供了一种稳健的架构方案，通过激励机制和高效协同解决了多智能体系统的长期生存问题。

title: Generating Counterfactual Patient Timelines from Real-World Data
authors: Yu Akagi, Tomohisa Seki, Toru Takiguchi, Hiromasa Ito, Yoshimasa Kawazoe, Kazuhiko Ohe
abstract: Counterfactual simulation - exploring hypothetical consequences under alternative clinical scenarios - holds promise for transformative applications such as personalized medicine and in silico trials. However, it remains challenging due to methodological limitations. Here, we show that an autoregressive generative model trained on real-world data from over 300,000 patients and 400 million patient timeline entries can generate clinically plausible counterfactual trajectories. As a validation task, we applied the model to patients hospitalized with COVID-19 in 2023, modifying age, serum C-reactive protein (CRP), and serum creatinine to simulate 7-day outcomes. Increased in-hospital mortality was observed in counterfactual simulations with older age, elevated CRP, and elevated serum creatinine. Remdesivir prescriptions increased in simulations with higher CRP values and decreased in those with impaired kidney function. These counterfactual trajectories reproduced known clinical patterns. These findings suggest that autoregressive generative models trained on real-world data in a self-supervised manner can establish a foundation for counterfactual clinical simulation.
zh_title: 从真实世界数据中生成反事实患者轨迹
translation: 反事实仿真——探索替代临床情景下的假设性后果——在个性化医疗和计算机模拟临床试验等变革性应用中具有巨大潜力。然而，由于方法论的局限性，这一领域仍面临挑战。在这里，我们展示了一个在超过30万名患者和4亿条患者时间轴记录的真实世界数据上训练的自回归生成模型，该模型能够生成具有临床合理性的反事实轨迹。作为一项验证任务，我们将该模型应用于2023年住院的COVID-19患者，通过修改年龄、血清C反应蛋白（CRP）和血清肌酐来模拟7天后的结果。在年龄较大、CRP升高和血清肌酐升高的反事实模拟中，观察到了更高的住院死亡率。在CRP值较高的模拟中，瑞德西韦的处方量增加，而在肾功能受损的模拟中处方量减少。这些反事实轨迹再现了已知的临床模式。这些发现表明，以自监督方式在真实世界数据上训练的自回归生成模型可以为反事实临床仿真奠定基础。
tldr: 利用自回归生成模型通过大规模真实世界数据模拟不同临床假设下的患者轨迹，为个性化医疗提供仿真支持。
ai_comments: 该研究展示了自回归生成模型在处理大规模真实世界医疗数据中的潜力，通过模拟反事实场景验证了模型捕捉复杂临床因果模式的能力，为个性化医疗和临床试验提供了新的仿真工具。局限性在于反事实生成的因果有效性在复杂临床环境下的验证仍需更多临床研究支持。
motivation: 现有的反事实仿真方法在临床应用中存在方法论上的局限，需要一种能够利用大规模真实世界数据生成临床合理轨迹的有效方法。
method: 采用自监督学习方式，利用超过30万名患者和4亿条数据记录，训练了一个自回归生成模型，并通过修改患者特征（如年龄、CRP、肌酐）来模拟和预测反事实的7天临床结果。
results: 模型成功模拟了COVID-19住院患者的7天结果，发现高龄、高CRP及高肌酐水平会导致更高的住院死亡率；模型生成的瑞德西韦处方模式与临床已知规律一致。
conclusion: 基于真实世界数据训练的自回归生成模型能够有效生成具有临床合理性的反事实患者轨迹，为反事实临床仿真提供了一个坚实的基础。

title: SIEVE: Sample-Efficient Parametric Learning from Natural Language
authors: Parth Asawa, Alexandros G. Dimakis, Matei Zaharia
abstract: Natural language context-such as instructions, knowledge, or feedback-contains rich signal for adapting language models. While in-context learning provides adaptation via the prompt, parametric learning persists into model weights and can improve performance further, though is data hungry and heavily relies on either high-quality traces or automated verifiers. We propose SIEVE, a method for sample-efficient parametric learning from natural language context that requires as few as three query examples. SIEVE uses a novel synthetic data generation pipeline, SIEVE-GEN, that leverages the insight that context is decomposable. Decomposing context allows us to generate higher quality rollouts by pairing synthetic queries with only the applicable context rather than the entirety, then using context distillation to internalize context into the model. We evaluate in reasoning settings where context is necessary, including custom domains and the RuleArena and Machine Translation from One Book tasks. Our results show that SIEVE outperforms prior context distillation methods using just three query examples, demonstrating how to achieve sample-efficient parametric learning from natural language.
zh_title: SIEVE：从自然语言中进行样本高效的参数化学习
translation: 自然语言上下文（如指令、知识或反馈）包含了用于调整语言模型的丰富信号。虽然上下文学习通过提示词提供适应性，但参数化学习会将信息持久化到模型权重中，从而进一步提升性能，不过它非常依赖数据，且高度依赖高质量的追踪或自动验证器。我们提出了SIEVE，一种从自然语言上下文中进行样本高效参数化学习的方法，该方法仅需少至三个查询示例。SIEVE使用了一种新颖的合成数据生成管道SIEVE-GEN，利用了上下文可分解这一洞察。分解上下文使我们能够通过将合成查询仅与适用的上下文而非全部上下文配对来生成更高质量的训练数据，然后使用上下文蒸馏将上下文内化到模型中。我们在需要上下文的推理设置中进行了评估，包括自定义领域、RuleArena和“从一本书中进行机器翻译”任务。结果表明，SIEVE仅使用三个查询示例就优于先前的上下文蒸馏方法，展示了如何从自然语言中实现样本高效的参数化学习。
tldr: SIEVE是一种仅需3个样本即可将自然语言上下文知识内化到模型权重中的高效参数化学习方法。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的上下文分解方法，能够以极少样本（仅3个）实现高效的参数化学习，解决了传统参数化学习对大规模高质量数据或自动验证器的依赖问题。这对于资源受限场景下的模型适应具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的参数化学习方法通常需要大量数据或高质量追踪，而上下文学习（In-context learning）虽然灵活但无法改变模型权重。作者旨在探索一种能在极少样本条件下实现高效参数化学习的方法。
method: 提出SIEVE方法，核心是SIEVE-GEN管道。该管道将复杂的上下文进行分解，通过将合成查询与特定相关上下文配对生成高质量训练数据，并利用上下文蒸馏技术将这些信息内化到模型权重中。
results: 在推理、自定义领域及机器翻译等任务中，SIEVE仅需3个查询示例即可超越现有的上下文蒸馏方法，显著提升了参数化学习的样本效率。
conclusion: SIEVE通过上下文分解和蒸馏技术，成功实现了极少样本下的高效参数化学习，为利用自然语言上下文提升模型能力提供了新路径。

title: LiME: Lightweight Mixture of Experts for Efficient Multimodal Multi-task Learning
authors: Md Kowsher, Haris Mansoor, Nusrat Jahan Prottasha, Ozlem Garibay, Victor Zhu, Zhengping Ji, Chen Chen
abstract: MoE-PEFT methods combine Mixture of Experts with parameter-efficient fine-tuning for multi-task adaptation, but require separate adapters per expert causing trainable parameters to scale linearly with expert count and limiting applicability to adapter-based architectures. We propose LiME (Lightweight Mixture of Experts), which achieves expert specialization through lightweight modulation rather than adapter replication. Instead of separate adapters, LiME uses a single shared PEFT module and modulates its output with lightweight expert vectors, reducing expert parameters while generalizing to any PEFT method. Notably, LiME introduces zero-parameter routing by leveraging existing frozen and adapted representations eliminating learned router parameters typically required per layer. Theoretically, we prove that (i) more experts preserve more task-relevant information and (ii) modulation approximates full expert-specific PEFT with bounded error. LiME further incorporates n-gram windowed routing and adaptive expert selection (Auto Top-K) based on routing confidence. Experiments on MMT-47, a multimodal multi-task benchmark with 47 tasks spanning text, image, and video, demonstrate that LiME achieves competitive or superior performance while using up to 4x fewer trainable parameters and up to 29% faster training compared to corresponding MoE-PEFT baselines.
zh_title: LiME：用于高效多模态多任务学习的轻量化混合专家模型
translation: MoE-PEFT方法将混合专家模型（MoE）与参数高效微调（PEFT）相结合以进行多任务适应，但它们要求每个专家配备独立的适配器，导致可训练参数随专家数量呈线性增长，并限制了其在基于适配器的架构中的适用性。我们提出了LiME（轻量化混合专家模型），通过轻量级调制而非适配器复制来实现专家专业化。LiME不使用单独的适配器，而是使用单个共享PEFT模块并通过轻量级专家向量对其输出进行调制，从而在减少专家参数的同时推广到任何PEFT方法。值得注意的是，LiME通过利用现有的冻结和适配表示，引入了零参数路由，消除了通常每层所需的学习型路由参数。在理论上，我们证明了（i）更多的专家可以保留更多与任务相关的信息，以及（ii）调制可以以有界误差近似全专家特定的PEFT。LiME进一步结合了n-gram窗口路由和基于路由置信度的自适应专家选择（Auto Top-K）。在包含文本、图像和视频的47个任务的多模态多任务基准MMT-47上的实验表明，与相应的MoE-PEFT基线相比，LiME在实现具有竞争力或优越性能的同时，可训练参数减少了4倍，训练速度提高了29%。
tldr: LiME通过共享适配器和轻量级调制取代了传统的冗余专家适配器，实现了更高效的多模态多任务学习，参数更少且训练更快。
ai_comments: LiME通过巧妙的调制机制解决了MoE-PEFT在大规模多任务学习中参数量激增的问题。其核心创新在于将“专家特定适配器”简化为“共享适配器+轻量级向量调制”，并提出零参数路由策略。这种方法不仅降低了计算负担，还具有很好的架构通用性，在多模态多任务场景下展现出极高的效率与性能平衡。
motivation: 现有的MoE-PEFT方法在处理多任务时，随着专家数量增加，训练参数呈线性增长，且受限于特定架构，难以在大规模多任务场景下高效部署。
method: 提出LiME架构，使用单个共享PEFT模块配合轻量级专家向量进行调制，取代传统的每个专家对应一个独立适配器；采用零参数路由策略，利用冻结和适配后的表示进行专家分配；引入n-gram窗口路由及基于置信度的自动Top-K专家选择。
results: 在MMT-47基准测试中，LiME相比MoE-PEFT基线模型，训练参数减少达4倍，训练速度提升达29%，同时保持了相等或更优的性能。
conclusion: LiME为高效多模态多任务学习提供了一种轻量化、高扩展性的解决方案，证明了通过共享组件与高效调制即可实现专家专业化，无需冗余的参数复制。

title: Convolutional Surrogate for 3D Discrete Fracture-Matrix Tensor Upscaling
authors: Martin Špetlík, Jan Březina
abstract:
Modeling groundwater flow in three-dimensional fractured crystalline media requires accounting for strong spatial heterogeneity induced by fractures. Fine-scale discrete fracture-matrix (DFM) simulations can capture this complexity but are computationally expensive, especially when repeated evaluations are needed. To address this, we aim to employ a multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) framework in which numerical homogenization is used to upscale sub-resolution fracture effects when transitioning between accuracy levels.
  To reduce the cost of conventional 3D numerical homogenization, we develop a surrogate model that predicts the equivalent hydraulic conductivity tensor Keq from a voxelized 3D domain representing tensor-valued random fields of matrix and fracture conductivities. Fracture size, orientation, and aperture are sampled from distributions informed by natural observations.
  The surrogate architecture combines a 3D convolutional neural network with feed-forward layers, enabling it to capture both local spatial features and global interactions. Three surrogates are trained on data generated by DFM simulations, each corresponding to a different fracture-to-matrix conductivity contrast. Performance is evaluated across a wide range of fracture network parameters and matrix-field correlation lengths.
  The trained models achieve high accuracy, with normalized root-mean-square errors below 0.22 across most test cases. Practical applicability is demonstrated by comparing numerically homogenized conductivities with surrogate predictions in two macro-scale problems: computing equivalent conductivity tensors and predicting outflow from a constrained 3D domain. In both cases, surrogate-based upscaling preserves accuracy while substantially reducing computational cost, achieving speedups exceeding 100x when inference is performed on a GPU.
zh_title: 用于三维离散裂隙-基质张量均匀化的卷积代理模型
translation: 在三维裂隙结晶介质中模拟地下水流，需要考虑由裂隙引起的强空间异质性。细尺度的离散裂隙-基质（DFM）模拟可以捕捉这种复杂性，但在需要重复评估时计算成本昂贵。为了解决这个问题，我们旨在采用多层蒙特卡洛（MLMC）框架，在精度级别转换时使用数值均匀化来向上缩放子分辨率裂隙效应。为了降低传统3D数值均匀化的成本，我们开发了一个代理模型，从表示基质和裂隙导率张量值随机场的体素化3D域中预测等效水力传导率张量Keq。裂隙的尺寸、方向和孔径是从基于自然观测的分布中抽取的。代理架构结合了3D卷积神经网络和前馈层，使其能够捕捉局部空间特征和全局相互作用。三个代理模型在DFM模拟生成的数据上进行训练，每个模型对应不同的裂隙与基质导率对比度。性能在广泛的裂隙网络参数和基质场相关长度范围内进行了评估。训练后的模型实现了高精度，大多数测试案例的归一化均方根误差低于0.22。通过在两个宏观尺度问题中比较数值均匀化导率与代理预测，证明了其实际适用性：计算等效导率张量和预测受限3D域的流出量。在这两种情况下，基于代理的向上缩放都保持了精度，同时大幅降低了计算成本，在GPU上进行推理时实现了超过100倍的加速。
tldr: 提出了一种基于3D卷积神经网络的代理模型，将三维裂隙介质的数值均匀化速度提升了100倍以上，且保持了高精度。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入卷积神经网络作为代理模型，有效解决了三维裂隙-基质流模拟中数值均匀化计算成本高昂的问题。其创新之处在于利用深度学习捕捉复杂的空间裂隙特征，并实现了超过100倍的计算加速，为大规模地下水模拟提供了一种高效的替代方案。限制在于模型可能受限于训练数据中裂隙参数的分布范围。
motivation: 三维裂隙介质中的地下水流模拟具有高度空间异质性，传统的细尺度离散裂隙-基质（DFM）模拟计算成本过高，无法满足重复评估的需求。
method: 开发了一个结合3D卷积神经网络和前馈层的代理模型，利用体素化的3D域预测等效水力传导率张量，并使用多层蒙特卡洛（MLMC）框架进行集成应用。
results: 代理模型在测试集上的归一化均方根误差低于0.22，在宏观尺度问题中，相比传统数值均匀化方法实现了超过100倍的加速，同时保持了良好的精度。
conclusion: 卷积代理模型能够准确、高效地替代传统的数值均匀化方法，在保持计算精度的同时，显著降低了三维裂隙介质流模拟的计算成本。

title: Not All Denoising Steps Are Equal: Model Scheduling for Faster Masked Diffusion Language Models
authors: Ivan Sedykh, Nikita Sorokin, Valentin Malykh
abstract: Recent advances in masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) narrow the quality gap to autoregressive LMs, but their sampling remains expensive because generation requires many full-sequence denoising passes with a large Transformer and, unlike autoregressive decoding, cannot benefit from KV caching. In this work, we exploit the flexibility of the diffusion framework and study model scheduling, where a smaller MDLM replaces the full model at a subset of denoising steps. On OpenWebText, we show that early and late denoising steps are substantially more robust to such replacement than middle steps, enabling up to a 17% reduction in FLOPs with only modest degradation in generative perplexity. We support these findings with a step-importance analysis based on loss and KL divergence between small and large models across timesteps, as well as an exhaustive search over coarse step segments, both of which identify the middle of the diffusion trajectory as most sensitive. Our results suggest that simple, architecture-agnostic scheduling rules can significantly accelerate MDLM sampling while largely preserving generation quality as measured by generative perplexity.
zh_title: 并非所有去噪步骤都均等：用于更快掩码扩散语言模型的模型调度
translation: 近期掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的进展缩小了与自回归语言模型的质量差距，但它们的采样仍然昂贵，因为生成需要多次使用大型Transformer进行全序列去噪，并且与自回归解码不同，它无法受益于KV缓存。在这项工作中，我们利用扩散框架的灵活性，研究模型调度，即在去噪步骤的子集中，一个较小的MDLM取代完整的模型。在OpenWebText上，我们发现早期和晚期的去噪步骤比中间步骤更能容忍这种替换，使得FLOPs减少高达17%，而生成困惑度仅有适度的下降。我们通过基于损失和跨时间步长的小模型与大模型之间KL散度的步骤重要性分析，以及对粗糙步骤段的详尽搜索来支持这些发现，两者都将扩散轨迹的中间部分确定为最敏感的。我们的结果表明，简单的、与架构无关的调度规则可以显著加速MDLM的采样，同时在很大程度上保持生成质量，以生成困惑度来衡量。
tldr: 通过在扩散模型的早期和晚期去噪步骤中使用较小的模型，可以显著减少计算量（高达17%），同时对生成质量的影响很小。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过模型调度有效地解决了MDLM采样成本高的问题，具有重要的实际应用价值。通过分析不同去噪步骤的重要性，该研究为加速扩散模型提供了有见地的见解。然而，仅使用生成困惑度作为评估指标可能不够全面，未来可以考虑其他评估指标。
motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的采样成本高，因为它们需要多次完整的去噪过程，并且无法利用KV缓存。
method: 研究模型调度，即在部分去噪步骤中使用一个较小的MDLM来替代完整的模型，并通过损失和KL散度分析来评估不同去噪步骤的重要性。
results: 早期和晚期的去噪步骤比中间步骤更能容忍被较小的模型替换，这使得计算量减少了17%，而生成困惑度仅有适度的下降。
conclusion: 简单的、与架构无关的模型调度规则可以显著加速MDLM的采样过程，同时在很大程度上保持生成质量。

title: Homophily-aware Supervised Contrastive Counterfactual Augmented Fair Graph Neural Network
authors: Mahdi Tavassoli Kejani, Fadi Dornaika, Charlotte Laclau, Jean-Michel Loubes
abstract: In recent years, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable success in tasks such as node classification, link prediction, and graph representation learning. However, they remain susceptible to biases that can arise not only from node attributes but also from the graph structure itself. Addressing fairness in GNNs has therefore emerged as a critical research challenge. In this work, we propose a novel model for training fairness-aware GNNs by improving the counterfactual augmented fair graph neural network framework (CAF). Specifically, our approach introduces a two-phase training strategy: in the first phase, we edit the graph to increase homophily ratio with respect to class labels while reducing homophily ratio with respect to sensitive attribute labels; in the second phase, we integrate a modified supervised contrastive loss and environmental loss into the optimization process, enabling the model to jointly improve predictive performance and fairness. Experiments on five real-world datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms CAF and several state-of-the-art graph-based learning methods in both classification accuracy and fairness metrics.

title: Haiku to Opus in Just 10 bits: LLMs Unlock Massive Compression Gains
authors: Roy Rinberg, Annabelle Michael Carrell, Simon Henniger, Nicholas Carlini, Keri Warr
abstract:
We study the compression of LLM-generated text across lossless and lossy regimes, characterizing a compression-compute frontier where more compression is possible at the cost of more compute. For lossless compression, domain-adapted LoRA adapters can improve LLM-based arithmetic coding by 2x over compression with the base LLM alone. For lossy compression, prompting a model for a succinct rewrite then applying arithmetic coding can achieve compression ratios of approximately 0.03, a 2x improvement over compressing the original response.
  We further introduce Question-Asking compression (QA), an interactive lossy protocol inspired by the game 'Twenty Questions'. A small model iteratively refines its response by asking yes/no questions to a stronger model, transferring exactly one bit per answer. On 8 benchmarks spanning math, science, and code, 10 binary questions recover 23% to 72% of the capability gap between a small and large model on standard benchmarks and 7% to 38% on harder benchmarks, achieving compression ratios of 0.0006 to 0.004. This is over 100x smaller than prior LLM-based compression (Deletang et al., 2024), suggesting that interactive protocols can transfer knowledge far more efficiently than transmitting full responses.

title: LLM Reasoning with Process Rewards for Outcome-Guided Steps
authors: Mohammad Rezaei, Jens Lehmann, Sahar Vahdati
abstract:
Mathematical reasoning in large language models has improved substantially with reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards, where final answers can be checked automatically and converted into reliable training signals. Most such pipelines optimize outcome correctness only, which yields sparse feedback for long, multi-step solutions and offers limited guidance on intermediate reasoning errors. Recent work therefore introduces process reward models (PRMs) to score intermediate steps and provide denser supervision. In practice, PRM scores are often imperfectly aligned with final correctness and can reward locally fluent reasoning that still ends in an incorrect answer. When optimized as absolute rewards, such signals can amplify fluent failure modes and induce reward hacking.
  We propose PROGRS, a framework that leverages PRMs while keeping outcome correctness dominant. PROGRS treats process rewards as relative preferences within outcome groups rather than absolute targets. We introduce outcome-conditioned centering, which shifts PRM scores of incorrect trajectories to have zero mean within each prompt group. It removes systematic bias while preserving informative rankings. PROGRS combines a frozen quantile-regression PRM with a multi-scale coherence evaluator. We integrate the resulting centered process bonus into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) without auxiliary objectives or additional trainable components. Across MATH-500, AMC, AIME, MinervaMath, and OlympiadBench, PROGRS consistently improves Pass@1 over outcome-only baselines and achieves stronger performance with fewer rollouts. These results show that outcome-conditioned centering enables safe and effective use of process rewards for mathematical reasoning.

zh_title: LLM 结合过程奖励以进行结果导向的推理
translation:
大型语言模型在通过可验证奖励的强化学习方面取得了显著进展，其中最终答案可以自动检查并转化为可靠的训练信号。然而，大多数此类流程仅优化结果的正确性，这对于长而多步骤的解决方案会产生稀疏反馈，并为中间推理错误提供有限的指导。因此，最近的工作引入了过程奖励模型（PRM）来对中间步骤进行评分，并提供更密集的监督。实际上，PRM 分数通常与最终正确性不完全一致，并且可能奖励局部流畅但最终错误的推理。当作为绝对奖励进行优化时，此类信号会放大流畅的失败模式并诱发奖励欺骗。

我们提出了 PROGRS，一个利用 PRM 但保持最终结果正确性占主导地位的框架。PROGRS 将过程奖励视为结果分组内的相对偏好，而不是绝对目标。我们引入了结果条件居中，它将每个提示分组内错误轨迹的 PRM 分数移至零均值。这消除了系统偏差，同时保留了信息丰富的排名。

PROGRS 结合了一个固定的分位数回归 PRM 和一个多尺度连贯性评估器。我们将由此产生的居中过程奖励加分整合到组相对策略优化（GRPO）中，没有辅助目标或额外的可训练组件。

在 MATH-500、AMC、AIME、MinervaMath 和 OlympiadBench 上，PROGRS 持续提高了 Pass@1 相对于仅结果的基线，并且在更少的采样次数下实现了更强的性能。这些结果表明，结果条件居中能够安全有效地利用过程奖励来进行数学推理。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为 PROGRS 的新框架，该框架通过将过程奖励（PRM）分数进行居中处理，使其在最终正确结果的引导下，而不是作为绝对奖励，来解决数学推理中的稀疏奖励和奖励欺骗问题。实验证明，PROGRS 在多个数学推理基准测试中显著提高了 Pass@1 性能，并且效率更高。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法来解决 LLM 数学推理中的奖励稀疏性和奖励欺骗问题，通过“结果条件居中”机制有效地利用了过程奖励。这种将过程奖励转化为相对偏好的思路具有重要意义，避免了直接优化可能带来的负面影响。然而，该方法在多尺度连贯性评估器和 GRPO 优化器中的具体实现细节以及其泛化能力仍需进一步探索。未来可以研究更复杂的奖励对齐技术，以及将此框架应用于其他需要多步骤推理的领域。
motivation: 现有的强化学习方法在数学推理中主要依赖最终答案的正确性进行奖励，这对于多步骤推理来说奖励信号稀疏，且难以纠正中间推理错误。过程奖励模型（PRM）虽然提供了更密集的监督，但其分数可能与最终正确性不完全一致，甚至可能奖励看似流畅但最终错误的推理过程，导致奖励欺骗。
method: 提出 PROGRS 框架，该框架将过程奖励视为结果分组内的相对偏好，而非绝对奖励。通过引入“结果条件居中”机制，将错误轨迹的过程奖励分数在每个提示分组内进行零均值处理，以消除系统偏差并保留有用的排名信息。PROGRS 结合了一个固定的分位数回归 PRM 和一个多尺度连贯性评估器，并将由此产生的居中过程奖励整合到“组相对策略优化”（GRPO）中，无需额外的辅助目标或可训练组件。
results: 在 MATH-500、AMC、AIME、MinervaMath 和 OlympiadBench 等多个数学推理基准测试中，PROGRS 相比仅依赖结果的基线方法，在 Pass@1 指标上持续提高了性能，并且在更少的采样次数下取得了更强的表现。
conclusion: 结果表明，结果条件居中机制能够安全有效地利用过程奖励来提升数学推理能力。

title: UI-Oceanus: Scaling GUI Agents with Synthetic Environmental Dynamics
authors: Mengzhou Wu, Yuzhe Guo, Yuan Cao, Haochuan Lu, Songhe Zhu, Pingzhe Qu, Xin Chen, Kang Qin, Zhongpu Wang, Xiaode Zhang, Xinyi Wang, Wei Dai, Gang Cao, Yuetang Deng, Zhi Gong, Dezhi Ran, Linyi Li, Wei Yang, Tao Xie
abstract: Scaling generalist GUI agents is hindered by the data scalability bottleneck of expensive human demonstrations and the "distillation ceiling" of synthetic teacher supervision. To transcend these limitations, we propose UI-Oceanus, a framework that shifts the learning focus from mimicking high-level trajectories to mastering interaction physics via ground-truth environmental feedback. Through a systematic investigation of self-supervised objectives, we identify that forward dynamics, defined as the generative prediction of future interface states, acts as the primary driver for scalability and significantly outweighs inverse inference. UI-Oceanus leverages this insight by converting low-cost autonomous exploration, which is verified directly by system execution, into high-density generative supervision to construct a robust internal world model. Experimental evaluations across a series of models demonstrate the decisive superiority of our approach: models utilizing Continual Pre-Training (CPT) on synthetic dynamics outperform non-CPT baselines with an average success rate improvement of 7% on offline benchmarks, which amplifies to a 16.8% gain in real-world online navigation. Furthermore, we observe that navigation performance scales with synthetic data volume. These results confirm that grounding agents in forward predictive modeling offers a superior pathway to scalable GUI automation with robust cross-domain adaptability and compositional generalization.

title: Characterizing WebGPU Dispatch Overhead for LLM Inference Across Four GPU Vendors, Three Backends, and Three Browsers
authors: Jędrzej Maczan
abstract: WebGPU's security-focused design imposes per-operation validation that compounds across the many small dispatches in neural network inference, yet the true cost of this overhead is poorly characterized. We present a systematic characterization of WebGPU dispatch overhead for LLM inference at batch size 1, spanning four GPU vendors (NVIDIA, AMD, Apple, Intel), two native implementations (Dawn, wgpu-native) and three browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox), and two model sizes (Qwen2.5-0.5B and 1.5B). Our primary contribution is a sequential-dispatch methodology that reveals naive single-operation benchmarks overestimate dispatch cost by ${\sim}20\times$. The true per-dispatch cost of WebGPU API overhead alone is 24-36 $μ$s on Vulkan and 32-71 $μ$s on Metal, while the total per-operation overhead including Python cost is ${\sim}95$~$μ$s, which turns out to be a distinction critical for optimization. On Vulkan, kernel fusion improves throughput by 53%, while CUDA fusion provides no benefit, confirming that per-operation overhead is a primary differentiator. LLM inference was tested across three major operating systems (Linux, Windows, macOS). We built $\texttt{torch-webgpu}$, a PrivateUse1-based out-of-tree PyTorch backend and an FX-to-WebGPU compiler, which on our reference platform achieves 11--12% of CUDA performance. At dtype-matched float32, RTX PRO 2000 achieves 1.4$\times$ WebGPU's throughput despite ${\sim}6\times$ less compute than RTX 5090. For dispatch overhead, backend choice is the dominant factor, although implementation choice also matters substantially within a backend (2.2$\times$ for Metal). In terms of dispatch vs kernel compute efficiency, we conclude that at batch=1 with the current dispatch-heavy pipeline, per-operation overhead dominates regardless of kernel quality. All code, benchmarks, and raw data are open source.

title: FTimeXer: Frequency-aware Time-series Transformer with Exogenous variables for Robust Carbon Footprint Forecasting
authors: Qingzhong Li, Yue Hu, Zhou Long, Qingchang Ma, Hui Ma, Jinhai Sa
abstract: Accurate and up-to-date forecasting of the power grid's carbon footprint is crucial for effective product carbon footprint (PCF) accounting and informed decarbonization decisions. However, the carbon intensity of the grid exhibits high non-stationarity, and existing methods often struggle to effectively leverage periodic and oscillatory patterns. Furthermore, these methods tend to perform poorly when confronted with irregular exogenous inputs, such as missing data or misalignment. To tackle these challenges, we propose FTimeXer, a frequency-aware time-series Transformer designed with a robust training scheme that accommodates exogenous factors. FTimeXer features an Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)-driven frequency branch combined with gated time-frequency fusion, allowing it to capture multi-scale periodicity effectively. It also employs stochastic exogenous masking in conjunction with consistency regularization, which helps reduce spurious correlations and enhance stability. Experiments conducted on three real-world datasets show consistent improvements over strong baselines. As a result, these enhancements lead to more reliable forecasts of grid carbon factors, which are essential for effective PCF accounting and informed decision-making regarding decarbonization.

title: DrugPlayGround: Benchmarking Large Language Models and Embeddings for Drug Discovery
authors: Tianyu Liu, Sihan Jiang, Fan Zhang, Kunyang Sun, Teresa Head-Gordon, Hongyu Zhao
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are in the ascendancy for research in drug discovery, offering unprecedented opportunities to reshape drug research by accelerating hypothesis generation, optimizing candidate prioritization, and enabling more scalable and cost-effective drug discovery pipelines. However there is currently a lack of objective assessments of LLM performance to ascertain their advantages and limitations over traditional drug discovery platforms. To tackle this emergent problem, we have developed DrugPlayGround, a framework to evaluate and benchmark LLM performance for generating meaningful text-based descriptions of physiochemical drug characteristics, drug synergism, drug-protein interactions, and the physiological response to perturbations introduced by drug molecules. Moreover, DrugPlayGround is designed to work with domain experts to provide detailed explanations for justifying the predictions of LLMs, thereby testing LLMs for chemical and biological reasoning capabilities to push their greater use at the frontier of drug discovery at all of its stages.

title: OPRIDE: Offline Preference-based Reinforcement Learning via In-Dataset Exploration
authors: Yiqin Yang, Hao Hu, Yihuan Mao, Jin Zhang, Chengjie Wu, Yuhua Jiang, Xu Yang, Runpeng Xie, Yi Fan, Bo Liu, Yang Gao, Bo Xu, Chongjie Zhang
abstract: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) can help avoid sophisticated reward designs and align better with human intentions, showing great promise in various real-world applications. However, obtaining human feedback for preferences can be expensive and time-consuming, which forms a strong barrier for PbRL. In this work, we address the problem of low query efficiency in offline PbRL, pinpointing two primary reasons: inefficient exploration and overoptimization of learned reward functions. In response to these challenges, we propose a novel algorithm, \textbf{O}ffline \textbf{P}b\textbf{R}L via \textbf{I}n-\textbf{D}ataset \textbf{E}xploration (OPRIDE), designed to enhance the query efficiency of offline PbRL. OPRIDE consists of two key features: a principled exploration strategy that maximizes the informativeness of the queries and a discount scheduling mechanism aimed at mitigating overoptimization of the learned reward functions. Through empirical evaluations, we demonstrate that OPRIDE significantly outperforms prior methods, achieving strong performance with notably fewer queries. Moreover, we provide theoretical guarantees of the algorithm's efficiency. Experimental results across various locomotion, manipulation, and navigation tasks underscore the efficacy and versatility of our approach.

title: Contextual Intelligence The Next Leap for Reinforcement Learning
authors: André Biedenkapp
abstract:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has produced spectacular results in games, robotics, and continuous control. Yet, despite these successes, learned policies often fail to generalize beyond their training distribution, limiting real-world impact. Recent work on contextual RL (cRL) shows that exposing agents to environment characteristics -- contexts -- can improve zero-shot transfer. So far, the community has treated context as a monolithic, static observable, an approach that constrains the generalization capabilities of RL agents.
  To achieve contextual intelligence we first propose a novel taxonomy of contexts that separates allogenic (environment-imposed) from autogenic (agent-driven) factors. We identify three fundamental research directions that must be addressed to promote truly contextual intelligence: (1) Learning with heterogeneous contexts to explicitly exploit the taxonomy levels so agents can reason about their influence on the world and vice versa; (2) Multi-time-scale modeling to recognize that allogenic variables evolve slowly or remain static, whereas autogenic variables may change within an episode, potentially requiring different learning mechanisms; (3) Integration of abstract, high-level contexts to incorporate roles, resource & regulatory regimes, uncertainties, and other non-physical descriptors that crucially influence behavior.
  We envision context as a first-class modeling primitive, empowering agents to reason about who they are, what the world permits, and how both evolve over time. By doing so, we aim to catalyze a new generation of context-aware agents that can be deployed safely and efficiently in the real world.

title: Differentiable Symbolic Planning: A Neural Architecture for Constraint Reasoning with Learned Feasibility
authors: Venkatakrishna Reddy Oruganti
abstract: Neural networks excel at pattern recognition but struggle with constraint reasoning -- determining whether configurations satisfy logical or physical constraints. We introduce Differentiable Symbolic Planning (DSP), a neural architecture that performs discrete symbolic reasoning while remaining fully differentiable. DSP maintains a feasibility channel (phi) that tracks constraint satisfaction evidence at each node, aggregates this into a global feasibility signal (Phi) through learned rule-weighted combination, and uses sparsemax attention to achieve exact-zero discrete rule selection. We integrate DSP into a Universal Cognitive Kernel (UCK) that combines graph attention with iterative constraint propagation. Evaluated on three constraint reasoning benchmarks -- graph reachability, Boolean satisfiability, and planning feasibility -- UCK+DSP achieves 97.4% accuracy on planning under 4x size generalization (vs. 59.7% for ablated baselines), 96.4% on SAT under 2x generalization, and maintains balanced performance on both positive and negative classes where standard neural approaches collapse. Ablation studies reveal that global phi aggregation is critical: removing it causes accuracy to drop from 98% to 64%. The learned phi signal exhibits interpretable semantics, with values of +18 for feasible cases and -13 for infeasible cases emerging without supervision.

title: An Initial Exploration of Contrastive Prompt Tuning to Generate Energy-Efficient Code
authors: Sophie Weidmann, Fernando Castor
abstract: Although LLMs are capable of generating functionally correct code, they also tend to produce less energy-efficient code in comparison to human-written solutions. As these inefficiencies lead to higher computational overhead, they are in direct conflict with Green Software Development (GSD) efforts, which aim to reduce the energy consumption of code. To support these efforts, this study aims to investigate whether and how LLMs can be optimized to promote the generation of energy-efficient code. To this end, we employ Contrastive Prompt Tuning (CPT). CPT combines Contrastive Learning techniques, which help the model to distinguish between efficient and inefficient code, and Prompt Tuning, a Parameter-Efficient Fine Tuning (PEFT) approach that requires only a fraction of the cost of traditional fine tuning. This study evaluates CPT on Python, Java and C++ coding problems across three different models to provide a comprehensive evaluation. The method achieves consistent improvements in code accuracy for two models but efficiency gains vary by model, language and task complexity, indicating that improvements are not uniformly reliable.

title: Modeling and Controlling Deployment Reliability under Temporal Distribution Shift
authors: Naimur Rahman, Naazreen Tabassum
abstract:
Machine learning models deployed in non-stationary environments are exposed to temporal distribution shift, which can erode predictive reliability over time. While common mitigation strategies such as periodic retraining and recalibration aim to preserve performance, they typically focus on average metrics evaluated at isolated time points and do not explicitly model how reliability evolves during deployment.
  We propose a deployment-centric framework that treats reliability as a dynamic state composed of discrimination and calibration. The trajectory of this state across sequential evaluation windows induces a measurable notion of volatility, allowing deployment adaptation to be formulated as a multi-objective control problem that balances reliability stability against cumulative intervention cost.
  Within this framework, we define a family of state-dependent intervention policies and empirically characterize the resulting cost-volatility Pareto frontier. Experiments on a large-scale, temporally indexed credit-risk dataset (1.35M loans, 2007-2018) show that selective, drift-triggered interventions can achieve smoother reliability trajectories than continuous rolling retraining while substantially reducing operational cost.
  These findings position deployment reliability under temporal shift as a controllable multi-objective system and highlight the role of policy design in shaping stability-cost trade-offs in high-stakes tabular applications.

title: From Broad Exploration to Stable Synthesis: Entropy-Guided Optimization for Autoregressive Image Generation
authors: Han Song, Yucheng Zhou, Jianbing Shen, Yu Cheng
abstract: Combining Chain-of-Thought (CoT) with Reinforcement Learning (RL) improves text-to-image (T2I) generation, yet the underlying interaction between CoT's exploration and RL's optimization remains unclear. We present a systematic entropy-based analysis that yields three key insights: (1) CoT expands the generative exploration space, while RL contracts it toward high-reward regions; (2) final reward is strongly negatively correlated with both the mean and variance of image-token entropy, highlighting the need to reduce uncertainty and instability; and (3) the entropy of the textual CoT directly governs downstream image quality, with lower-entropy CoTs leading to better generations. Motivated by these findings, we propose Entropy-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (EG-GRPO), a fine-tuning strategy that reallocates optimization budget by uncertainty: low-entropy tokens are excluded from reward-driven updates to preserve stability, while high-entropy tokens receive an entropy bonus that encourages structured exploration without collapse. Experiments on standard T2I benchmarks demonstrate that EG-GRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance.

title: Prism: Policy Reuse via Interpretable Strategy Mapping in Reinforcement Learning
authors: Thomas Pravetz
abstract: We present PRISM (Policy Reuse via Interpretable Strategy Mapping), a framework that grounds reinforcement learning agents' decisions in discrete, causally validated concepts and uses those concepts as a zero-shot transfer interface between agents trained with different algorithms. PRISM clusters each agent's encoder features into $K$ concepts via K-means. Causal intervention establishes that these concepts directly drive - not merely correlate with - agent behavior: overriding concept assignments changes the selected action in 69.4% of interventions ($p = 8.6 \times 10^{-86}$, 2500 interventions). Concept importance and usage frequency are dissociated: the most-used concept (C47, 33.0% frequency) causes only a 9.4% win-rate drop when ablated, while ablating C16 (15.4% frequency) collapses win rate from 100% to 51.8%. Because concepts causally encode strategy, aligning them via optimal bipartite matching transfers strategic knowledge zero-shot. On Go~7$\times$7 with three independently trained agents, concept transfer achieves 69.5%$\pm$3.2% and 76.4%$\pm$3.4% win rate against a standard engine across the two successful transfer pairs (10 seeds), compared to 3.5% for a random agent and 9.2% without alignment. Transfer succeeds when the source policy is strong; geometric alignment quality predicts nothing ($R^2 \approx 0$). The framework is scoped to domains where strategic state is naturally discrete: the identical pipeline on Atari Breakout yields bottleneck policies at random-agent performance, confirming that the Go results reflect a structural property of the domain.

title: MLFCIL: A Multi-Level Forgetting Mitigation Framework for Federated Class-Incremental Learning in LEO Satellites
authors: Heng Zhang, Xiaohong Deng, Sijing Duan, Wu Ouyang, KM Mahfujul, Yiqin Deng, Zhigang Chen
abstract: Low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellite constellations are increasingly performing on-board computing. However, the continuous emergence of new classes under strict memory and communication constraints poses major challenges for collaborative training. Federated class-incremental learning (FCIL) enables distributed incremental learning without sharing raw data, but faces three LEO-specific challenges: non-independent and identically distributed data heterogeneity caused by orbital dynamics, amplified catastrophic forgetting during aggregation, and the need to balance stability and plasticity under limited resources. To tackle these challenges, we propose MLFCIL, a multi-level forgetting mitigation framework that decomposes catastrophic forgetting into three sources and addresses them at different levels: class-reweighted loss to reduce local bias, knowledge distillation with feature replay and prototype-guided drift compensation to preserve cross-task knowledge, and class-aware aggregation to mitigate forgetting during federation. In addition, we design a dual-granularity coordination strategy that combines round-level adaptive loss balancing with step-level gradient projection to further enhance the stability-plasticity trade-off. Experiments on the NWPU-RESISC45 dataset show that MLFCIL significantly outperforms baselines in both accuracy and forgetting mitigation, while introducing minimal resource overhead.

title: Dynamic Mask Enhanced Intelligent Multi-UAV Deployment for Urban Vehicular Networks
authors: Gaoxiang Cao, Wenke Yuan, Yunpeng Hou, Huasen He, Quan Zheng, Jian Yang
abstract: Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) play a crucial role in realizing vehicle-road collaboration and intelligent transportation. However, urban VANETs often face challenges such as frequent link disconnections and subnet fragmentation, which hinder reliable connectivity. To address these issues, we dynamically deploy multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) as communication relays to enhance VANET. A novel Score based Dynamic Action Mask enhanced QMIX algorithm (Q-SDAM) is proposed for multi-UAV deployment, which maximizes vehicle connectivity while minimizing multi-UAV energy consumption. Specifically, we design a score-based dynamic action mask mechanism to guide UAV agents in exploring large action spaces, accelerate the learning process and enhance optimization performance. The practicality of Q-SDAM is validated using real-world datasets. We show that Q-SDAM improves connectivity by 18.2% while reducing energy consumption by 66.6% compared with existing algorithms.

title: Fighting AI with AI: AI-Agent Augmented DNS Blocking of LLM Services during Student Evaluations
authors: Yonas Kassa, James Bonacci, Ping Wang
abstract: The transformative potential of large language models (LLMs) in education, such as improving accessibility and personalized learning, is being eclipsed by significant challenges. These challenges stem from concerns that LLMs undermine academic assessment by enabling bypassing of critical thinking, leading to increased cognitive offloading. This emerging trend stresses the dual imperative of harnessing AI's educational benefits while safeguarding critical thinking and academic rigor in the evolving AI ecosystem. To this end, we introduce AI-Sinkhole, an AI-agent augmented DNS-based framework that dynamically discovers, semantically classifies, and temporarily network-wide blocks emerging LLM chatbot services during proctored exams. AI-Sinkhole offers explainable classification via quantized LLMs (LLama 3, DeepSeek-R1, Qwen-3) and dynamic DNS blocking with Pi-Hole. We also share our observations in using LLMs as explainable classifiers which achieved robust cross-lingual performance (F1-score > 0.83). To support future research and development in this domain initial codes with a readily deployable 'AI-Sinkhole' blockist is available on https://github.com/AIMLEdu/ai-sinkhole.
