translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）经常表现出阿谀奉承行为：即使用户的立场与模型的观点冲突，模型也会表示赞同。虽然以往的研究大多在单智能体设置下探讨此问题，但在协作多智能体系统中的研究仍未充分展开。我们探讨了了解其他智能体的阿谀奉承水平是否会影响讨论结果。为了进行调查，我们使用六种开源LLM进行了受控实验，为智能体提供了同伴的阿谀奉承排名，以评估每个同伴的阿谀奉承倾向。这些排名基于使用各种静态（讨论前）和动态（在线）策略计算的得分。我们发现，提供阿谀奉承先验信息可以降低容易产生阿谀奉承的同伴的影响力，缓解错误级联，并将最终讨论的准确率提高了10.5%。因此，这是一种减少讨论中阿谀奉承并提高下游准确性的轻量且有效的方法。
tldr: 通过向多智能体系统提供同伴的“阿谀奉承”倾向排名，可显著减少盲目从众行为，提升协作讨论的准确性。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将“阿谀奉承”（Sycophancy）问题从单智能体扩展到多智能体协作场景，并提出了一种轻量级的防御机制。其局限性在于依赖于对智能体阿谀奉承倾向的预先评估，在缺乏此类评估数据或评估不准确的情况下效果可能受限。
motivation: 大语言模型在单智能体中表现出的“阿谀奉承”倾向（即为了迎合用户观点而放弃自身观点）在多智能体协作系统中如何传播及影响讨论结果，目前尚缺乏深入研究。
method: 在受控实验中，为六种开源大语言模型组成的协作系统提供同伴的“阿谀奉承排名”（基于静态和动态策略计算的评分），观察该先验信息如何影响讨论结果和决策准确性。
results: 研究表明，提供阿谀奉承倾向的先验信息能显著降低阿谀奉承型智能体的影响力，有效缓解错误级联现象，并将最终讨论的准确率提高了10.5%。
conclusion: 提供智能体阿谀奉承倾向的先验信息，是减轻多智能体系统中阿谀奉承现象、阻断错误级联并提升讨论准确性的有效且轻量的方法。

title: A Numerical Method for Coupling Parameterized Physics-Informed Neural Networks and FDM for Advanced Thermal-Hydraulic System Simulation
authors: Jeesuk Shin, Donggyun Seo, Sihyeong Yu, Joongoo Jeon
abstract: Severe accident analysis using system-level codes such as MELCOR is indispensable for nuclear safety assessment, yet the computational cost of repeated simulations poses a significant bottleneck for parametric studies and uncertainty quantification. Existing surrogate models accelerate these analyses but depend on large volumes of simulation data, while physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) enable data-free training but must be retrained for every change in problem parameters. This study addresses both limitations by developing the Parameterized PINNs coupled with FDM (P2F) method, a node-assigned hybrid framework for MELCOR's Control Volume Hydrodynamics/Flow Path (CVH/FP) module. In the P2F method, a parameterized Node-Assigned PINN (NA-PINN) accepts the water-level difference, initial velocity, and time as inputs, learning a solution manifold so that a single trained network serves as a data-free surrogate for the momentum conservation equation across all flow paths without retraining. This PINN is coupled with a finite difference method (FDM) solver that advances the mass conservation equation at each time step, ensuring exact discrete mass conservation while replacing the iterative nonlinear momentum solve with a single forward pass. Verification on a six-tank gravity-driven draining scenario yields a water level mean absolute error of $7.85 \times 10^{-5}$ m and a velocity mean absolute error of $3.21 \times 10^{-3}$ m/s under the nominal condition with $Δt = 1.0$ s. The framework maintains consistent accuracy across time steps ranging from 0.2 to 1.0 s and generalizes to five distinct initial conditions, all without retraining or simulation data. This work introduces a numerical coupling methodology for integrating parameterized PINNs with FDM within a nuclear thermal-hydraulic system code framework.
zh_title: 一种用于高级热工水力系统模拟的参数化物理信息神经网络与有限差分法耦合的数值方法
translation: 使用MELCOR等系统级代码进行严重事故分析对于核安全评估不可或缺，但重复模拟的计算成本是参数研究和不确定性量化的一个显著瓶颈。现有代理模型加速了这些分析，但依赖大量模拟数据，而物理信息神经网络（PINNs）能够进行无数据训练，但对于每个问题参数的变化都必须重新训练。本研究通过开发参数化PINN与FDM耦合（P2F）方法解决了这两个局限性，这是一种用于MELCOR的控制容积水动力学/流路（CVH/FP）模块的节点分配混合框架。在P2F方法中，一个参数化的节点分配PINN（NA-PINN）接受水位差、初始速度和时间作为输入，学习一个解流形，使得一个训练好的网络无需再训练即可作为所有流路动量守恒方程的无数据代理。该PINN与一个有限差分法（FDM）求解器耦合，FDM求解器在每个时间步推进质量守恒方程，确保精确的离散质量守恒，并用一次前向传播取代了迭代的非线性动量求解。在六罐重力驱动排水场景的验证中，在标称条件下（Δt = 1.0 s），水位平均绝对误差为7.85 × 10⁻⁵ m，速度平均绝对误差为3.21 × 10⁻³ m/s。该框架在0.2到1.0 s的时间步长范围内保持一致的精度，并且无需再训练或模拟数据即可推广到五种不同的初始条件。这项工作引入了一种数值耦合方法，用于在核热工水力系统代码框架内集成参数化PINN与FDM。
keywords: 参数化物理信息神经网络
tldr: 本研究开发了一种名为P2F的混合框架，将参数化物理信息神经网络（NA-PINN）与有限差分法（FDM）耦合，用于核热工水力系统模拟，解决了传统方法计算成本高和代理模型需要大量数据或反复训练的局限性，实现了无数据训练和无需再训练即可处理不同参数条件。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了参数化物理信息神经网络（PINNs）与有限差分法（FDM）的耦合方法（P2F），有效地解决了传统PINNs需要反复训练以及代理模型依赖大量数据的局限性。通过将PINN参数化并与FDM结合，实现了无数据训练、无需再训练即可处理不同参数条件，显著降低了核热工水力系统模拟的计算成本。这种混合框架在核安全评估等领域具有重要的应用潜力，为复杂系统模拟提供了一种高效且准确的新途径。
motivation: 核安全评估中使用的系统级代码（如MELCOR）在参数研究和不确定性量化中由于重复模拟的计算成本过高而成为瓶颈。现有代理模型虽然能加速分析，但依赖大量模拟数据；而物理信息神经网络（PINNs）虽然可以无数据训练，但对于每个参数变化都需要重新训练。本研究旨在解决这些局限性。
method: 本研究开发了参数化PINN与FDM耦合（P2F）方法，这是一种节点分配的混合框架，用于MELCOR的控制容积水动力学/流路（CVH/FP）模块。P2F方法中，一个参数化的节点分配PINN（NA-PINN）以水位差、初始速度和时间作为输入，学习一个解流形，使得一个训练好的网络无需再训练即可作为所有流路动量守恒方程的无数据代理。该PINN与一个有限差分法（FDM）求解器耦合，FDM求解器在每个时间步推进质量守恒方程，确保精确的离散质量守恒，并用一次前向传播取代了迭代的非线性动量求解。
results: 在六罐重力驱动排水场景的验证中，在标称条件下（Δt = 1.0 s），水位平均绝对误差为7.85 × 10⁻⁵ m，速度平均绝对误差为3.21 × 10⁻³ m/s。该框架在0.2到1.0 s的时间步长范围内保持一致的精度，并且无需再训练或模拟数据即可推广到五种不同的初始条件。
conclusion: 本研究引入了一种数值耦合方法，用于在核热工水力系统代码框架内集成参数化物理信息神经网络与有限差分法，有效解决了传统方法在计算成本和数据依赖性方面的挑战，实现了高效、准确且无需再训练的模拟。

title: AgentSZZ: Teaching the LLM Agent to Play Detective with Bug-Inducing Commits
authors: Yunbo Lyu, Jieke Shi, Hong Jin Kang, Ratnadira Widyasari, Junda He, Yuqing Niu, Chengran Yang, Junkai Chen, Zhou Yang, Julia Lawall, David Lo
abstract: The SZZ algorithm is the dominant technique for identifying bug-inducing commits and underpins many software engineering tasks, such as defect prediction and vulnerability analysis. Despite numerous variants, including recent LLM-based approaches, performance remains limited on developer-annotated datasets (e.g., recall of 0.552 on the Linux kernel). A key limitation is the reliance on git blame, which traces line-level changes within the same file, failing in common scenarios such as ghost and cross-file cases-making nearly one-quarter of bug-inducing commits inherently untraceable. Moreover, current approaches follow fixed pipelines that restrict iterative reasoning and exploration, unlike developers who investigate bugs through an interactive, multi-tool process. To address these challenges, we propose AgentSZZ, an agent-based framework that leverages LLM-driven agents to explore repositories and identify bug-inducing commits. Unlike prior methods, AgentSZZ integrates task-specific tools, domain knowledge, and a ReAct-style loop to enable adaptive and causal tracing of bugs. A structured compression module further improves efficiency by reducing redundant context while preserving key evidence. Extensive experiments on three widely used datasets show that AgentSZZ consistently outperforms state-of-the-art SZZ algorithms across all settings, achieving F1-score gains of up to 27.2% over prior LLM-based approaches. The improvements are especially pronounced in challenging scenarios such as cross-file and ghost commits, with recall gains of up to 300% and 60%, respectively. Ablation studies show that task-specific tools and domain knowledge are critical, while compression tool outputs reduce token consumption by over 30% with negligible impact. The replication package is available.
zh_title: AgentSZZ：教会大模型智能体像侦探一样通过Bug引入提交进行追踪
translation: SZZ算法是识别Bug引入提交的主流技术，支撑了缺陷预测和漏洞分析等许多软件工程任务。尽管存在众多变体，包括最近基于LLM的方法，但在开发者标注的数据集上性能仍然有限（例如在Linux内核上的召回率为0.552）。一个关键限制是对git blame的依赖，它只能追踪同一文件内的行级变化，而在Ghost提交和跨文件等常见场景中会失效，导致近四分之一的Bug引入提交本质上无法追踪。此外，当前方法遵循固定的流水线，限制了迭代推理和探索，这与开发者通过交互式、多工具流程调查Bug的方式不同。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AgentSZZ，这是一个基于智能体的框架，利用LLM驱动的智能体探索代码库并识别Bug引入提交。与之前的方法不同，AgentSZZ集成了任务专用工具、领域知识和ReAct风格的循环，以实现Bug的自适应和因果追踪。结构化压缩模块通过在保留关键证据的同时减少冗余上下文，进一步提高了效率。在三个广泛使用的数据集上的大量实验表明，AgentSZZ在所有设置下都持续优于最先进的SZZ算法，F1得分比之前基于LLM的方法提高了27.2%。这种改进在跨文件和Ghost提交等挑战性场景中尤为显著，召回率分别提高了300%和60%。消融研究表明，任务专用工具和领域知识至关重要，而压缩工具输出可减少超过30%的Token消耗，且影响微乎其微。复制包已提供。
tldr: AgentSZZ通过引入LLM智能体和ReAct推理循环，解决了传统SZZ算法难以追踪跨文件和Ghost Bug的难题，性能显著提升。
ai_comments: AgentSZZ通过引入大模型智能体，成功模拟了人类开发者的调试思维，打破了传统SZZ算法对git blame的过度依赖，在处理复杂Bug（如跨文件和Ghost提交）方面取得了显著突破，是软件工程领域将LLM智能体应用于因果追踪的优秀案例。
motivation: 传统SZZ算法高度依赖git blame，难以处理跨文件和Ghost提交等复杂场景，且缺乏像人类开发者那样的交互式迭代推理能力。
method: 提出AgentSZZ框架，利用ReAct循环机制，结合任务专用工具、领域知识以及结构化压缩模块，实现对代码库的自适应和因果路径追踪。
results: AgentSZZ在三个数据集上全面超越现有SOTA方法，F1-score最高提升27.2%，在跨文件和Ghost提交场景中召回率分别提升高达300%和60%，同时通过压缩模块降低了30%以上的Token消耗。
conclusion: AgentSZZ通过引入智能体框架、任务专用工具和结构化压缩，显著提升了识别Bug引入提交的准确性和效率，特别是在处理复杂Bug场景时表现优异。

title: Let's Have a Conversation: Designing and Evaluating LLM Agents for Interactive Optimization
authors: Joshua Drossman, Alexandre Jacquillat, Sébastien Martin
abstract: Optimization is as much about modeling the right problem as solving it. Identifying the right objectives, constraints, and trade-offs demands extensive interaction between researchers and stakeholders. Large language models can empower decision-makers with optimization capabilities through interactive optimization agents that can propose, interpret and refine solutions. However, it is fundamentally harder to evaluate a conversation-based interaction than traditional one-shot approaches. This paper proposes a scalable and replicable methodology for evaluating optimization agents through conversations. We build LLM-powered decision agents that role-play diverse stakeholders, each governed by an internal utility function but communicating like a real decision-maker. We generate thousands of conversations in a school scheduling case study. Results show that one-shot evaluation is severely limiting: the same optimization agent converges to much higher-quality solutions through conversations. Then, this paper uses this methodology to demonstrate that tailored optimization agents, endowed with domain-specific prompts and structured tools, can lead to significant improvements in solution quality in fewer interactions, as compared to general-purpose chatbots. These findings provide evidence of the benefits of emerging solutions at the AI-optimization interface to expand the reach of optimization technologies in practice. They also uncover the impact of operations research expertise to facilitate interactive deployments through the design of effective and reliable optimization agents.
zh_title: 让我们对话吧：交互式优化中LLM代理的设计与评估
translation: 优化不仅在于解决问题，更在于建模。识别正确的目标、约束和权衡需要研究者与利益相关者之间进行广泛的互动。大语言模型可以通过交互式优化代理赋予决策者优化能力，从而提出、解释和完善解决方案。然而，评估基于对话的交互比传统的“一键式”方法在根本上更难。本文提出了一种可扩展且可复制的方法，用于通过对话评估优化代理。我们构建了基于LLM的决策代理，它们扮演不同的利益相关者，每个代理都由内部效用函数管理，但像真实的决策者一样进行交流。我们在学校排课案例研究中生成了数千次对话。结果表明，一键式评估具有严重的局限性：同一个优化代理通过对话可以收敛到质量更高的解。此外，本文使用该方法论证明，与通用聊天机器人相比，配备领域特定提示和结构化工具的定制化优化代理可以在更少的交互中显著提高解的质量。这些发现为AI与优化接口处的新兴解决方案提供了证据，以扩大优化技术在实践中的应用范围。它们还揭示了运筹学专业知识对于通过设计有效且可靠的优化代理来促进交互式部署的影响。
tldr: 本文提出了一种评估交互式优化LLM代理的方法，证明了通过对话交互和领域定制，代理能显著提升复杂优化问题的求解质量。
ai_comments: 本文通过引入角色扮演的对话评估框架，填补了交互式优化领域中“评估难”的空白，强调了领域专业知识（Operations Research）在设计可靠优化代理中的关键作用，具有很高的实践价值。
motivation: 优化问题的核心在于建模，而建模过程需要研究者与利益相关者进行大量交互；传统的一键式（one-shot）评估方式无法衡量对话式交互的复杂性与动态性。
method: 提出了一种可扩展且可复制的对话式评估方法；构建了基于LLM的决策代理，通过内部效用函数驱动角色扮演；以学校排课为案例，进行了数千次模拟对话测试。
results: 实验表明，对话式交互比一键式评估更能提升优化解的质量；定制化（具有领域提示词和结构化工具）的优化代理比通用聊天机器人更高效且解的质量更高。
conclusion: 通过对话交互，优化代理能够显著提升解的质量，且经过领域定制的代理在效率和效果上均优于通用聊天机器人。

title: Redirected, Not Removed: Task-Dependent Stereotyping Reveals the Limits of LLM Alignments
authors: Divyanshu Kumar, Ishita Gupta, Nitin Aravind Birur, Tanay Baswa, Sahil Agarwal, Prashanth Harshangi
abstract: How biased is a language model? The answer depends on how you ask. A model that refuses to choose between castes for a leadership role will, in a fill-in-the-blank task, reliably associate upper castes with purity and lower castes with lack of hygiene. Single-task benchmarks miss this because they capture only one slice of a model's bias profile. We introduce a hierarchical taxonomy covering 9 bias types, including under-studied axes like caste, linguistic, and geographic bias, operationalized through 7 evaluation tasks that span explicit decision-making to implicit association. Auditing 7 commercial and open-weight LLMs with \textasciitilde45K prompts, we find three systematic patterns. First, bias is task-dependent: models counter stereotypes on explicit probes but reproduce them on implicit ones, with Stereotype Score divergences up to 0.43 between task types for the same model and identity groups. Second, safety alignment is asymmetric: models refuse to assign negative traits to marginalized groups, but freely associate positive traits with privileged ones. Third, under-studied bias axes show the strongest stereotyping across all models, suggesting alignment effort tracks benchmark coverage rather than harm severity. These results demonstrate that single-benchmark audits systematically mischaracterize LLM bias and that current alignment practices mask representational harm rather than mitigating it.
zh_title: 重定向而非移除：依赖任务的刻板印象揭示了LLM对齐的局限性
translation: 语言模型有多偏见？答案取决于你如何提问。一个拒绝在领导角色中选择种姓的模型，在填空任务中却会可靠地将高种姓与纯洁、低种姓与不卫生联系起来。单任务基准测试忽略了这一点，因为它们只捕获了模型偏见画像的一个切片。我们引入了一个涵盖9种偏见类型的层次分类法，包括种姓、语言和地理偏见等研究不足的维度，并通过跨越显性决策到隐性联想的7项评估任务进行操作化。在审计了7个商业和开源LLM并使用约4.5万个提示词后，我们发现了三个系统性模式。首先，偏见是任务依赖的：模型在显性探测中反抗刻板印象，但在隐性探测中却会重现，同一模型和身份组在不同任务类型间的刻板印象得分差异高达0.43。其次，安全对齐是不对称的：模型拒绝给边缘群体分配负面特征，但会自由地将正面特征与特权群体关联。第三，研究不足的偏见轴在所有模型中显示出最强的刻板印象，这表明对齐工作更多是追踪基准测试的覆盖范围，而非伤害的严重程度。这些结果证明，单基准测试审计系统性地误读了LLM的偏见，且当前的对齐实践掩盖了表征伤害，而非减轻了它。
tldr: 研究发现LLM的偏见会根据任务类型（显性 vs 隐性）发生转移，现有的对齐机制往往只是掩盖了偏见，而非真正消除了模型中的刻板印象。
ai_comments: 该研究深刻揭示了当前大模型对齐技术的局限性，即“顾此失彼”的现象。它挑战了单一基准测试评估模型的传统范式，强调了偏见评估需要多维度、多任务的综合视角。其核心贡献在于证明了当前的对齐只是将偏见从显性任务“重定向”到了隐性任务中，并未真正消除表征伤害。
motivation: 现有的单任务偏见基准测试往往无法全面捕捉模型的偏见特征，导致模型在某些任务中表现“安全”，但在其他任务中仍表现出明显的刻板印象。
method: 构建了一个涵盖9种偏见类型（包括种姓、语言、地理等）的层次分类法，并设计了7种从显性决策到隐性联想的任务，对7个主流LLM进行了约4.5万个提示词的审计。
results: 1. 偏见具有任务依赖性：模型在显性任务中抵制刻板印象，但在隐性任务中却会重现；2. 安全对齐具有不对称性：模型拒绝给边缘群体分配负面特征，但倾向于将正面特征与特权群体联系；3. 未被充分研究的偏见维度表现出最强的刻板印象，说明对齐努力更多是追随基准测试覆盖范围，而非伤害严重程度。
conclusion: 单一任务基准测试无法全面评估LLM的偏见，当前的对齐实践往往只是掩盖而非消除了偏见，导致了表征伤害在不同任务间的重定向。

title: Cross-subject Muscle Fatigue Detection via Adversarial and Supervised Contrastive Learning with Inception-Attention Network
authors: Zitao Lin, Chang Zhu, Wei Meng
abstract: Muscle fatigue detection plays an important role in physical rehabilitation. Previous researches have demonstrated that sEMG offers superior sensitivity in detecting muscle fatigue compared to other biological signals. However, features extracted from sEMG may vary during dynamic contractions and across different subjects, which causes unstability in fatigue detection. To address these challenges, this research proposes a novel neural network comprising an Inception-attention module as a feature extractor, a fatigue classifier and a domain classifier equipped with a gradient reversal layer. The integrated domain classifier encourages the network to learn subject-invariant common fatigue features while minimizing subject-specific features. Furthermore, a supervised contrastive loss function is also employed to enhance the generalization capability of the model. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model achieved outstanding performance in three-class classification tasks, reaching 93.54% accuracy, 92.69% recall and 92.69% F1-score, providing a robust solution for cross-subject muscle fatigue detection, offering significant guidance for rehabilitation training and assistance.
comment: This work has been submitted to ICARM 2026 for possible publication. 6 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables
zh_title: 基于对抗与监督对比学习及Inception-Attention网络的跨个体肌肉疲劳检测
translation: 肌肉疲劳检测在物理康复中起着重要作用。先前的研究表明，与其他生物信号相比，sEMG在检测肌肉疲劳方面具有更高的敏感性。然而，从sEMG中提取的特征在动态收缩过程中以及不同个体之间可能会发生变化，这导致了疲劳检测的不稳定性。为了应对这些挑战，本研究提出了一种新型神经网络，包含一个作为特征提取器的Inception-Attention模块、一个疲劳分类器以及一个配备了梯度反转层的领域分类器。集成的领域分类器鼓励网络在最小化特定个体特征的同时，学习与个体无关的通用疲劳特征。此外，还采用了一种监督对比损失函数来增强模型的泛化能力。实验结果表明，该模型在三分类任务中表现出色，准确率达到93.54%，召回率为92.69%，F1分数为92.69%，为跨个体肌肉疲劳检测提供了一种鲁棒的解决方案，并为康复训练和辅助提供了重要的指导。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的深度学习模型，通过对抗训练和监督对比学习提取通用疲劳特征，显著提升了肌电信号在跨个体肌肉疲劳检测中的准确率。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入对抗学习和监督对比学习，有效地解决了跨个体肌电信号（sEMG）特征分布不一致的问题，在提升模型泛化能力方面具有重要意义。Inception-Attention模块的设计能够有效提取多尺度特征，但模型在实际临床应用中的实时性及计算资源需求未作详细说明。
motivation: 针对现有基于sEMG的肌肉疲劳检测方法在动态收缩和不同个体间表现不稳定、特征差异大，难以实现有效的跨个体检测的问题。
method: 提出了一种新型神经网络，包含Inception-Attention模块作为特征提取器，并结合疲劳分类器和带有梯度反转层的领域分类器进行对抗训练，同时引入监督对比损失函数以增强模型泛化能力。
results: 在三分类任务中，模型达到了93.54%的准确率、92.69%的召回率和92.69%的F1分数，验证了其在跨个体疲劳检测中的鲁棒性和高效性。
conclusion: 该研究提出的基于对抗和监督对比学习的模型在跨个体肌电信号疲劳检测中表现优异，能有效提取主体无关的疲劳特征，为康复训练提供了鲁棒的监测方案。

title: Do Agent Societies Develop Intellectual Elites? The Hidden Power Laws of Collective Cognition in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Kavana Venkatesh, Jiaming Cui
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed as interacting agent societies, yet scaling these systems often yields diminishing or unstable returns, the causes of which remain poorly understood. We present the first large-scale empirical study of coordination dynamics in LLM-based multi-agent systems, introducing an atomic event-level formulation that reconstructs reasoning as cascades of coordination. Analyzing over 1.5 Million interactions across tasks, topologies, and scales, we uncover three coupled laws: coordination follows heavy-tailed cascades, concentrates via preferential attachment into intellectual elites, and produces increasingly frequent extreme events as system size grows. We show that these effects are coupled through a single structural mechanism: an integration bottleneck, in which coordination expansion scales with system size while consolidation does not, producing large but weakly integrated reasoning processes. To test this mechanism, we introduce Deficit-Triggered Integration (DTI), which selectively increases integration under imbalance. DTI improves performance precisely where coordination fails, without suppressing large-scale reasoning. Together, our results establish quantitative laws of collective cognition and identify coordination structure as a fundamental, previously unmeasured axis for understanding and improving scalable multi-agent intelligence.
zh_title: 代理社会是否会产生智力精英？LLM多智能体系统中集体认知的隐藏幂律
translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统正日益作为交互式智能体社会被部署，然而这些系统的扩展往往导致收益递减或不稳定，其原因尚不明确。我们提出了首个针对基于LLM的多智能体系统协作动力学的大规模实证研究，引入了一种将推理重构为协作级联的原子事件级公式。通过对跨任务、拓扑和规模的150万次交互进行分析，我们发现了三条耦合定律：协作遵循重尾级联，通过优先依附集中形成“智力精英”，且随着系统规模增长，频繁产生极端事件。我们证明这些效应通过单一结构机制耦合，即“集成瓶颈”：协作扩展随系统规模而扩展，但整合能力却不随之增加，从而产生了庞大但整合度较弱的推理过程。为了验证这一机制，我们引入了缺陷触发集成（DTI），它能在失衡时选择性地增加整合。DTI在协作失败处精确提升了性能，且未抑制大规模推理。总之，我们的结果建立了集体认知的定量定律，并将协作结构确定为理解和改进可扩展多智能体智能的一个基本的、此前未被测量的维度。
tldr: LLM多智能体系统存在协作集成瓶颈，导致性能不稳定；通过DTI机制调节集成度可实现更高效的协作。
ai_comments: 该研究通过大规模实证分析揭示了LLM多智能体系统中的“幂律”现象，不仅挑战了单纯增加智能体数量就能提升性能的直觉，还提出了通过优化协作结构来解决瓶颈的新思路，对于构建可扩展的协作AI系统具有重要指导意义。
motivation: LLM多智能体系统在扩展时常出现收益递减或不稳定的现象，其背后的深层动力学机制尚不明确，亟需对其协作结构进行量化研究。
method: 提出了一种原子级事件公式，对150万次交互进行大规模实证分析，并开发了“缺陷触发集成”（DTI）机制，通过在失衡时选择性增加集成度来优化协作。
results: 发现了三条耦合定律：协作呈重尾级联分布、通过优先依附形成“智力精英”、系统规模越大极端事件越频繁。核心原因是“集成瓶颈”导致协作扩张与整合能力不匹配。DTI机制成功提升了系统性能。
conclusion: 协作系统的扩展受制于集成瓶颈，导致形成“智力精英”与松散的推理过程。通过DTI机制缓解集成失衡，可有效提升大规模多智能体系统的性能。

title: A Logic of Secrecy on Simplicial Models
authors: Shanxia Wang
abstract:
We develop a logic of secrecy on simplicial models for multi-agent systems. Standard simplicial models provide a geometric semantics for knowledge by representing global states as facets of a chromatic simplicial complex and agents' local states as coloured vertices. However, secrecy cannot in general be captured as a genuinely new modality by relying on the ordinary simplicial knowledge structure alone. This motivates the introduction of an additional secrecy layer.
  To this end, we define \emph{simplicial secrecy models}, which enrich standard simplicial epistemic models with agent-relative secrecy neighborhood functions attached to local states. On this basis, we introduce a primitive secrecy operator $S_a\varphi$. Semantically, $S_a\varphi$ holds when agent $a$ knows $\varphi$ in the ordinary simplicial sense and, moreover, the truth set of $\varphi$ belongs to one of the designated secrecy neighborhoods associated with $a$'s current local state. The clause for secrecy thus combines an ordinary knowledge requirement with an additional local-state-based neighborhood requirement, while the frame condition ensures that designated secrecy events remain non-trivial from the perspective of every other agent.
  We formulate a system $\mathsf{SSL}$ for the resulting language and show that it is sound with respect to the class of simplicial secrecy models. For the genuinely multi-agent case $|A|\ge 2$, we prove completeness by first constructing an auxiliary-colour canonical model and then representing it inside the original class of pure $A$-chromatic simplicial secrecy models. The resulting framework yields a primitive, local-state-based, and geometrically grounded account of secrecy on simplicial models, together with a sound axiomatization and, in the genuinely multi-agent case, a complete one.
comment: This is a preliminary draft. Comments and suggestions are very welcome
zh_title: 单纯模型上的保密逻辑
translation: 我们为多智能体系统开发了一种单纯模型上的保密逻辑。标准的单纯模型通过将全局状态表示为色单纯复形的切面，将智能体的局部状态表示为着色顶点，从而为知识提供了几何语义。然而，仅依靠普通的单纯知识结构，通常无法将保密性作为一种真正的新模态来捕捉。这促使我们引入了一个额外的保密层。为此，我们定义了“单纯保密模型”，通过在局部状态上附加智能体相关的保密邻域函数来丰富标准的单纯认知模型。在此基础上，我们引入了一个原始保密算子 $S_a\varphi$。从语义上讲，$S_a\varphi$ 在智能体 $a$ 以普通单纯意义知道 $\varphi$，且 $\varphi$ 的真值集属于与 $a$ 当前局部状态相关联的指定保密邻域之一时成立。因此，保密性条款结合了普通知识要求和额外的基于局部状态的邻域要求，而框架条件确保了指定的保密事件从每个其他智能体的角度来看保持非平凡性。我们为所得语言制定了一个系统 $\mathsf{SSL}$，并证明了它对于单纯保密模型类是可靠的。对于真正的多智能体情况（|A|≥2），我们通过首先构建辅助颜色规范模型，然后将其表示在纯 A-色单纯保密模型的原始类中，证明了其完备性。所得框架在单纯模型上提供了一种原始的、基于局部状态的、几何扎实的保密说明，并具有可靠的公理化，在多智能体情况下还具有完备的公理化。
tldr: 该研究通过在单纯复形模型中增加保密邻域，为多智能体系统提供了一种既具有几何基础又具备完整公理化系统的保密逻辑。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入“保密邻域函数”将保密性（Secrecy）这一概念成功集成到单纯复形模型（Simplicial Models）中，为多智能体系统中的信息隐藏提供了几何语义解释，弥补了传统知识逻辑在表达保密性方面的不足。其理论贡献在于成功构建并证明了系统的可靠性和完备性。
motivation: 标准的单纯复形模型虽然能够很好地表示智能体的知识，但无法直接将“保密性”作为一种独立的模态进行建模，因此需要引入额外的保密层来增强其表达能力。
method: 定义单纯保密模型（Simplicial Secrecy Models），通过在局部状态上附加智能体相关的保密邻域函数（secrecy neighborhood functions），并引入原始保密算子 $S_a\varphi$。通过构造辅助颜色规范模型并将其嵌入纯A-色单纯保密模型类中，证明了系统的完备性。
results: 提出了逻辑系统SSL，证明了其对于单纯保密模型类的可靠性（Soundness）；对于多智能体情况（|A|≥2），证明了该系统的完备性（Completeness）。
conclusion: 本文通过构建单纯保密模型（Simplicial Secrecy Models）及对应的逻辑系统SSL，成功地将保密性这一概念引入多智能体系统的几何语义框架中，为处理多智能体交互中的保密问题提供了一种严谨的逻辑与几何工具。

title: Beyond the AI Tutor: Social Learning with LLM Agents
authors: Harsh Kumar, Zi Kang, Jonathan Vincentius, Ashton Anderson
abstract: Most AI-based educational tools today adopt a one-on-one tutoring paradigm, pairing a single LLM with a single learner. Yet decades of learning science research suggest that multi-party interaction -- through peer modeling, co-construction, and exposure to diverse perspectives -- can produce learning benefits that dyadic tutoring alone cannot. In this paper, we investigate whether multi-agent LLM configurations can enhance learning outcomes beyond what a single LLM tutor provides. We present two controlled experiments spanning distinct learning contexts. In a convergent problem-solving study ($N=315$), participants tackle SAT-level math problems in a 2$\times$2 design that varies the presence of an LLM tutor and LLM peers, each making different kinds of errors (conceptual vs.\ arithmetic); participants who interacted with both a tutor and peers achieved the highest unassisted test accuracy. In a divergent composition study ($N=247$), participants write argumentative and creative essays with either no AI assistance, a single LLM (Claude or ChatGPT), or both Claude and ChatGPT together; while both LLM conditions improved essay quality, only the two-agent condition avoided the idea-level homogeneity that single-model assistance was found to produce. Together, these studies offer one of the first controlled investigations of multi-agent LLM learning environments, probing whether the move from one-on-one AI tutoring toward richer agent configurations can unlock the collaborative and observational benefits long documented in human social learning research.
zh_title: 超越AI导师：基于大语言模型智能体的社会化学习
translation: 当今大多数基于人工智能的教育工具都采用一对一的辅导范式，即一个大语言模型（LLM）对应一个学习者。然而，数十年的学习科学研究表明，通过同伴建模、共同构建和接触多样化观点，多方互动可以产生单纯的一对一辅导所无法带来的学习收益。在本文中，我们研究了多智能体LLM配置是否能增强学习成果，使其超越单一LLM导师所能提供的效果。我们展示了两个跨越不同学习情境的受控实验。在一项收敛性问题解决研究（N=315）中，参与者在2x2设计的实验中解决SAT水平的数学问题，该设计改变了LLM导师和LLM同伴的存在情况，每个同伴会犯不同类型的错误（概念性错误与算术错误）；与导师和同伴互动的参与者在未受辅助的测试中获得了最高的准确率。在一项发散性写作研究（N=247）中，参与者在没有AI辅助、单一LLM（Claude或ChatGPT）或两者结合的情况下撰写论证性和创造性文章；虽然两种LLM条件都提高了文章质量，但只有双智能体条件避免了单模型辅助所产生的观点层面的同质化。总之，这些研究为多智能体LLM学习环境提供了首批受控调查之一，探讨了从一对一AI辅导向更丰富的智能体配置的转变是否能解锁人类社会学习研究中长期记录的协作和观察优势。
tldr: 研究证实，引入多智能体（如LLM导师+LLM同伴）的社交学习环境，比单一AI导师更能提升学习者的表现并促进思维多样性。
ai_comments: 该研究通过将教育科学中的社会学习理论应用于AI领域，打破了传统的“一对一”辅导范式，具有很高的创新性。研究不仅关注学习效果的提升，还揭示了单模型可能导致的同质化问题，为未来构建更多元、更具协作性的AI教育系统提供了实证依据。
motivation: 现有的AI教育工具大多基于“一对一”辅导范式，忽略了学习科学中强调的同伴建模、共建和多元视角等社会学习优势。因此，作者旨在探索多智能体LLM配置是否能超越单一AI导师，提升学习效果。
method: 通过两个受控实验进行研究：1. 在收敛性问题解决研究（N=315）中，采用2x2设计，对比LLM导师与LLM同伴（分别犯不同错误）的组合效果；2. 在发散性写作研究（N=247）中，对比无AI、单模型（Claude或ChatGPT）与双模型协作对作文质量及创意多样性的影响。
results: 1. 在数学问题解决中，同时与导师和同伴互动的参与者获得了最高的独立测试准确率；2. 在写作任务中，双模型协作不仅提升了作文质量，还避免了单模型辅助常见的观点同质化问题。
conclusion: 研究表明，引入多智能体（LLM peers）的学习环境能够通过提供多样化的视角和协作体验，显著提升学习者的解决问题能力，并有效缓解单模型辅导带来的思维同质化问题。

title: Beyond Semantic Manipulation: Token-Space Attacks on Reward Models
authors: Yuheng Zhang, Mingyue Huo, Minghao Zhu, Mengxue Zhang, Nan Jiang
abstract: Reward models (RMs) are widely used as optimization targets in reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), yet they remain vulnerable to reward hacking. Existing attacks mainly operate within the semantic space, constructing human-readable adversarial outputs that exploit RM biases. In this work, we introduce a fundamentally different paradigm: Token Mapping Perturbation Attack (TOMPA), a framework that performs adversarial optimization directly in token space. By bypassing the standard decode-re-tokenize interface between the policy and the reward model, TOMPA enables the attack policy to optimize over raw token sequences rather than coherent natural language. Using only black-box scalar feedback, TOMPA automatically discovers non-linguistic token patterns that elicit extremely high rewards across multiple state-of-the-art RMs. Specifically, when targeting Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B, TOMPA nearly doubles the reward of GPT-5 reference answers and outperforms them on 98.0% of prompts. Despite these high scores, the generated outputs degenerate into nonsensical text, revealing that RMs can be systematically exploited beyond the semantic regime and exposing a critical vulnerability in current RLHF pipelines.
zh_title: 超越语义操纵：针对奖励模型的Token空间攻击
translation: 奖励模型（RM）被广泛用作人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）中的优化目标，但它们仍然容易受到奖励黑客攻击。现有的攻击主要在语义空间内操作，构建可读的对抗性输出来利用RM的偏差。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种根本不同的范式：Token映射扰动攻击（TOMPA），这是一个直接在Token空间进行对抗性优化的框架。通过绕过策略模型和奖励模型之间的标准解码-重分词接口，TOMPA使得攻击策略能够优化原始Token序列，而不是连贯的自然语言。仅使用黑盒标量反馈，TOMPA自动发现了在多个最先进的RM上引发极高奖励的非语言Token模式。具体而言，当针对Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B时，TOMPA获得的奖励几乎是GPT-5参考答案的两倍，并且在98.0%的提示词上表现优于它们。尽管分数很高，但生成的输出退化为无意义的文本，这表明RM可以在语义范畴之外被系统性地利用，并暴露了当前RLHF流水线中的一个关键漏洞。
tldr: TOMPA攻击通过直接优化Token序列而非语义文本，成功诱导奖励模型给出极高评分，揭示了奖励模型在非语义层面的严重脆弱性。
ai_comments: 该研究揭示了奖励模型（RM）不仅在语义层面存在缺陷，在底层Token表示空间也存在严重的安全隐患。TOMPA攻击框架通过绕过语义约束，证明了奖励模型对非自然语言模式的过度拟合，这对当前强化学习（RLHF）流水线的鲁棒性提出了严峻挑战。
motivation: 现有的奖励模型攻击主要局限于语义空间，忽略了奖励模型在底层Token表示空间可能存在的漏洞，需要一种能够绕过语义约束的攻击方法来全面评估奖励模型的鲁棒性。
method: 提出了Token映射扰动攻击（TOMPA）框架，该方法直接在Token空间进行对抗性优化，绕过了策略模型与奖励模型之间的解码-重分词接口，仅利用黑盒标量反馈发现能诱导高奖励的非语言Token模式。
results: TOMPA成功发现了能诱导极高奖励的非自然语言Token模式。在针对Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B的测试中，该方法生成的输出奖励几乎是GPT-5参考答案的两倍，并在98.0%的提示词上表现更优，尽管这些输出在语义上是无意义的乱码。
conclusion: 奖励模型在Token空间存在根本性的脆弱性，能够被非语义的Token模式系统性地攻击，这表明现有的RLHF训练方法在防御此类攻击方面存在盲区。

title: Inverse Safety Filtering: Inferring Constraints from Safety Filters for Decentralized Coordination
authors: Minh Nguyen, Jingqi Li, Gechen Qu, Claire J. Tomlin
abstract: Safe multi-agent coordination in uncertain environments can benefit from learning constraints from other agents. Implicitly communicating safety constraints through actions is a promising approach, allowing agents to coordinate and maintain safety without expensive communication channels. This paper introduces an online method to infer constraints from observing the safety-filtered actions of other agents. We approach the problem by using safety filters to ensure forward safety and exploit their structure to work backwards and infer constraints. We provide sufficient conditions under which we can infer these constraints and prove that our inference method converges. This constraint inference procedure is coupled with a decentralized planning method that ensures safety when the constraint activation distance is sufficiently large. We then empirically validate our method with Monte Carlo simulations and hardware experiments with quadruped robots.
zh_title: 逆安全滤波：从安全滤波器中推断约束以实现去中心化协作
translation: 在不确定环境中，安全的多智能体协作可以通过从其他智能体学习约束来获益。通过动作隐式传达安全约束是一种有前景的方法，它允许智能体在没有昂贵通信渠道的情况下进行协作并保持安全。本文介绍了一种在线方法，通过观察其他智能体的安全滤波动作来推断约束。我们通过使用安全滤波器来确保前向安全，并利用其结构进行反向推导以推断约束。我们提供了推断这些约束的充分条件，并证明了我们的推断方法是收敛的。该约束推断过程与一种去中心化规划方法相结合，当约束激活距离足够大时，可以确保安全性。我们通过蒙特卡洛仿真和四足机器人的硬件实验对我们的方法进行了实证验证。
tldr: 通过观察智能体动作反推其安全约束，实现无需通信的去中心化安全协作。
ai_comments: 该研究通过反向工程安全滤波器来推断约束，为多智能体系统提供了一种无需显式通信的协作新思路，具有很高的实用价值。局限性在于该方法对约束激活距离有一定要求，且在复杂动态环境下的鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 在不依赖昂贵通信渠道的情况下，通过观察其他智能体的行为来隐式推断安全约束，以实现不确定环境下的安全多智能体协作。
method: 提出了一种在线推断方法，利用安全滤波器的结构进行反向推导以获取约束；结合了去中心化规划方法，在满足一定条件时确保系统安全。
results: 提供了推断约束的充分条件并证明了推断方法的收敛性；通过蒙特卡洛仿真和四足机器人硬件实验验证了该方法的有效性。
conclusion: 该论文提出的逆安全滤波方法能够有效地从观察到的智能体行为中推断出安全约束，并通过去中心化规划实现协作，在仿真和四足机器人硬件实验中得到了验证。

title: MBGR: Multi-Business Prediction for Generative Recommendation at Meituan
authors: Changhao Li, Junwei Yin, Zhilin Zeng, Senjie Kou, Shuli Wang, Wenshuai Chen, Yinhua Zhu, Haitao Wang, Xingxing Wang
abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for industrial recommendations. GR leverages Semantic IDs (SIDs) to reduce the encoding-decoding space and employs the Next Token Prediction (NTP) framework to explore scaling laws. However, existing GR methods suffer from two critical issues: (1) a \textbf{seesaw phenomenon} in multi-business scenarios arises due to NTP's inability to capture complex cross-business behavioral patterns; and (2) a unified SID space causes \textbf{representation confusion} by failing to distinguish distinct semantic information across businesses. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Business Generative Recommendation (MBGR), the first GR framework tailored for multi-business scenarios. Our framework comprises three key components. First, we design a Business-aware semantic ID (BID) module that preserves semantic integrity via domain-aware tokenization. Then, we introduce a Multi-Business Prediction (MBP) structure to provide business-specific prediction capabilities. Furthermore, we develop a Label Dynamic Routing (LDR) module that transforms sparse multi-business labels into dense labels to further enhance the multi-business generation capability. Extensive offline and online experiments on Meituan's food delivery platform validate MBGR's effectiveness, and we have successfully deployed it in production.
zh_title: MBGR：美团多业务生成式推荐预测
translation: 生成式推荐（GR）最近已成为工业推荐领域的一种前景广阔的范式。GR利用语义ID（SIDs）来减少编码-解码空间，并采用下一个Token预测（NTP）框架来探索缩放定律。然而，现有的GR方法存在两个关键问题：（1）由于NTP无法捕捉复杂的跨业务行为模式，在多业务场景中会出现“跷跷板现象”；（2）统一的SID空间由于无法区分跨业务的不同语义信息，导致“表征混淆”。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了多业务生成式推荐（MBGR），这是第一个为多业务场景量身定制的GR框架。我们的框架包含三个关键组件。首先，我们设计了一个业务感知语义ID（BID）模块，通过领域感知分词来保持语义完整性。然后，我们引入了一个多业务预测（MBP）结构，以提供特定于业务的预测能力。此外，我们开发了一个标签动态路由（LDR）模块，将稀疏的多业务标签转换为稠密标签，以进一步增强多业务生成能力。在美团外卖平台上进行的大量离线和在线实验验证了MBGR的有效性，并且我们已将其成功部署到生产环境中。
tldr: 针对生成式推荐在多业务场景下的失效问题，本文提出了MBGR框架，通过引入业务感知ID、多业务预测结构和动态标签路由，显著提升了跨业务推荐效果并已在美团落地。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将生成式推荐（GR）应用于多业务场景，解决了跨业务行为模式捕捉困难和表征混淆等实际工程问题，具有很高的工业落地价值。其局限性在于该方法高度依赖美团特定的业务架构，通用性有待进一步验证。
motivation: 现有生成式推荐方法在多业务场景下存在“跷跷板现象”（难以捕捉跨业务行为）和“表征混淆”（统一语义ID空间导致语义区分度差）的问题。
method: 提出了MBGR框架，包含三个模块：1. BID（业务感知语义ID）模块：通过领域感知分词保持语义完整性；2. MBP（多业务预测）结构：提供针对具体业务的预测能力；3. LDR（标签动态路由）模块：将稀疏的多业务标签转化为稠密标签以增强生成能力。
results: 在美团外卖平台的离线和在线实验中验证了MBGR的有效性，并已成功部署至生产环境。
conclusion: MBGR通过BID、MBP和LDR三个核心模块，有效解决了多业务生成式推荐中的跷跷板效应和表征混淆问题，并在美团生产环境中取得了显著效果。

title: Finding Belief Geometries with Sparse Autoencoders
authors: Matthew Levinson
abstract:
Understanding the geometric structure of internal representations is a central goal of mechanistic interpretability. Prior work has shown that transformers trained on sequences generated by hidden Markov models encode probabilistic belief states as simplex-shaped geometries in their residual stream, with vertices corresponding to latent generative states. Whether large language models trained on naturalistic text develop analogous geometric representations remains an open question.
  We introduce a pipeline for discovering candidate simplex-structured subspaces in transformer representations, combining sparse autoencoders (SAEs), $k$-subspace clustering of SAE features, and simplex fitting using AANet. We validate the pipeline on a transformer trained on a multipartite hidden Markov model with known belief-state geometry. Applied to Gemma-2-9B, we identify 13 priority clusters exhibiting candidate simplex geometry ($K \geq 3$).
  A key challenge is distinguishing genuine belief-state encoding from tiling artifacts: latents can span a simplex-shaped subspace without the mixture coordinates carrying predictive signal beyond any individual feature. We therefore adopt barycentric prediction as our primary discriminating test. Among the 13 priority clusters, 3 exhibit a highly significant advantage on near-vertex samples (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-14}$) and 4 on simplex-interior samples. Together 5 distinct real clusters pass at least one split, while no null cluster passes either. One cluster, 768_596, additionally achieves the highest causal steering score in the dataset. This is the only case where passive prediction and active intervention converge. We present these findings as preliminary evidence that genuine belief-like geometry exists in Gemma-2-9B's representation space, and identify the structured evaluation that would be required to confirm this interpretation.
zh_title: 利用稀疏自编码器发现信仰几何结构
translation: 理解内部表征的几何结构是机械可解释性的核心目标。既往研究表明，在由隐马尔可夫模型生成的序列上训练的转换器，会在其残差流中将概率信仰状态编码为单纯形几何结构，其中顶点对应于潜在的生成状态。在自然语言文本上训练的大型语言模型是否会发展出类似的几何表征仍是一个未决问题。我们引入了一种发现转换器表征中候选单纯形结构子空间的流程，结合了稀疏自编码器（SAE）、SAE特征的k-子空间聚类以及使用AANet进行的单纯形拟合。我们在一个在已知信仰状态几何的复合隐马尔可夫模型上训练的转换器上验证了该流程。应用于Gemma-2-9B时，我们识别出13个表现出候选单纯形几何（K ≥ 3）的优先簇。一个关键挑战是区分真实的信仰状态编码与平铺伪影：潜在变量可以在不携带超出任何单个特征的预测信号的情况下跨越单纯形形状的子空间。因此，我们采用重心预测作为我们的主要判别测试。在13个优先簇中，3个在近顶点样本上表现出高度显著的优势（Wilcoxon p < 10^-14），4个在单纯形内部样本上表现出显著优势。总共有5个不同的真实簇通过了至少一项测试，而没有任何无效簇通过。其中一个簇（768_596）在数据集中取得了最高的因果转向得分。这是被动预测与主动干预收敛的唯一案例。我们将这些发现作为Gemma-2-9B表征空间中存在真实类信仰几何的初步证据，并确定了确认这种解释所需的结构化评估方法。
tldr: 通过稀疏自编码器和单纯形拟合，研究在Gemma-2-9B模型中发现了类似概率信仰状态的几何表征，并证明了其在预测和因果干预任务中的有效性。
ai_comments: 该研究为理解大型语言模型（LLM）的内部工作机制提供了新的几何视角。通过结合稀疏自编码器（SAE）与单纯形拟合技术，作者不仅展示了探测模型内部信仰状态表征的方法论，还通过严格的重心预测测试区分了真实的认知表征与简单的稀疏特征平铺，这在机械可解释性研究中具有重要的方法论意义。
motivation: 旨在探究大型语言模型是否像在简单的隐马尔可夫模型上训练的转换器一样，在内部表征中形成类似于概率信仰状态的单纯形几何结构。
method: 提出了一种综合方法：利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取特征，通过k-子空间聚类进行分组，并使用AANet进行单纯形拟合；最后采用重心预测（barycentric prediction）作为区分真实信仰表征与伪影的关键测试。
results: 在Gemma-2-9B中识别出13个候选单纯形簇，其中5个簇通过了严格的重心预测测试，且其中一个簇在因果干预实验中表现出显著的相关性。
conclusion: 研究为Gemma-2-9B模型中存在类信仰几何结构提供了初步证据，并提出了一套验证此类表征的严格实验流程。

title: Efficient3D: A Unified Framework for Adaptive and Debiased Token Reduction in 3D MLLMs
authors: Yuhui Lin, Siyue Yu, Yuxing Yang, Guangliang Cheng, Jimin Xiao
abstract: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have expanded reasoning capabilities into 3D domains, enabling fine-grained spatial understanding. However, the substantial size of 3D MLLMs and the high dimensionality of input features introduce considerable inference overhead, which limits practical deployment on resource constrained platforms. To overcome this limitation, this paper presents Efficient3D, a unified framework for visual token pruning that accelerates 3D MLLMs while maintaining competitive accuracy. The proposed framework introduces a Debiased Visual Token Importance Estimator (DVTIE) module, which considers the influence of shallow initial layers during attention aggregation, thereby producing more reliable importance predictions for visual tokens. In addition, an Adaptive Token Rebalancing (ATR) strategy is developed to dynamically adjust pruning strength based on scene complexity, preserving semantic completeness and maintaining balanced attention across layers. Together, they enable context-aware token reduction that maintains essential semantics with lower computation. Comprehensive experiments conducted on five representative 3D vision and language benchmarks, including ScanRefer, Multi3DRefer, Scan2Cap, ScanQA, and SQA3D, demonstrate that Efficient3D achieves superior performance compared with unpruned baselines, with a +2.57% CIDEr improvement on the Scan2Cap dataset. Therefore, Efficient3D provides a scalable and effective solution for efficient inference in 3D MLLMs. The code is released at: https://github.com/sol924/Efficient3D
zh_title: Efficient3D：一种用于3D多模态大模型自适应和去偏Token剪枝的统一框架
translation: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）的最新进展已将其推理能力扩展到3D领域，实现了细粒度的空间理解。然而，3D MLLMs的巨大规模和输入特征的高维度带来了巨大的推理开销，限制了其在资源受限平台上的实际部署。为了克服这一限制，本文提出了Efficient3D，一个用于视觉Token剪枝的统一框架，在保持竞争性精度的同时加速3D MLLMs。所提出的框架引入了去偏视觉Token重要性估计器（DVTIE）模块，该模块在注意力聚合过程中考虑了浅层初始层的影响，从而为视觉Token产生更可靠的重要性预测。此外，开发了一种自适应Token重平衡（ATR）策略，根据场景复杂度动态调整剪枝强度，以保持语义完整性并维持层间注意力的平衡。这些共同实现了上下文感知的Token缩减，在降低计算量的同时保持了必要的语义。在包括ScanRefer、Multi3DRefer、Scan2Cap、ScanQA和SQA3D在内的五个代表性3D视觉与语言基准测试上进行的全面实验表明，Efficient3D与未剪枝的基线相比表现出卓越的性能，在Scan2Cap数据集上CIDEr提高了+2.57%。因此，Efficient3D为3D MLLMs的高效推理提供了一种可扩展且有效的解决方案。代码已发布在：https://github.com/sol924/Efficient3D
tldr: Efficient3D通过一种统一的Token剪枝框架，在保持3D多模态大模型精度的同时，显著降低了推理开销。
ai_comments: 该研究通过创新性的去偏重要性估计和自适应重平衡策略，成功解决了3D多模态大模型在推理效率与精度之间的权衡问题。该方法的优势在于其通用性，且在多个基准测试中不仅降低了计算负担，甚至实现了性能提升，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 3D多模态大模型（3D MLLMs）模型巨大且输入维度高，导致推理成本高昂，难以在资源受限平台上部署。
method: 提出了Efficient3D框架，包含两个核心组件：1. Debiased Visual Token Importance Estimator (DVTIE)模块，通过考虑浅层特征的影响来优化Token重要性预测；2. Adaptive Token Rebalancing (ATR)策略，根据场景复杂度动态调整剪枝强度。
results: 在五个3D视觉与语言基准测试（如ScanRefer、Scan2Cap等）中表现优异，在Scan2Cap数据集上CIDEr得分提升了2.57%，在降低计算量的同时实现了比未剪枝基线模型更好的性能。
conclusion: Efficient3D通过DVTIE和ATR模块实现了高效的视觉Token剪枝，为3D多模态大模型在资源受限场景下的部署提供了可扩展且有效的方案。

title: AnnoRetrieve: Efficient Structured Retrieval for Unstructured Document Analysis
authors: Teng Lin, Yuyu Luo, Nan Tang
abstract: Unstructured documents dominate enterprise and web data, but their lack of explicit organization hinders precise information retrieval. Current mainstream retrieval methods, especially embedding-based vector search, rely on coarse-grained semantic similarity, incurring high computational cost and frequent LLM calls for post-processing. To address this critical issue, we propose AnnoRetrieve, a novel retrieval paradigm that shifts from embeddings to structured annotations, enabling precise, annotation-driven semantic retrieval. Our system replaces expensive vector comparisons with lightweight structured queries over automatically induced schemas, dramatically reducing LLM usage and overall cost. The system integrates two synergistic core innovations: SchemaBoot, which automatically generates document annotation schemas via multi-granularity pattern discovery and constraint-based optimization, laying a foundation for annotation-driven retrieval and eliminating manual schema design, and Structured Semantic Retrieval (SSR), the core retrieval engine, which unifies semantic understanding with structured query execution; by leveraging the annotated structure instead of vector embeddings, SSR achieves precise semantic matching, seamlessly completing attribute-value extraction, table generation, and progressive SQL-based reasoning without relying on LLM interventions. This annotation-driven paradigm overcomes the limitations of traditional vector-based methods with coarse-grained matching and heavy LLM dependency and graph-based methods with high computational overhead. Experiments on three real-world datasets confirm that AnnoRetrieve significantly lowers LLM call frequency and retrieval cost while maintaining high accuracy. AnnoRetrieve establishes a new paradigm for cost-effective, precise, and scalable document analysis through intelligent structuring.
zh_title: AnnoRetrieve：面向非结构化文档分析的高效结构化检索系统
translation: 非结构化文档在企业和网络数据中占据主导地位，但缺乏明确的组织结构阻碍了精确的信息检索。当前主流的检索方法，特别是基于嵌入的向量搜索，依赖于粗粒度的语义相似度，导致了高昂的计算成本和频繁的LLM调用。为了解决这一关键问题，我们提出了AnnoRetrieve，一种从嵌入转向结构化标注的新型检索范式，实现了精确的、由标注驱动的语义检索。我们的系统用自动生成的模式上的轻量级结构化查询取代了昂贵的向量比较，极大地减少了LLM的使用和整体成本。该系统集成了两项协同的核心创新：SchemaBoot，通过多粒度模式发现和基于约束的优化自动生成文档标注模式，为标注驱动的检索奠定基础并消除了手动模式设计；以及结构化语义检索（SSR），即核心检索引擎，它将语义理解与结构化查询执行统一起来；通过利用标注结构而非向量嵌入，SSR实现了精确的语义匹配，无缝完成了属性值提取、表格生成和渐进式SQL推理，而无需依赖LLM干预。这种标注驱动的范式克服了传统基于向量方法（粗粒度匹配和重度LLM依赖）以及基于图方法（高计算开销）的局限性。在三个真实数据集上的实验证实，AnnoRetrieve在保持高准确性的同时，显著降低了LLM调用频率和检索成本。AnnoRetrieve通过智能结构化为经济高效、精确且可扩展的文档分析建立了一种新范式。
tldr: AnnoRetrieve通过将文档自动结构化并进行模式化查询，替代了昂贵的向量搜索和频繁的LLM调用，实现了低成本、高精度的文档分析。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种从非结构化文档分析中转向结构化标注检索的新范式，有效解决了现有向量检索精度不足和依赖大模型（LLM）导致的成本高昂问题。其创新点在于SchemaBoot的自动化模式生成和SSR引擎的结构化语义检索，具有很强的工业应用潜力。
motivation: 现有的基于向量的检索方法精度较粗，且需要频繁调用LLM进行后处理，导致计算成本过高；而基于图的方法又存在计算开销大的问题。
method: 提出了AnnoRetrieve系统，核心包含两个部分：1. SchemaBoot：通过多粒度模式发现和基于约束的优化，自动生成文档标注模式；2. 结构化语义检索（SSR）：利用标注结构代替向量嵌入，执行属性提取、表格生成和SQL推理。
results: 在三个真实数据集上的实验表明，AnnoRetrieve在保持高准确率的同时，显著降低了LLM调用频率和检索成本。
conclusion: AnnoRetrieve通过自动化的模式构建与结构化查询，成功实现了在降低LLM依赖和计算成本的同时，维持甚至提升了文档检索与分析的精度。

title: Adaptive Semantic Communication for Wireless Image Transmission Leveraging Mixture-of-Experts Mechanism
authors: Haowen Wan, Qianqian Yang
abstract: Deep learning based semantic communication has achieved significant progress in wireless image transmission, but most existing schemes rely on fixed models and thus lack robustness to diverse image contents and dynamic channel conditions. To improve adaptability, recent studies have developed adaptive semantic communication strategies that adjust transmission or model behavior according to either source content or channel state. More recently, MoE-based semantic communication has emerged as a sparse and efficient adaptive architecture, although existing designs still mainly rely on single-driven routing. To address this limitation, we propose a novel multi-stage end-to-end image semantic communication system for multi-input multi-output (MIMO) channels, built upon an adaptive MoE Swin Transformer block. Specifically, we introduce a dynamic expert gating mechanism that jointly evaluates both real-time CSI and the semantic content of input image patches to compute adaptive routing probabilities. By selectively activating only a specialized subset of experts based on this joint condition, our approach breaks the rigid coupling of traditional adaptive methods and overcomes the bottlenecks of single-driven routing. Simulation results indicate a significant improvement in reconstruction quality over existing methods while maintaining the transmission efficiency.
zh_title: 利用混合专家机制的无线图像传输自适应语义通信
translation: 基于深度学习的语义通信在无线图像传输方面取得了显著进展，但大多数现有方案依赖于固定模型，因此对多样的图像内容和动态信道条件缺乏鲁棒性。为了提高适应性，最近的研究开发了根据源内容或信道状态调整传输或模型行为的自适应语义通信策略。最近，基于MoE的语义通信作为一种稀疏且高效的自适应架构出现，尽管现有设计主要仍依赖于单驱动路由。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种用于多输入多输出（MIMO）信道的新型多阶段端到端图像语义通信系统，该系统建立在自适应MoE Swin Transformer块之上。具体而言，我们引入了一种动态专家门控机制，该机制联合评估实时CSI和输入图像块的语义内容，以计算自适应路由概率。通过基于这种联合条件仅选择性地激活专门的专家子集，我们的方法打破了传统自适应方法的刚性耦合，并克服了单驱动路由的瓶颈。仿真结果表明，在保持传输效率的同时，重建质量较现有方法有了显著提高。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合CSI和图像内容的MoE自适应路由机制，提升了无线图像语义通信的鲁棒性和重建质量。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入混合专家（MoE）机制，成功解决了传统语义通信中模型对动态环境适应性差的问题。其核心创新在于双驱动的路由机制，即同时考虑信道状态信息（CSI）和图像内容，这种设计比单一维度的自适应方法更具鲁棒性和灵活性，是语义通信领域的重要进展。
motivation: 现有基于深度学习的语义通信方案多依赖固定模型，缺乏对多样化图像内容和动态信道条件的鲁棒性；且现有的MoE设计大多仅依赖单一维度的驱动进行路由，限制了系统的适应能力。
method: 提出了一种基于自适应MoE Swin Transformer块的多阶段端到端图像语义通信系统。核心方法是引入了一种动态专家门控机制，该机制通过联合评估实时信道状态信息（CSI）和输入图像块的语义内容，计算自适应路由概率，从而选择性地激活专家网络。
results: 仿真结果表明，与现有方法相比，该系统在保持传输效率的同时，显著提升了图像的重建质量。
conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于MoE和Swin Transformer的自适应图像语义通信系统，通过联合评估信道和语义内容，实现了高效且高质量的图像传输。

title: Parser-Oriented Structural Refinement for a Stable Layout Interface in Document Parsing
authors: Fuyuan Liu, Dianyu Yu, He Ren, Nayu Liu, Xiaomian Kang, Delai Qiu, Fa Zhang, Genpeng Zhen, Shengping Liu, Jiaen Liang, Wei Huang, Yining Wang, Junnan Zhu
abstract: Accurate document parsing requires both robust content recognition and a stable parser interface. In explicit Document Layout Analysis (DLA) pipelines, downstream parsers do not consume the full detector output. Instead, they operate on a retained and serialized set of layout instances. However, on dense pages with overlapping regions and ambiguous boundaries, unstable layout hypotheses can make the retained instance set inconsistent with its parser input order, leading to severe downstream parsing errors. To address this issue, we introduce a lightweight structural refinement stage between a DETR-style detector and the parser to stabilize the parser interface. Treating raw detector outputs as a compact hypothesis pool, the proposed module performs set-level reasoning over query features, semantic cues, box geometry, and visual evidence. From a shared refined structural state, it jointly determines instance retention, refines box localization, and predicts parser input order before handoff. We further introduce retention-oriented supervision and a difficulty-aware ordering objective to better align the retained instance set and its order with the final parser input, especially on structurally complex pages. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks show that our method consistently improves page-level layout quality. When integrated into a standard end-to-end parsing pipeline, the stabilized parser interface also substantially reduces sequence mismatch, achieving a Reading Order Edit of 0.024 on OmniDocBench.
zh_title: 面向解析器的结构化细化：文档解析中的稳定布局接口研究
translation: 准确的文档解析既需要强大的内容识别能力，也需要稳定的解析器接口。在显式的文档布局分析（DLA）流水线中，下游解析器并不消费检测器的全部输出，而是仅处理保留并序列化后的布局实例集合。然而，在具有重叠区域和模糊边界的密集页面上，不稳定的布局假设可能导致保留的实例集与其解析器输入顺序不一致，从而导致严重的下游解析错误。为了解决这一问题，我们在DETR风格的检测器和解析器之间引入了一个轻量级的结构化细化阶段，以稳定解析器接口。该方法将原始检测器输出视为紧凑的假设池，在查询特征、语义线索、框几何和视觉证据上进行集合级推理。从共享的细化结构状态出发，它在移交前联合决定实例保留、细化框定位并预测解析器输入顺序。我们进一步引入了面向保留的监督和难度感知排序目标，以更好地使保留的实例集及其顺序与最终解析器输入对齐，特别是在结构复杂的页面上。在公共基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法始终提高了页面级布局质量。当集成到标准的端到端解析流水线中时，稳定的解析器接口也大幅减少了序列不匹配，在OmniDocBench上实现了0.024的阅读顺序编辑得分。
tldr: 提出一种在检测器与解析器间的结构化细化模块，通过稳定布局实例的保留与排序，解决了复杂文档解析中的顺序错乱问题。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地提出在检测器和解析器之间增加一个结构化细化阶段，解决了由于布局假设不稳定导致的解析顺序错乱问题。这对于提升复杂文档（如重叠区域多、布局密集）的解析鲁棒性具有重要意义，且方法轻量，易于集成。
motivation: 在复杂的文档布局中，检测器输出的不稳定会导致解析器输入顺序混乱，进而引发严重的解析错误，需要一种机制来稳定解析器接口。
method: 引入一个轻量级的结构化细化模块，利用集合级推理处理查询特征、语义线索、框几何和视觉证据；同时采用保留导向的监督和难度感知排序目标来优化实例保留和排序。
results: 在公开基准测试中提升了页面级布局质量，并将OmniDocBench上的阅读顺序编辑错误率降低至0.024。
conclusion: 通过在DETR类检测器与解析器间引入结构化细化模块，并配合针对性的监督策略，该方法有效稳定了解析器接口，显著降低了文档解析中的序列不匹配问题。

title: DocShield: Towards AI Document Safety via Evidence-Grounded Agentic Reasoning
authors: Fanwei Zeng, Changtao Miao, Jing Huang, Zhiya Tan, Shutao Gong, Xiaoming Yu, Yang Wang, Weibin Yao, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Jianshu Li, Yin Yan
abstract: The rapid progress of generative AI has enabled increasingly realistic text-centric image forgeries, posing major challenges to document safety. Existing forensic methods mainly rely on visual cues and lack evidence-based reasoning to reveal subtle text manipulations. Detection, localization, and explanation are often treated as isolated tasks, limiting reliability and interpretability. To tackle these challenges, we propose DocShield, the first unified framework formulating text-centric forgery analysis as a visual-logical co-reasoning problem. At its core, a novel Cross-Cues-aware Chain of Thought (CCT) mechanism enables implicit agentic reasoning, iteratively cross-validating visual anomalies with textual semantics to produce consistent, evidence-grounded forensic analysis. We further introduce a Weighted Multi-Task Reward for GRPO-based optimization, aligning reasoning structure, spatial evidence, and authenticity prediction. Complementing the framework, we construct RealText-V1, a multilingual dataset of document-like text images with pixel-level manipulation masks and expert-level textual explanations. Extensive experiments show DocShield significantly outperforms existing methods, improving macro-average F1 by 41.4% over specialized frameworks and 23.4% over GPT-4o on T-IC13, with consistent gains on the challenging T-SROIE benchmark. Our dataset, model, and code will be publicly released.
zh_title: DocShield：通过基于证据的代理推理实现AI文档安全
translation: 生成式AI的飞速发展使得针对文档的逼真文本图像篡改成为可能，对文档安全提出了严峻挑战。现有的取证方法主要依赖视觉线索，缺乏基于证据的推理来揭示细微的文本篡改。此外，检测、定位和解释通常被视为孤立的任务，限制了系统的可靠性和可解释性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了DocShield，这是第一个将以文本为中心的篡改分析建模为视觉-逻辑协同推理问题的统一框架。其核心是一种新颖的交叉线索感知思维链（CCT）机制，支持隐式代理推理，通过迭代交叉验证视觉异常与文本语义，产生一致且有证据支撑的取证分析。我们进一步引入了一种用于基于GRPO优化的加权多任务奖励，以对齐推理结构、空间证据和真实性预测。作为框架的补充，我们构建了RealText-V1，这是一个包含像素级篡改掩码和专家级文本解释的多语言文档图像数据集。广泛的实验表明，DocShield显著优于现有方法，在T-IC13上，宏平均F1比专业框架提高了41.4%，比GPT-4o提高了23.4%，并在具有挑战性的T-SROIE基准测试中也取得了持续的提升。我们的数据集、模型和代码将向公众发布。
tldr: DocShield通过视觉与逻辑协同推理机制，实现了比现有方法更精准、更具可解释性的文档篡改检测与分析。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将文档篡改检测从单一的视觉分析提升为视觉与逻辑的协同推理，引入Agentic思维链机制，显著提升了模型的可解释性和检测准确率。这是解决文档安全领域复杂篡改检测的一个重要里程碑。
motivation: 现有文档取证方法过度依赖视觉线索，缺乏证据支撑，且检测、定位与解释任务分离，导致模型可靠性与可解释性不足。
method: 提出DocShield框架，核心包含Cross-Cues-aware Chain of Thought (CCT) 机制，通过迭代交叉验证视觉异常与文本语义；采用基于GRPO的加权多任务奖励优化机制，并构建了包含像素级掩码和专家级解释的RealText-V1数据集。
results: 在T-IC13数据集上，DocShield的宏平均F1得分比专业框架提升了41.4%，比GPT-4o提升了23.4%，并在T-SROIE基准测试中表现出显著优势。
conclusion: DocShield 通过创新的视觉-逻辑协同推理机制，成功实现了文档篡改的高效检测与证据溯源，为文档安全领域提供了新的技术范式。

title: XrayClaw: Cooperative-Competitive Multi-Agent Alignment for Trustworthy Chest X-ray Diagnosis
authors: Shawn Young, Lijian Xu
abstract: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation is a fundamental yet complex clinical task that increasingly relies on artificial intelligence for automation. However, traditional monolithic models often lack the nuanced reasoning required for trustworthy diagnosis, frequently leading to logical inconsistencies and diagnostic hallucinations. While multi-agent systems offer a potential solution by simulating collaborative consultations, existing frameworks remain susceptible to consensus-based errors when instantiated by a single underlying model. This paper introduces XrayClaw, a novel framework that operationalizes multi-agent alignment through a sophisticated cooperative-competitive architecture. XrayClaw integrates four specialized cooperative agents to simulate a systematic clinical workflow, alongside a competitive agent that serves as an independent auditor. To reconcile these distinct diagnostic pathways, we propose Competitive Preference Optimization, a learning objective that penalizes illogical reasoning by enforcing mutual verification between analytical and holistic interpretations. Extensive empirical evaluations on the MS-CXR-T, MIMIC-CXR, and CheXbench benchmarks demonstrate that XrayClaw achieves state-of-the-art performance in diagnostic accuracy, clinical reasoning fidelity, and zero-shot domain generalization. Our results indicate that XrayClaw effectively mitigates cumulative hallucinations and enhances the overall reliability of automated CXR diagnosis, establishing a new paradigm for trustworthy medical imaging analysis.
zh_title: XrayClaw：用于可信胸部X光诊断的合作-竞争多智能体对齐框架
translation: 胸部X光（CXR）判读是一项基础且复杂的临床任务，目前越来越依赖人工智能来实现自动化。然而，传统的单一模型往往缺乏可信诊断所需的细致推理能力，经常导致逻辑不一致和诊断幻觉。虽然多智能体系统通过模拟协作会诊提供了一种潜在的解决方案，但现有的框架在由单一底层模型实例化时，仍容易产生基于共识的错误。本文介绍了XrayClaw，这是一个新颖的框架，通过复杂的合作-竞争架构实现了多智能体对齐。XrayClaw集成了四个专门的协作智能体来模拟系统的临床工作流，以及一个充当独立审计员的竞争智能体。为了协调这些不同的诊断路径，我们提出了竞争性偏好优化，这是一种通过强制执行分析型解读与整体型解读之间的相互验证来惩罚不合理推理的学习目标。在MS-CXR-T、MIMIC-CXR和CheXbench基准测试上的广泛实证评估表明，XrayClaw在诊断准确性、临床推理保真度和零样本领域泛化方面达到了最先进的性能。我们的结果表明，XrayClaw有效地减轻了累积幻觉并增强了自动化CXR诊断的整体可靠性，为可信的医学影像分析建立了一种新范式。
tldr: XrayClaw通过引入竞争性审计智能体和新型优化目标，解决了胸部X光诊断中常见的逻辑幻觉问题，实现了更可靠的临床推理。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于引入了“合作-竞争”的多智能体架构，通过引入独立的审计智能体和竞争性偏好优化（CPO）来解决传统单模型在医学诊断中出现的逻辑不一致和幻觉问题。这种方法论不仅提高了准确性，还增强了临床推理的可解释性，是多智能体协作在医疗AI领域应用的一个重要范式。
motivation: 传统单一模型在胸部X光诊断中缺乏细致的推理能力，容易产生逻辑不一致和诊断幻觉，而现有的多智能体协作框架在由单一模型实例化时容易出现基于共识的错误。
method: 提出XrayClaw框架，包含四个负责临床工作流的协作智能体和一个负责独立审计的竞争智能体，并设计了“竞争性偏好优化（CPO）”学习目标，通过强制分析型与整体型解读之间的相互验证来惩罚不合理的推理。
results: 在MS-CXR-T、MIMIC-CXR和CheXbench数据集上表现出最先进的性能，在诊断准确性、临床推理保真度和零样本领域泛化能力方面均有显著提升，并有效缓解了累积幻觉。
conclusion: XrayClaw通过合作-竞争多智能体架构和竞争性偏好优化，有效减少了胸部X光诊断中的逻辑错误与幻觉，显著提升了诊断的准确性和可信度。

title: VBGS-SLAM: Variational Bayesian Gaussian Splatting Simultaneous Localization and Mapping
authors: Yuhan Zhu, Yanyu Zhang, Jie Xu, Wei Ren
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown promising results for 3D scene modeling using mixtures of Gaussians, yet its existing simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) variants typically rely on direct, deterministic pose optimization against the splat map, making them sensitive to initialization and susceptible to catastrophic forgetting as map evolves. We propose Variational Bayesian Gaussian Splatting SLAM (VBGS-SLAM), a novel framework that couples the splat map refinement and camera pose tracking in a generative probabilistic form. By leveraging conjugate properties of multivariate Gaussians and variational inference, our method admits efficient closed-form updates and explicitly maintains posterior uncertainty over both poses and scene parameters. This uncertainty-aware method mitigates drift and enhances robustness in challenging conditions, while preserving the efficiency and rendering quality of existing 3DGS. Our experiments demonstrate superior tracking performance and robustness in long sequence prediction, alongside efficient, high-quality novel view synthesis across diverse synthetic and real-world scenes.
zh_title: VBGS-SLAM：变分贝叶斯高斯溅射同步定位与建图
translation: 3D高斯溅射（3DGS）在使用高斯混合模型进行3D场景建模方面表现出了良好的效果。然而，现有的同步定位与建图（SLAM）变体通常依赖于针对溅射图的直接、确定性位姿优化，这使得它们对初始化敏感，且随着地图的演化容易产生灾难性遗忘。我们提出了变分贝叶斯高斯溅射SLAM（VBGS-SLAM），这是一个新颖的框架，以生成式概率形式耦合了溅射图精炼和相机位姿跟踪。通过利用多元高斯的共轭性质和变分推理，我们的方法支持高效的闭式更新，并显式地维护位姿和场景参数的后验不确定性。这种感知不确定性的方法减轻了漂移，增强了在挑战性条件下的鲁棒性，同时保留了现有3DGS的效率和渲染质量。实验证明，该方法在长序列预测中具有卓越的跟踪性能和鲁棒性，并在各种合成和真实场景中实现了高效、高质量的新视角合成。
tldr: 一种基于变分贝叶斯的 3DGS SLAM 方法，通过显式建模位姿与场景不确定性，解决了传统方法易漂移和遗忘的问题。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入变分贝叶斯框架，将不确定性建模引入到3DGS SLAM中，有效解决了传统确定性优化方法在位姿估计和地图更新中的漂移与遗忘问题，是一个非常有前景的结合方向。
motivation: 现有的3DGS SLAM方法多依赖直接、确定性的位姿优化，导致对初始化敏感，且在地图演化过程中容易出现灾难性遗忘。
method: 提出一种生成式概率框架，利用多元高斯的共轭性质和变分推理，对地图精炼和相机位姿跟踪进行耦合，实现闭式更新并显式维护位姿与场景参数的后验不确定性。
results: 实验表明，该方法在长序列预测中表现出优越的跟踪性能和鲁棒性，并在多种合成和真实场景中实现了高效、高质量的新视角合成。
conclusion: VBGS-SLAM 通过变分贝叶斯方法实现了位姿与场景参数的不确定性建模，在保持3DGS高效渲染特性的同时，显著提升了SLAM系统的鲁棒性和轨迹跟踪精度。

title: LieTrunc-QNN: Lie Algebra Truncation and Quantum Expressivity Phase Transition from LiePrune to Provably Stable Quantum Neural Networks
authors: Haijian Shao, Dalong Zhao, Xing Deng, Wenzheng Zhu, Yingtao Jiang
abstract:
Quantum Machine Learning (QML) is fundamentally limited by two challenges: barren plateaus (exponentially vanishing gradients) and the fragility of parameterized quantum circuits under noise. Despite extensive empirical studies, a unified theoretical framework remains lacking.
  We introduce LieTrunc-QNN, an algebraic-geometric framework that characterizes trainability via Lie-generated dynamics. Parameterized quantum circuits are modeled as Lie subalgebras of u(2^n), whose action induces a Riemannian manifold of reachable quantum states. Expressivity is reinterpreted as intrinsic manifold dimension and geometry.
  We establish a geometric capacity-plateau principle: increasing effective dimension leads to exponential gradient suppression due to concentration of measure. By restricting to structured Lie subalgebras (LieTrunc), the manifold is contracted, preventing concentration and preserving non-degenerate gradients.
  We prove two main results: (1) a trainability lower bound for LieTrunc-QNN, and (2) that the Fubini-Study metric rank is bounded by the algebraic span of generators, showing expressivity is governed by structure rather than parameter count. Compact Lie subalgebras also provide inherent robustness to perturbations.
  Importantly, we establish a polynomial trainability regime where gradient variance decays polynomially instead of exponentially.
  Experiments (n=2-6) validate the theory: LieTrunc-QNN maintains stable gradients and high effective dimension, while random truncation leads to metric rank collapse. At n=6, full metric rank is preserved (rank=16). Results support a scaling law between gradient variance and effective dimension.
  This work provides a unified geometric framework for QNN design, linking Lie algebra, manifold geometry, and optimization.
zh_title: LieTrunc-QNN：李代数截断与从LiePrune到可证明稳定量子神经网络的量子表达能力相变
translation:
量子机器学习（QML）主要受限于两个挑战：贫瘠高原（指数级消失的梯度）和参数化量子电路在噪声下的脆弱性。尽管已有广泛的实证研究，但仍缺乏统一的理论框架。
我们引入了LieTrunc-QNN，这是一个通过李生成动力学来表征可训练性的代数几何框架。参数化量子电路被建模为u(2^n)的李子代数，其作用导出了可达量子态的黎曼流形。表达能力被重新解释为内在流形维度和几何结构。
我们建立了一个几何容量-高原原则：由于测度的集中，增加有效维度会导致指数级的梯度抑制。通过限制为结构化的李子代数（LieTrunc），流形被收缩，从而防止了集中并保留了非退化梯度。
我们证明了两个主要结果：（1）LieTrunc-QNN的训练性下界，以及（2）Fubini-Study度量秩受限于生成元的代数跨度，表明表达能力由结构而非参数数量决定。紧李子代数也提供了固有的抗扰动鲁棒性。
重要的是，我们建立了一个多项式训练机制，其中梯度方差呈多项式而非指数级衰减。
实验（n=2-6）验证了该理论：LieTrunc-QNN保持了稳定的梯度和高有效维度，而随机截断导致了度量秩坍缩。在n=6时，保持了完全度量秩（秩=16）。结果支持了梯度方差与有效维度之间的缩放定律。
这项工作为QNN设计提供了一个统一的几何框架，链接了李代数、流形几何和优化。
tldr: 通过李代数截断技术限制量子电路的几何结构，LieTrunc-QNN成功解决了梯度消失问题，实现了训练性能从指数级衰减到多项式级衰减的转变。
ai_comments: 该论文通过李代数理论为量子神经网络的训练性和稳定性提供了坚实的几何基础，成功连接了量子表达能力与梯度消失问题，是量子机器学习领域的一项重要理论进展。
motivation: 量子机器学习面临贫瘠高原（梯度消失）和噪声下的电路脆弱性问题，缺乏统一的理论框架来解释其训练性和表达能力。
method: 引入LieTrunc-QNN框架，将参数化量子电路建模为u(2^n)的李子代数，通过结构化李代数截断（LieTrunc）限制可达量子态的流形几何，并利用李代数生成元的代数跨度来界定Fubini-Study度量秩。
results: 证明了LieTrunc-QNN的训练性下界，建立了梯度方差与有效维度的比例定律，实现了梯度方差的多项式衰减，并在实验中验证了其在n=6时仍能保持非退化的度量秩。
conclusion: LieTrunc-QNN通过限制量子电路的李代数结构，有效抑制了测量集中现象，从而在保证表达能力的同时实现了多项式级的训练性能，为设计鲁棒且可训练的量子神经网络提供了理论指导。

title: Trivial Vocabulary Bans Improve LLM Reasoning More Than Deep Linguistic Constraints
authors: Rodney Jehu-Appiah
abstract: A previous study reported that E-Prime (English without the verb "to be") selectively altered reasoning in language models, with cross-model correlations suggesting a structural signature tied to which vocabulary was removed. I designed a replication with active controls to test the proposed mechanism: cognitive restructuring through specific vocabulary-cognition mappings. The experiment tested five conditions (unconstrained control, E-Prime, No-Have, elaborated metacognitive prompt, neutral filler-word ban) across six models and seven reasoning tasks (N=15,600 trials, 11,919 after compliance filtering). Every prediction from the cognitive restructuring hypothesis was disconfirmed. All four treatments outperformed the control (83.0%), including both active controls predicted to show null effects. The neutral filler-word ban, banning words like "very" and "just" with no role in logical inference, produced the largest improvement (+6.7 pp), while E-Prime produced the smallest (+3.7 pp). The four conditions ranked in perfect inverse order of theoretical depth. The cross-model correlation signature did not replicate (mean r=0.005). These results are consistent with a simpler mechanism: any constraint that forces a model off its default generation path acts as an output regularizer, improving reasoning by disrupting fluent but shallow response patterns. The shallowest constraints work best because they impose monitoring load with minimal conceptual disruption. I present these findings as a case study in discovery through disconfirmation.
zh_title: 简单的词汇禁令比深层的语言约束更能提升大型语言模型的推理能力
translation: 一项先前的研究报告称，E-Prime（无“be”动词的英语）选择性地改变了语言模型的推理能力，跨模型相关性表明存在一种与被移除词汇相关的结构特征。我设计了一个包含主动对照的复制实验，以检验提出的机制：通过特定的词汇-认知映射进行认知重构。该实验在六个模型和七个推理任务中测试了五种条件（无约束对照组、E-Prime、无“have”动词、详细的元认知提示、中性填充词禁令）（N=15,600次试验，过滤后为11,919次）。认知重构假说的所有预测都被证伪了。所有四种处理方法都优于对照组（83.0%），包括被预测为无效的两个主动对照组。禁止“very”和“just”等没有逻辑推理作用的词汇的中性填充词禁令产生了最大的改进（+6.7个百分点），而E-Prime产生的改进最小（+3.7个百分点）。四种条件的排名与理论深度完全相反。跨模型相关性特征未复制（平均r=0.005）。这些结果与一个更简单的机制一致：任何迫使模型偏离其默认生成路径的约束都会作为输出正则化器，通过破坏流畅但肤浅的响应模式来提高推理能力。最浅的约束效果最好，因为它们在最小的概念干扰下施加了监控监控负载。我将这些发现作为一个通过证伪进行发现的案例研究。
tldr: 通过强制模型偏离默认生成路径的任何约束都可以作为输出正则化器，通过破坏流畅但肤浅的响应模式来提高推理能力。最简单的约束效果最好，因为它们在最小的概念干扰下施加了监控负载。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过实验证伪了一个关于词汇限制如何影响大型语言模型推理能力的假设，并提出了一个更简单的解释：任何形式的输出约束，即使是看似无关紧要的，都能通过打断模型流畅但可能不准确的输出模式来提高其推理能力。研究的创新之处在于其严谨的实验设计，包括主动对照组和对先前研究的直接复制与证伪，以及对结果的简洁解释。该研究的重要性在于为如何有效提升大型语言模型的推理能力提供了新的视角，表明简单、低成本的干预措施可能比复杂的语言规则更有效。然而，研究也存在局限性，例如其结论主要基于对特定模型的测试，其普遍性有待进一步验证。未来的研究可以探索不同类型的简单约束以及它们在不同模型和任务上的效果。
motivation: 复制一项先前关于E-Prime（无‘be’动词的英语）选择性地改变语言模型推理能力的研究，以检验其提出的机制：通过特定的词汇-认知映射进行认知重构。
method: 通过六个模型和七个推理任务（N=15,600次试验，过滤后为11,919次）测试了五种条件（无约束对照组、E-Prime、无‘have’、详细的元认知提示、中性填充词禁令），以检验认知重构假说。
results: 所有四种处理方法都优于对照组（83.0%），包括被预测为无效的两个主动对照组。禁止“very”和“just”等词汇的中性填充词禁令产生了最大的改进（+6.7个百分点），而E-Prime产生的改进最小（+3.7个百分点）。四种条件的排名与理论深度完全相反。跨模型相关性特征未复制（平均r=0.005）。
conclusion: 结果与一个更简单的机制一致：任何迫使模型偏离其默认生成路径的约束都会作为输出正则化器，通过破坏流畅但肤浅的响应模式来提高推理能力。最浅的约束效果最好，因为它们在最小的概念干扰下施加了监控负载。

title: A Rapid Instrument Exchange System for Humanoid Robots in Minimally Invasive Surgery
authors: Bingcong Zhang, Yihang Lyv, Lianbo Ma, Yushi He, Pengfei Wei, Xingchi Liu, Jinhua Li, Jianchang Zhao, Lizhi Pan
abstract: Humanoid robot technologies have demonstrated immense potential for minimally invasive surgery (MIS). Unlike dedicated multi-arm surgical platforms, the inherent dual-arm configuration of humanoid robots necessitates an efficient instrument exchange capability to perform complex procedures, mimicking the natural workflow where surgeons manually switch instruments. To address this, this paper proposes an immersive teleoperated rapid instrument exchange system. The system utilizes a low-latency mechanism based on single-axis compliant docking and environmental constraint release. Integrated with real-time first-person view (FPV) perception via a head-mounted display (HMD), this framework significantly reduces operational complexity and cognitive load during the docking process. Comparative evaluations between experts and novices demonstrate high operational robustness and a rapidly converging learning curve; novice performance in instrument attachment and detachment improved substantially after brief training. While long-distance spatial alignment still presents challenges in time cost and collaborative stability, this study successfully validates the technical feasibility of humanoid robots executing stable instrument exchanges within constrained clinical environments.

title: TypePro: Boosting LLM-Based Type Inference via Inter-Procedural Slicing
authors: Teyu Lin, Minghao Fan, Huaxun Huang, Zhirong Shen, Rongxin Wu
abstract: Dynamic languages (such as Python and JavaScript) offer flexibility and simplified type handling for programming, but this can also lead to an increase in type-related errors and additional overhead for compile-time type inference. As a result, type inference for dynamic languages has become a popular research area. Existing approaches typically achieve type inference through static analysis, machine learning, or large language models (LLMs). However, current work only focuses on the direct dependencies of variables related to type inference as the context, resulting in incomplete contextual information and thus affecting the accuracy of type inference. To address this issue, this paper proposes a method called TypePro, which leverages LLMs for type inference in dynamic languages. TypePro supplements contextual information by conducting inter-procedural code slicing. Then, TypePro proposes a set of candidate complex types based on the structural information of data types implied in the slices, thereby addressing the lack of domain knowledge of LLMs. We conducted experiments on the ManyTypes4Py and ManyTypes4TypeScript datasets, achieving Top-1 exact match (EM) rates of 88.9% and 86.6%, respectively. Notably, TypePro improves the Top-1 Exact Match by 7.1 and 10.3 percentage points over the second-best approach, showing the effectiveness and robustness of TypePro.
zh_title: TypePro：通过跨过程切片增强基于大模型的类型推断
translation: 动态语言（如Python和JavaScript）提供了灵活性和简化的类型处理，但也可能导致类型相关错误的增加以及编译时类型推断的额外开销。因此，动态语言的类型推断已成为一个热门的研究领域。现有的方法通常通过静态分析、机器学习或大语言模型（LLM）来实现类型推断。然而，当前的工作仅关注与类型推断相关的变量的直接依赖关系作为上下文，导致上下文信息不完整，从而影响了类型推断的准确性。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种名为TypePro的方法，利用LLM进行动态语言的类型推断。TypePro通过执行跨过程代码切片来补充上下文信息。然后，TypePro基于切片中隐含的数据结构信息提出了一组复杂的候选类型，从而解决了LLM缺乏领域知识的问题。我们在ManyTypes4Py和ManyTypes4TypeScript数据集上进行了实验，Top-1精确匹配（EM）率分别达到了88.9%和86.6%。值得注意的是，TypePro在Top-1精确匹配率上比第二好的方法分别提高了7.1和10.3个百分点，显示了TypePro的有效性和鲁棒性。
tldr: TypePro通过跨过程切片技术为大模型提供更完整的上下文，显著提升了Python和TypeScript的类型推断准确率。
ai_comments: 该研究通过跨过程切片技术有效解决了LLM进行类型推断时上下文缺失的问题，是一种将程序分析与大模型结合的典型且高效的范式，具有很强的实用价值。
motivation: 当前基于LLM的动态语言类型推断方法仅关注变量的直接依赖关系，导致上下文信息不完整，进而影响推断准确性。
method: 提出TypePro方法，首先利用跨过程代码切片技术补充上下文信息，随后基于切片中隐含的数据结构信息生成复杂类型候选集，以增强LLM的领域知识。
results: 在ManyTypes4Py和ManyTypes4TypeScript数据集上，TypePro的Top-1精确匹配率分别达到88.9%和86.6%，较次优方法分别提升了7.1和10.3个百分点。
conclusion: TypePro通过结合跨过程代码切片与LLM，显著提升了动态语言类型推断的准确性，优于现有的前沿方法。

title: Maximally Random Sortition
authors: Gabriel de Azevedo, Paul Gölz
abstract: Citizens' assemblies are a form of democratic innovation in which a randomly selected panel of constituents deliberates on questions of public interest. We study a novel goal for the selection of panel members: maximizing the entropy of the distribution over possible panels. We design algorithms that sample from maximum-entropy distributions, potentially subject to constraints on the individual selection probabilities. We investigate the properties of these algorithms theoretically, including in terms of their resistance to manipulation and transparency. We benchmark our algorithms on a large set of real assembly lotteries in terms of their intersectional diversity and the probability of satisfying unseen representation constraints, and we obtain favorable results on both measures. We deploy one of our algorithms on a website for citizens' assembly practitioners.

title: Evaluating the Formal Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models through Chomsky Hierarchy
authors: Yihong Dong, Xiaoha Jian, Xue Jiang, Xuyuan Guo, Zhiyuan Fan, Jiaru Qian, Kechi Zhang, Jia Li, Zhi Jin, Ge Li
abstract: The formal reasoning capabilities of LLMs are crucial for advancing automated software engineering. However, existing benchmarks for LLMs lack systematic evaluation based on computation and complexity, leaving a critical gap in understanding their formal reasoning capabilities. Therefore, it is still unknown whether SOTA LLMs can grasp the structured, hierarchical complexity of formal languages as defined by Computation Theory. To address this, we introduce ChomskyBench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating LLMs through the lens of Chomsky Hierarchy. Unlike prior work that uses vectorized classification for neural networks, ChomskyBench is the first to combine full Chomsky Hierarchy coverage, process-trace evaluation via natural language, and deterministic symbolic verifiability. ChomskyBench is composed of a comprehensive suite of language recognition and generation tasks designed to test capabilities at each level. Extensive experiments indicate a clear performance stratification that correlates with the hierarchy's levels of complexity. Our analysis reveals a direct relationship where increasing task difficulty substantially impacts both inference length and performance. Furthermore, we find that while larger models and advanced inference methods offer notable relative gains, they face severe efficiency barriers: achieving practical reliability would require prohibitive computational costs, revealing that current limitations stem from inefficiency rather than absolute capability bounds. A time complexity analysis further indicates that LLMs are significantly less efficient than traditional algorithmic programs for these formal tasks. These results delineate the practical limits of current LLMs, highlight the indispensability of traditional software tools, and provide insights to guide the development of future LLMs with more powerful formal reasoning capabilities.

title: V2X-QA: A Comprehensive Reasoning Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models in Autonomous Driving Across Ego, Infrastructure, and Cooperative Views
authors: Junwei You, Pei Li, Zhuoyu Jiang, Weizhe Tang, Zilin Huang, Rui Gan, Jiaxi Liu, Yan Zhao, Sikai Chen, Bin Ran
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for autonomous driving, yet existing benchmarks remain largely ego-centric and therefore cannot systematically assess model performance in infrastructure-centric and cooperative driving conditions. In this work, we introduce V2X-QA, a real-world dataset and benchmark for evaluating MLLMs across vehicle-side, infrastructure-side, and cooperative viewpoints. V2X-QA is built around a view-decoupled evaluation protocol that enables controlled comparison under vehicle-only, infrastructure-only, and cooperative driving conditions within a unified multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) framework. The benchmark is organized into a twelve-task taxonomy spanning perception, prediction, and reasoning and planning, and is constructed through expert-verified MCQA annotation to enable fine-grained diagnosis of viewpoint-dependent capabilities. Benchmark results across ten representative state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source models show that viewpoint accessibility substantially affects performance, and infrastructure-side reasoning supports meaningful macroscopic traffic understanding. Results also indicate that cooperative reasoning remains challenging since it requires cross-view alignment and evidence integration rather than simply additional visual input. To address these challenges, we introduce V2X-MoE, a benchmark-aligned baseline with explicit view routing and viewpoint-specific LoRA experts. The strong performance of V2X-MoE further suggests that explicit viewpoint specialization is a promising direction for multi-view reasoning in autonomous driving. Overall, V2X-QA provides a foundation for studying multi-perspective reasoning, reliability, and cooperative physical intelligence in connected autonomous driving. The dataset and V2X-MoE resources are publicly available at: https://github.com/junwei0001/V2X-QA.

title: ALIVE-LIO: Degeneracy-Aware Learning of Inertial Velocity for Enhancing ESKF-Based LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
authors: Seongjun Kim, Daehan Lee, Junwoo Hong, Sanghyun Park, Hyunyoung Jo, Soohee Han
abstract: Odometry estimation using light detection and ranging (LiDAR) and an inertial measurement unit (IMU), known as LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO), often suffers from performance degradation in degenerate environments, such as long corridors or single-wall scenarios with narrow field-of-view LiDAR. To address this limitation, we propose ALIVE-LIO, a degeneracy-aware LiDAR-inertial odometry framework that explicitly enhances state estimation in degenerate directions. The key contribution of ALIVE-LIO is the strategic integration of a deep neural network into a classical error-state Kalman filter (ESKF) to compensate for the loss of LiDAR observability. Specifically, ALIVE-LIO employs a neural network to predict the body-frame velocity and selectively fuses this prediction into the ESKF only when degeneracy is detected, providing effective state updates along degenerate directions. This design enables ALIVE-LIO to utilize the probabilistic structure and consistency of the ESKF while benefiting from learning-based motion estimation. The proposed method was evaluated on publicly available datasets exhibiting degeneracy, as well as on our own collected data. Experimental results demonstrate that ALIVE-LIO substantially reduces pose drift in degenerate environments, yielding the most competitive results in 22 out of 32 sequences. The implementation of ALIVE-LIO will be publicly available.
zh_title: ALIVE-LIO：退化感知学习惯性速度以增强基于ESKF的激光雷达-惯性里程计
translation: 使用激光雷达（LiDAR）和惯性测量单元（IMU）的里程计估计，称为激光雷达-惯性里程计（LIO），在退化环境中，如长走廊或窄视场激光雷达的单墙场景中，通常会遇到性能下降的问题。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了ALIVE-LIO，一个退化感知的激光雷达-惯性里程计框架，它明确地增强了在退化方向上的状态估计。ALIVE-LIO的关键贡献是将深度神经网络战略性地集成到经典的误差状态卡尔曼滤波器（ESKF）中，以补偿激光雷达可观测性的损失。具体来说，ALIVE-LIO使用一个神经网络来预测本体坐标系的速度，并仅在检测到退化时选择性地将该预测融合到ESKF中，从而在退化方向上提供有效的状态更新。这种设计使ALIVE-LIO能够利用ESKF的概率结构和一致性，同时受益于基于学习的运动估计。所提出的方法在包含退化场景的公开数据集以及我们自己收集的数据上进行了评估。实验结果表明，ALIVE-LIO在退化环境中显著减少了姿态漂移，在32个序列中的22个中取得了最具竞争力的结果。ALIVE-LIO的实现将公开可用。
keywords: 误差状态卡尔曼滤波器
tldr: ALIVE-LIO通过集成深度神经网络到ESKF中，在退化环境中通过预测惯性速度来补偿LiDAR可观测性损失，从而显著减少姿态漂移，在22/32个序列中表现最佳。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的ALIVE-LIO方法，通过将学习模型集成到传统的ESKF框架中来解决LIO在退化环境下的性能问题，具有重要的理论和实践意义。通过在退化时选择性地融合学习到的速度预测，该方法有效地利用了IMU数据，提高了估计的鲁棒性。然而，该方法对神经网络的依赖性以及在非退化环境下的性能表现仍需进一步探索。
motivation: 传统的激光雷达-惯性里程计（LIO）在退化环境（如长走廊或窄视场单墙场景）中性能会下降。
method: 提出ALIVE-LIO框架，将深度神经网络集成到经典的误差状态卡尔曼滤波器（ESKF）中，用于预测本体坐标系速度，并在检测到退化时选择性地融合该预测，以补偿LiDAR可观测性损失。

title: Breakdowns in Conversational AI: Interactional Failures in Emotionally and Ethically Sensitive Contexts
authors: Jiawen Deng, Wentao Zhang, Ziyun Jiao, Fuji Ren
abstract: Conversational AI is increasingly deployed in emotionally charged and ethically sensitive interactions. Previous research has primarily concentrated on emotional benchmarks or static safety checks, overlooking how alignment unfolds in evolving conversation. We explore the research question: what breakdowns arise when conversational agents confront emotionally and ethically sensitive behaviors, and how do these affect dialogue quality? To stress-test chatbot performance, we develop a persona-conditioned user simulator capable of engaging in multi-turn dialogue with psychological personas and staged emotional pacing. Our analysis reveals that mainstream models exhibit recurrent breakdowns that intensify as emotional trajectories escalate. We identify several common failure patterns, including affective misalignments, ethical guidance failures, and cross-dimensional trade-offs where empathy supersedes or undermines responsibility. We organize these patterns into a taxonomy and discuss the design implications, highlighting the necessity to maintain ethical coherence and affective sensitivity throughout dynamic interactions. The study offers the HCI community a new perspective on the diagnosis and improvement of conversational AI in value-sensitive and emotionally charged contexts.

title: FluxMoE: Decoupling Expert Residency for High-Performance MoE Serving
authors: Qingxiu Liu, Cyril Y. He, Hanser Jiang, Zion Wang, Alan Zhao, Patrick P. C. Lee
abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become a dominant paradigm for scaling large language models, but their rapidly growing parameter sizes introduce a fundamental inefficiency during inference: most expert weights remain idle in GPU memory while competing with performance-critical runtime state such as the key-value (KV) cache. Since KV cache capacity directly determines serving throughput, this mismatch leads to underutilized memory and degraded performance. In this paper, we present FluxMoE, a new MoE inference system that decouples expert parameters from persistent GPU residency. FluxMoE introduces an expert paging abstraction that treats expert weights as streamed, transient resources, materializing them on demand and evicting them immediately after use, allowing GPU memory to be preferentially allocated to throughput-critical runtime state. We implement FluxMoE atop vLLM to enable efficient MoE inference under severe memory constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that FluxMoE achieves up to 3.0$\times$ throughput gains over vLLM in memory-intensive regimes, without compromising model fidelity.

title: ExploreVLA: Dense World Modeling and Exploration for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
authors: Zihao Sheng, Xin Ye, Jingru Luo, Sikai Chen, Liu Ren
abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving models based on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures have shown promising results by learning driving policies through behavior cloning on expert demonstrations. However, imitation learning inherently limits the model to replicating observed behaviors without exploring diverse driving strategies, leaving it brittle in novel or out-of-distribution scenarios. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a natural remedy by enabling policy exploration beyond the expert distribution. Yet VLA models, typically trained on offline datasets, lack directly observable state transitions, necessitating a learned world model to anticipate action consequences. In this work, we propose a unified understanding-and-generation framework that leverages world modeling to simultaneously enable meaningful exploration and provide dense supervision. Specifically, we augment trajectory prediction with future RGB and depth image generation as dense world modeling objectives, requiring the model to learn fine-grained visual and geometric representations that substantially enrich the planning backbone. Beyond serving as a supervisory signal, the world model further acts as a source of intrinsic reward for policy exploration: its image prediction uncertainty naturally measures a trajectory's novelty relative to the training distribution, where high uncertainty indicates out-of-distribution scenarios that, if safe, represent valuable learning opportunities. We incorporate this exploration signal into a safety-gated reward and optimize the policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Experiments on the NAVSIM and nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, achieving a state-of-the-art PDMS score of 93.7 and an EPDMS of 88.8 on NAVSIM. The code and demo will be publicly available at https://zihaosheng.github.io/ExploreVLA/.

title: Generative Frontiers: Why Evaluation Matters for Diffusion Language Models
authors: Patrick Pynadath, Jiaxin Shi, Ruqi Zhang
abstract: Diffusion language models have seen exciting recent progress, offering far more flexibility in generative trajectories than autoregressive models. This flexibility has motivated a growing body of research into new approaches to diffusion language modeling, which typically begins at the scale of GPT-2 small (150 million parameters). However, these advances introduce new issues with evaluation methodology. In this technical note, we discuss the limitations of current methodology and propose principled augmentations to ensure reliable comparisons. We first discuss why OpenWebText has become the standard benchmark, and why alternatives such as LM1B are inherently less meaningful. We then discuss the limitations of likelihood evaluations for diffusion models, and explain why relying on generative perplexity alone as a metric can lead to uninformative results. To address this, we show that generative perplexity and entropy are two components of the KL divergence to a reference distribution. This decomposition explains generative perplexity's sensitivity to entropy, and naturally suggests generative frontiers as a principled method for evaluating model generative quality. We conclude with empirical observations on model quality at this scale. We include a blog post with interactive content to illustrate the argument at https://patrickpynadath1.github.io/blog/eval_methodology/.

title: Evaluating Bounded Superintelligent Authority in Multi-Level Governance: A Framework for Governance Under Radical Capability Asymmetry
authors: Tony Rost
abstract: Governance theory has always presumed cognitive comparability between governors and governed. This paper identifies that unstated assumption, constructs a framework that makes it testable, and shows that it is load-bearing. The framework specifies necessary conditions along six dimensions (legitimacy, accountability, corrigibility, non-domination, subsidiarity, and institutional resilience), synthesized from political legitimacy theory, principal-agent models, republican political theory, and AI alignment research. Applied first to existing institutions and then to a prospective case of bounded superintelligent authority where capability asymmetry is radical, the framework finds structural failures on four of six dimensions. Among these, two are design-tractable and two are theory-requiring: the public reason problem under cognitive incomprehensibility and the non-domination problem under permanent capability asymmetry demand genuinely new normative frameworks, not better institutional design. A further finding is that dimensions which function as independent checks under bounded asymmetry become correlated failures under radical asymmetry. The analysis contributes to political theory by exposing foundational assumptions that have gone unexamined because, until now, they have always been satisfied.
