title: Comparing the Impact of Pedagogy-Informed Custom and General-Purpose GAI Chatbots on Students' Science Problem-Solving Processes and Performance Using Heterogeneous Interaction Network Analysis
authors: Hanyu Su, Huilin Zhang, Shihui Feng
abstract: Problem solving plays an essential role in science education, and generative AI (GAI) chatbots have emerged as a promising tool for supporting students' science problem solving. However, general-purpose chatbots (e.g., ChatGPT), which often provide direct, ready-made answers, may lead to students' cognitive offloading. Prior research has rarely focused on custom chatbots for facilitating students' science problem solving, nor has it examined how they differently influence problem-solving processes and performance compared to general-purpose chatbots. To address this gap, we developed a pedagogy-informed custom GAI chatbot grounded in the Socratic questioning method, which supports students by prompting them with guiding questions. This study employed a within-subjects counterbalanced design in which 48 secondary school students used both custom and general-purpose chatbot to complete two science problem-solving tasks. 3297 student-chatbot dialogues were collected and analyzed using Heterogeneous Interaction Network Analysis (HINA). The results showed that: (1) students demonstrated significantly higher interaction intensity and cognitive interaction diversity when using custom chatbot than using general-purpose chatbot; (2) students were more likely to follow custom chatbot's guidance to think and reflect, whereas they tended to request general-purpose chatbot to execute specific commands; and (3) no statistically significant difference was observed in students' problem-solving performance evaluated by solution quality between two chatbot conditions. This study provides novel theoretical insights and empirical evidence that custom chatbots are less likely to induce cognitive offloading and instead foster greater cognitive engagement compared to general-purpose chatbots. This study also offers insights into the design and integration of GAI chatbots in science education.

title: A Boolean encoding of the Most Permissive semantics for Boolean networks
authors: Laure de Chancel, Brigitte Mossé, Aurélien Naldi, Élisabeth Remy
abstract: Boolean networks are widely used to model biological regulatory networks and study their dynamics. Classical semantics, such as the asynchronous semantics, do not always accurately capture transient or asymptotic behaviors observed in quantitative models. To address this limitation, the Most Permissive semantics was introduced by Paulevé et al., extending Boolean dynamics with intermediate activity levels that allow components to transiently activate or inhibit their targets during transitions. In this work, we provide a Boolean encoding of the Most Permissive semantics: each component of the original network is represented by a triplet of Boolean variables, and we derive the extended logical function governing the resulting network. We prove that the asynchronous dynamics of the encoded network exactly reproduces the attainability properties of the original network under Most Permissive semantics. This encoding is implemented as a modifier within the bioLQM framework, making it directly compatible with existing tools such as GINsim. To address scalability limitations, we further extend the tool to support partial unfolding, restricted to a user-defined subset of components.

title: BugForge: Constructing and Utilizing DBMS Bug Repository to Enhance DBMS Testing
authors: Dawei Li, Qifan Liu, Yuxiao Guo, Jie Liang, Zhiyong Wu, Chi Zhang, Jingzhou Fu, Haogang Mao, Zhenyu Guan, Yu Jiang
abstract:
DBMSs are complex systems prone to bugs that may lead to system failures or compromise data integrity. Establishing unified DBMS bug repositories is crucial for systematically organizing bug-related data, enabling code improvement, and supporting automated testing. In particular, bug reports often contain valuable test inputs and bug-triggering clues that help explore rare execution paths and expose critical buggy behavior, thereby guiding automated DBMS testing. However, the heterogeneity of bug reports, along with their incomplete or inaccurate content, makes it challenging to build unified repositories and convert them into high-quality test cases.
  In this paper, we propose BugForge, a framework that constructs standardized DBMS bug repositories and leverages them to generate high-quality test cases to enhance DBMS testing. Specifically, BugForge progressively collects bug reports, then employs syntax-aware processing and input-adaptive raw PoC extraction to construct a DBMS bug repository. The repository stores structured bug-related data, including bug metadata and raw PoCs that entail potential bug-triggering semantics. These data are further refined into high-quality test cases through semantic-guided adaptation, thereby enabling enhanced DBMS testing methods, including DBMS fuzzing, regression testing, and cross-DBMS bug discovery. We implemented BugForge for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, and MonetDB, totally integrated 37,632 bug reports spanning up to 28 years. Based on the repository, BugForge uncovered 35 previously unknown bugs with 22 confirmed by developers, demonstrating the value of constructing and utilizing bug repositories for DBMS testing.

title: Learning Contractive Integral Operators with Fredholm Integral Neural Operators
authors: Kyriakos C. Georgiou, Constantinos Siettos, Athanasios N. Yannacopoulos
abstract: We generalize the framework of Fredholm Neural Networks, to learn non-expansive integral operators arising in Fredholm Integral Equations (FIEs) of the second kind in arbitrary dimensions. We first present the proposed Fredholm Integral Neural Operators (FREDINOs), for FIEs and prove that they are universal approximators of linear and non-linear integral operators and corresponding solution operators. We furthermore prove that the learned operators are guaranteed to be contractive, thereby strictly satisfying the mathematical property required for the convergence of the fixed point scheme. Finally, we also demonstrate how FREDINOs can be used to learn the solution operator of non-linear elliptic PDEs, via a Boundary Integral Equation (BIE) formulation. We assess the proposed methodology numerically, via several benchmark problems: linear and non-linear FIEs in arbitrary dimensions, as well as a non-linear elliptic PDE in 2D. Built on tailored mathematical/numerical analysis theory, FREDINOs offer high-accuracy approximations and interpretable schemes, making them well suited for scientific machine learning/numerical analysis computations.

title: Beyond Isolated Tasks: A Framework for Evaluating Coding Agents on Sequential Software Evolution
authors: KN Ajay Shastry, Ganesh Senrayan, Shrey Satapara, Pranoy Panda, Chaitanya Devaguptapu
abstract: Existing datasets for coding agents evaluate performance on isolated, single pull request (PR) tasks in a stateless manner, failing to capture the reality of real-world software development where code changes accumulate, technical debt accrues, and test suites grow over time. To bridge this gap, we introduce an automated coding task generation framework, which helps generate our dataset SWE-STEPS, that evaluates coding agents on long-horizon tasks through two realistic settings mirroring actual developer workflows: Conversational coding with iterative requests, and single-shot Project Requirement document (PRD)-based coding. Unlike existing datasets that evaluate agents on disjointed Pull Requests (PRs), our framework assesses performance across chains of dependent PRs, enabling evaluation of sequential execution, regression verification, and long-term repository health. We discover that widely used isolated PR evaluations yield inflated success rates, w.r.t. our settings - overshooting performance by as much as 20 percentage points - because they ignore the ``spillover'' effects of previous inefficient or buggy code. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that even when agents successfully resolve issues, they degrade repository health by generating code with higher cognitive complexity and technical debt compared to human developers, underscoring the necessity for multidimensional evaluation.

title: ARM: Advantage Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Manipulation
authors: Yiming Mao, Zixi Yu, Weixin Mao, Yinhao Li, Qirui Hu, Zihan Lan, Minzhao Zhu, Hua Chen
abstract: Long-horizon robotic manipulation remains challenging for reinforcement learning (RL) because sparse rewards provide limited guidance for credit assignment. Practical policy improvement thus relies on richer intermediate supervision, such as dense progress rewards, which are costly to obtain and ill-suited to non-monotonic behaviors such as backtracking and recovery. To address this, we propose Advantage Reward Modeling (ARM), a framework that shifts from hard-to-quantify absolute progress to estimating relative advantage. We introduce a cost-effective tri-state labeling strategy -- Progressive, Regressive, and Stagnant -- that reduces human cognitive overhead while ensuring high cross-annotator consistency. By training on these intuitive signals, ARM enables automated progress annotation for both complete demonstrations and fragmented DAgger-style data. Integrating ARM into an offline RL pipeline allows for adaptive action-reward reweighting, effectively filtering suboptimal samples. Our approach achieves a 99.4% success rate on a challenging long-horizon towel-folding task, demonstrating improved stability and data efficiency over current VLA baselines with near-zero human intervention during policy training.

title: Behavior-Constrained Reinforcement Learning with Receding-Horizon Credit Assignment for High-Performance Control
authors: Siwei Ju, Jan Tauberschmidt, Oleg Arenz, Peter van Vliet, Jan Peters
abstract: Learning high-performance control policies that remain consistent with expert behavior is a fundamental challenge in robotics. Reinforcement learning can discover high-performing strategies but often departs from desirable human behavior, whereas imitation learning is limited by demonstration quality and struggles to improve beyond expert data. We propose a behavior-constrained reinforcement learning framework that improves beyond demonstrations while explicitly controlling deviation from expert behavior. Because expert-consistent behavior in dynamic control is inherently trajectory-level, we introduce a receding-horizon predictive mechanism that models short-term future trajectories and provides look-ahead rewards during training. To account for the natural variability of human behavior under disturbances and changing conditions, we further condition the policy on reference trajectories, allowing it to represent a distribution of expert-consistent behaviors rather than a single deterministic target. Empirically, we evaluate the approach in high-fidelity race car simulation using data from professional drivers, a domain characterized by extreme dynamics and narrow performance margins. The learned policies achieve competitive lap times while maintaining close alignment with expert driving behavior, outperforming baseline methods in both performance and imitation quality. Beyond standard benchmarks, we conduct human-grounded evaluation in a driver-in-the-loop simulator and show that the learned policies reproduce setup-dependent driving characteristics consistent with the feedback of top-class professional race drivers. These results demonstrate that our method enables learning high-performance control policies that are both optimal and behavior-consistent, and can serve as reliable surrogates for human decision-making in complex control systems.

title: QVAD: A Question-Centric Agentic Framework for Efficient and Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection
authors: Lokman Bekit, Hamza Karim, Nghia T Nguyen, Yasin Yilmaz
abstract: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, particularly due to the open-set nature of anomalies. While recent training-free approaches utilizing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown promise, they typically rely on massive, resource-intensive foundation models to compensate for the ambiguity of static prompts. We argue that the bottleneck in VAD is not necessarily model capacity, but rather the static nature of inquiry. We propose QVAD, a question-centric agentic framework that treats VLM-LLM interaction as a dynamic dialogue. By iteratively refining queries based on visual context, our LLM agent guides smaller VLMs to produce high-fidelity captions and precise semantic reasoning without parameter updates. This ``prompt-updating" mechanism effectively unlocks the latent capabilities of lightweight models, enabling state-of-the-art performance on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and UBNormal using a fraction of the parameters required by competing methods. We further demonstrate exceptional generalizability on the single-scene ComplexVAD dataset. Crucially, QVAD achieves high inference speeds with minimal memory footprints, making advanced VAD capabilities deployable on resource-constrained edge devices.

title: Posterior Matching over Binary-Input Memoryless Symmetric Channels: Non-Asymptotic Bounds and Low-Complexity Encoding
authors: Recep Can Yavas
abstract: We study variable-length feedback (VLF) codes over binary-input memoryless symmetric (BMS) channels using posterior matching with small-enough-difference (SED) partitioning. Prior analyses of SED-based schemes rely on bounded log-likelihood ratio (LLR) increments, restricting their scope to discrete-output channels such as the binary symmetric channel (BSC). We remove this restriction and provide an analysis of posterior matching that covers a broad class of BMS channels, including continuous-output channels such as the binary-input AWGN channel. We derive a novel non-asymptotic achievability bound on the expected decoding time that decomposes into communication, confirmation, and recovery terms with explicit dependence on the channel capacity~$C$, the KL divergence~$C_1$, and the Bhattacharyya parameter of the channel. The proof develops new stopping-time and overshoot bounds for submartingales and random walks with unbounded increments, drawing on tools from renewal theory. On the algorithmic side, we propose a low-complexity encoder that enforces the exact SED partition at every step by grouping messages according to their log-likelihood ratios that are assumed to land on a lattice, and applying a batched correction step that restores the partition balance. The resulting encoder complexity is polynomial in the number of transmitted bits. For continuous-output channels, the lattice structure is enforced through output quantization satisfying an exact induced-lattice constraint; the associated capacity loss is $O(\log B / B^2)$ for a $B$-level quantizer. These results yield a VLF coding scheme for BMS channels that simultaneously achieves strong non-asymptotic performance and practical encoder complexity.

title: GenSmoke-GS: A Multi-Stage Method for Novel View Synthesis from Smoke-Degraded Images Using a Generative Model
authors: Qida Cao, Xinyuan Hu, Changyue Shi, Jiajun Ding, Zhou Yu, Jun Yu
abstract: This paper describes our method for Track 2 of the NTIRE 2026 3D Restoration and Reconstruction (3DRR) Challenge on smoke-degraded images. In this task, smoke reduces image visibility and weakens the cross-view consistency required by scene optimization and rendering. We address this problem with a multi-stage pipeline consisting of image restoration, dehazing, MLLM-based enhancement, 3DGS-MCMC optimization, and averaging over repeated runs. The main purpose of the pipeline is to improve visibility before rendering while limiting scene-content changes across input views. Experimental results on the challenge benchmark show improved quantitative performance and better visual quality than the provided baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/plbbl/GenSmoke-GS. Our method achieved a ranking of 1 out of 14 participants in Track 2 of the NTIRE 3DRR Challenge, as reported on the official competition website: https://www.codabench.org/competitions/13993/#/results-tab.

title: Enhancing Multi-Robot Exploration Using Probabilistic Frontier Prioritization with Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixtures
authors: John Lewis Devassy, Meysam Basiri, Mário A. T. Figueiredo, Pedro U. Lima
abstract: Multi-agent autonomous exploration is essential for applications such as environmental monitoring, search and rescue, and industrial-scale surveillance. However, effective coordination under communication constraints remains a significant challenge. Frontier exploration algorithms analyze the boundary between the known and unknown regions to determine the next-best view that maximizes exploratory gain. This article proposes an enhancement to existing frontier-based exploration algorithms by introducing a probabilistic approach to frontier prioritization. By leveraging Dirichlet process Gaussian mixture model (DP-GMM) and a probabilistic formulation of information gain, the method improves the quality of frontier prioritization. The proposed enhancement, integrated into two state-of-the-art multi-agent exploration algorithms, consistently improves performance across environments of varying clutter, communication constraints, and team sizes. Simulations showcase an average gain of $10\%$ and $14\%$ for the two algorithms across all combinations. Successful deployment in real-world experiments with a dual-drone system further corroborates these findings.

title: Analyzing Healthcare Interoperability Vulnerabilities: Formal Modeling and Graph-Theoretic Approach
authors: Jawad Mohammed, Gahangir Hossain
abstract: In a healthcare environment, the healthcare interoperability platforms based on HL7 FHIR allow concurrent, asynchronous access to a set of shared patient resources, which are independent systems, i.e., EHR systems, pharmacy systems, lab systems, and devices. The FHIR specification lacks a protocol for concurrency control, and the research on detecting a race condition only targets the OS kernel. The research on FHIR security only targets authentication and injection attacks, considering concurrent access to patient resources to be sequential. The gap in the research in this area is addressed through the introduction of FHIR Resource Access Graph (FRAG), a formally defined graph G = (P,R,E, λ, τ, S), in which the nodes are the concurrent processes, the typed edges represent the resource access events, and the race conditions are represented as detectable structural properties. Three clinically relevant race condition classes are formally specified: Simultaneous Write Conflict (SWC), TOCTOU Authorization Violation (TAV), and Cascading Update Race (CUR). The FRAG model is implemented as a three-pass graph traversal detection algorithm and tested against a time window-based baseline on 1,500 synthetic FHIR R4 transaction logs. Under full concurrent access (C2), FRAG attains a 90.0% F1 score vs. 25.5% for the baseline, a 64.5 pp improvement.

title: STEAR: Layer-Aware Spatiotemporal Evidence Intervention for Hallucination Mitigation in Video Large Language Models
authors: Linfeng Fan, Yuan Tian, Ziwei Li, Zhiwu Lu
abstract: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) remain prone to spatiotemporal hallucinations, often generating visually unsupported details or incorrect temporal relations. Existing mitigation methods typically treat hallucination as a uniform decoding failure, applying globally shared correction rules. We instead observe that decoder layers contribute differently to visual grounding and later linguistic composition, indicating that intervention must be layer-aware. Based on this insight, we propose STEAR, a layer-aware spatiotemporal evidence intervention framework. STEAR identifies high-risk decoding steps and selects token-conditioned visual evidence from grounding-sensitive middle layers. It uses this shared evidence for two coupled purposes: restoring missing local grounding in middle layers, and constructing temporally perturbed patch-level counterfactuals to falsify inconsistent reasoning during late-layer decoding. Consequently, STEAR mitigates both spatial and temporal hallucinations within an efficient single-encode inference framework. Experiments across representative Video-LLM backbones and challenging benchmarks demonstrate that STEAR consistently reduces hallucinations while improving faithfulness, temporal consistency, and robustness. Our results confirm that reliable video decoding relies on intervening on precise evidence at the right layer, rather than enforcing a global penalty. The code is provided in the Supplementary Material.
zh_title: STEAR：用于缓解视频大语言模型幻觉的层级感知时空证据干预方法
translation: 视频大语言模型（Video-LLMs）仍然容易产生时空幻觉，经常生成视觉上不支持的细节或错误的时间关系。现有的缓解方法通常将幻觉视为统一的解码失败，应用全局共享的修正规则。我们观察到解码器层在视觉基础和后续语言合成中的贡献不同，这表明干预必须是层级感知的。基于这一见解，我们提出了STEAR，一个层级感知的时空证据干预框架。STEAR识别高风险解码步骤，并从对基础敏感的中间层选择token条件下的视觉证据。它将这些共享证据用于两个耦合目的：恢复中间层缺失的局部基础，以及构建时间扰动的补丁级反事实，以证伪后期解码过程中的不一致推理。因此，STEAR在高效的单编码推理框架内缓解了空间和时间幻觉。在代表性Video-LLM主干和具有挑战性的基准测试中的实验表明，STEAR一致地减少了幻觉，同时提高了忠实度、时间一致性和鲁棒性。我们的结果证实，可靠的视频解码依赖于在正确的层级上对精确证据进行干预，而不是强制执行全局惩罚。代码在补充材料中提供。
tldr: STEAR通过针对不同解码层实施精准的视觉证据干预，有效解决了视频大模型中的时空幻觉问题。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于打破了将幻觉视为统一解码失败的传统观念，提出了一种基于层级感知（Layer-Aware）的干预机制。通过深入剖析不同解码层在视觉基础（Visual Grounding）和语言合成中的不同作用，STEAR实现了更精细的幻觉控制，为视频大模型的可信推理提供了新思路。

conclusion: STEAR通过层级感知的证据干预，有效地缓解了Video-LLM中的时空幻觉，证明了针对不同解码层进行精准干预优于全局惩罚策略。

title: JoyAI-LLM Flash: Advancing Mid-Scale LLMs with Token Efficiency
authors: Aichen Cai, Anmeng Zhang, Anyu Li, Bo Zhang, Bohua Cai, Chang Li, Changjian Jiang, Changkai Lu, Chao Xue, Chaocai Liang, Cheng Zhang, Dongkai Liu, Fei Wang, Guoqiang Huang, Haijian Ke, Han Lin, Hao Wang, Ji Miao, Jiacheng Zhang, Jialong Shi, Jifeng Zhu, Jingjing Qian, Junhui Luo, Junwu Xiong, Lam So, Liang Huang, Ming Ke, Mingyang Li, Panfeng Shi, Peng Hao, Qi Wang, Qian Lai, Qiaoqiao Yuan, Qingyu Yin, Qiong Cao, Qixiang Wang, Rongcheng Bian, Rongduo Han, Shaoqiang Zheng, Shi Hu, Shi Suo, Shijie Ren, Shijin Zhang, Shiying Fan, Shuai Xie, Tianyi Zhang, Wei Liu, Wentao Tan, Xianghan Meng, Xiaodong He, Xing Pan, Xiran Wang, Xuyang Peng, Ya Zhang, Yang Liu, Yangyang Duan, Yanxu Chen, Yicheng Gong, Yidan Huang, Yifei Liu, Yinhao Bai, Yongqiang Liu, Yuesong Zhang, Yuqi Zhang, Zerui Xie, Zhenfang Wang, Zhennan Shen, Zheyuan Liu, Zhuwei Zeng
abstract: We introduce JoyAI-LLM Flash, an efficient Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model designed to redefine the trade-off between strong performance and token efficiency in the sub-50B parameter regime. JoyAI-LLM Flash is pretrained on a massive corpus of 20 trillion tokens and further optimized through a rigorous post-training pipeline, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) across diverse environments. To improve token efficiency, JoyAI-LLM Flash strategically balances \emph{thinking} and \emph{non-thinking} cognitive modes and introduces FiberPO, a novel RL algorithm inspired by fibration theory that decomposes trust-region maintenance into global and local components, providing unified multi-scale stability control for LLM policy optimization. To enhance architectural sparsity, the model comprises 48B total parameters while activating only 2.7B parameters per forward pass, achieving a substantially higher sparsity ratio than contemporary industry leading models of comparable scale. To further improve inference throughput, we adopt a joint training-inference co-design that incorporates dense Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) and Quantization-Aware Training (QAT). We release the checkpoints for both JoyAI-LLM-48B-A3B Base and its post-trained variants on Hugging Face to support the open-source community.
comment: Xiaodong He is the corresponding author

title: On ANN-enhanced positive invariance for nonlinear flat systems
authors: Huu-Thinh Do, Ionela Prodan
abstract: The concept of positively invariant (PI) sets has proven effective in the formal verification of stability and safety properties for autonomous systems. However, the characterization of such sets is challenging for nonlinear systems in general, especially in the presence of constraints. In this work, we show that, for a class of feedback linearizable systems, called differentially flat systems, a PI set can be derived by leveraging a neural network approximation of the linearizing mapping. More specifically, for the class of flat systems, there exists a linearizing variable transformation that converts the nonlinear system into linear controllable dynamics, albeit at the cost of distorting the constraint set. We show that by approximating the distorted set using a rectified linear unit neural network, we can derive a PI set inside the admissible domain through its set-theoretic description. This offline characterization enables the synthesis of various efficient online control strategies, with different complexities and performances. Numerical simulations are provided to demonstrate the validity of the proposed framework.
zh_title: 关于非线性平坦系统的ANN增强正不变性研究
translation: 正不变（PI）集的概念已被证明在自主系统的稳定性和安全属性的形式化验证中是有效的。然而，对于非线性系统，特别是在存在约束的情况下，这类集合的刻画极具挑战性。在这项工作中，我们证明了对于一类称为微分平坦系统的反馈线性化系统，可以通过利用线性化映射的神经网络逼近来推导PI集。具体而言，对于平坦系统，存在一种线性化变量变换，可以将非线性系统转化为线性可控动力学，但这会以扭曲约束集为代价。我们展示了通过使用修正线性单元（ReLU）神经网络逼近扭曲后的集合，可以通过其集合论描述在容许域内推导出一个PI集。这种离线刻画能够合成各种高效的在线控制策略，具有不同的复杂度和性能。数值仿真验证了所提框架的有效性。
tldr: 通过神经网络逼近微分平坦系统的约束映射，离线构建正不变集，从而实现受限非线性系统的安全在线控制。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地结合了微分平坦系统理论与神经网络逼近，为解决非线性系统在约束条件下的正不变集（PI set）表征问题提供了一种切实可行的离线计算框架，具有很高的工程应用价值。局限性在于该方法仅适用于微分平坦系统，且神经网络逼近带来的误差对系统安全性保证的影响需进一步严谨分析。
motivation: 非线性系统在存在约束的情况下，正不变集（PI set）的刻画非常困难，作者旨在利用微分平坦系统的特性，结合神经网络技术来简化这一过程，以实现更高效的安全控制。
method: 利用神经网络（ReLU）逼近微分平坦系统变换后的非线性约束集，并通过集合论描述，在容许域内推导出系统的正不变集（PI set），进而辅助在线控制策略的合成。
results: 通过仿真实验证明了所提框架的有效性，成功在微分平坦系统中离线构建了正不变集，并为在线控制提供了多种策略。
conclusion: 本文提出了一种利用ReLU神经网络逼近微分平坦系统变换后的约束集，从而离线构建系统正不变集的方法，为非线性系统的安全控制提供了有效的理论支撑。

title: Combining Static Code Analysis and Large Language Models Improves Correctness and Performance of Algorithm Recognition
authors: Denis Neumüller, Sebastian Boll, David Schüler, Matthias Tichy
abstract: Context: Since it is well-established that developers spend a substantial portion of their time understanding source code, the ability to automatically identify algorithms within source code presents a valuable opportunity. This capability can support program comprehension, facilitate maintenance, and enhance overall software quality. Objective: We empirically evaluate how combining LLMs with static code analysis can improve the automated recognition of algorithms, while also evaluating their standalone performance and dependence on identifier names. Method: We perform multiple experiments evaluating the combination of LLMs with static analysis using different filter patterns. We compare this combined approach against their standalone performance under various prompting strategies and investigate the impact of systematic identifier obfuscation on classification performance and runtime. Results: The combination of LLMs with lightweight static analysis performs surprisingly well, reducing required LLM calls by 72.39-97.50% depending on the filter pattern. This not only lowers runtime significantly but also improves F1-scores by up to 12 percentage points (pp) compared to the baseline. Regarding the different prompting strategies, in-context learning with two examples provides an effective trade-off between classification performance and runtime efficiency, achieving F1-scores of 75-77% with only a modest increase in inference time. Lastly, we find that LLMs are not solely dependent on name-information as they are still able to identify most algorithm implementations when identifiers are obfuscated. Conclusion: By combining LLMs with static analysis, we achieve substantial reductions in runtime while simultaneously improving F1-scores, underscoring the value of a hybrid approach.
zh_title: 结合静态代码分析与大语言模型提升算法识别的准确性与性能
translation: 背景：众所周知，开发者花费大量时间理解源代码，因此自动识别源代码中的算法具有重要价值。这一能力可支持程序理解、促进维护并提升软件整体质量。目标：我们实证评估了将LLM与静态代码分析相结合如何改善算法的自动识别，同时评估了它们的独立性能以及对标识符名称的依赖性。方法：我们进行了多项实验，使用不同的过滤模式评估LLM与静态分析的结合。我们将这种组合方法与它们在各种提示策略下的独立性能进行了比较，并调查了系统化标识符混淆对分类性能和运行时间的影响。结果：LLM与轻量级静态分析的结合表现出色，根据过滤模式的不同，减少了72.39%至97.50%的LLM调用需求。这不仅显著降低了运行时间，还使F1分数比基线提高了多达12个百分点。关于不同的提示策略，带有两个示例的上下文学习在分类性能和运行效率之间提供了有效的权衡，在仅略微增加推理时间的情况下实现了75-77%的F1分数。最后，我们发现LLM并不完全依赖名称信息，因为即使在标识符被混淆时，它们仍然能够识别大多数算法实现。结论：通过将LLM与静态分析相结合，我们在大幅减少运行时间的同时提高了F1分数，凸显了混合方法的价值。
tldr: 通过静态分析预筛选，大幅降低了LLM在算法识别任务中的计算成本，并提升了识别准确率。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地提出了一种混合方法，通过引入轻量级静态分析作为预筛选机制，有效解决了LLM在代码分析任务中高计算成本和高延迟的问题。研究不仅展示了性能的提升，还通过标识符混淆实验揭示了LLM在代码语义理解上的鲁棒性。其局限性在于未探讨更复杂的代码结构或跨文件场景下的表现。
motivation: 开发者在理解源代码上耗费大量时间，自动识别源代码中的算法对于提升程序理解、维护和软件质量至关重要，但现有的LLM方法存在计算成本高、效率低的问题。
method: 通过引入不同的过滤模式，将轻量级静态分析与大语言模型相结合；对比了混合方法与独立使用LLM的性能，并采用不同的提示策略（Prompting Strategies）进行实验，同时通过系统化的标识符混淆来测试模型的依赖性。
results: 混合方法将LLM调用次数减少了72.39%至97.50%，显著降低了运行时间，并将F1分数提高了最高12个百分点；研究还发现LLM在标识符混淆后仍具备较强的算法识别能力。
conclusion: 将大语言模型与静态代码分析相结合，是一种能显著降低运行时间并提升算法识别准确率的有效混合策略。

title: MECO: A Multimodal Dataset for Emotion and Cognitive Understanding in Older Adults
authors: Hongbin Chen, Jie Li, Wei Wang, Siyang Song, Xiao Gu, Jianqing Li, Wentao Xiang
abstract: While affective computing has advanced considerably, multimodal emotion prediction in aging populations remains underexplored, largely due to the scarcity of dedicated datasets. Existing multimodal benchmarks predominantly target young, cognitively healthy subjects, neglecting the influence of cognitive decline on emotional expression and physiological responses. To bridge this gap, we present MECO, a Multimodal dataset for Emotion and Cognitive understanding in Older adults. MECO includes 42 participants and provides approximately 38 hours of multimodal signals, yielding 30,592 synchronized samples. To maximize ecological validity, data collection followed standardized protocols within community-based settings. The modalities cover video, audio, electroencephalography (EEG), and electrocardiography (ECG). In addition, the dataset offers comprehensive annotations of emotional and cognitive states, including self-assessed valence, arousal, six basic emotions, and Mini-Mental State Examination cognitive scores. We further establish baseline benchmarks for both emotion and cognitive prediction. MECO serves as a foundational resource for multimodal modeling of affect and cognition in aging populations, facilitating downstream applications such as personalized emotion recognition and early detection of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) in real-world settings. The complete dataset and supplementary materials are available at https://maitrechen.github.io/meco-page/.
zh_title: MECO：一个用于老年人情感与认知理解的多模态数据集
translation: 尽管情感计算已取得显著进展，但针对老年群体的多模态情感预测研究仍未得到充分探索，这主要是由于缺乏专门的数据集。现有的多模态基准测试主要针对年轻且认知健康的受试者，忽略了认知衰退对情感表达和生理反应的影响。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了MECO，一个用于老年人情感与认知理解的多模态数据集。MECO包含42名参与者，提供了约38小时的多模态信号，产生了30,592个同步样本。为了最大化生态效度，数据采集遵循了社区环境中的标准化协议。模态涵盖视频、音频、脑电图（EEG）和心电图（ECG）。此外，该数据集还提供了情感和认知状态的全面标注，包括自我评估的效价、唤醒度、六种基本情绪以及简易精神状态检查（MMSE）认知评分。我们进一步建立了情感和认知预测的基准模型。MECO作为老年人群体情感和认知多模态建模的基础资源，促进了诸如个性化情感识别和现实环境中轻度认知障碍（MCI）早期检测等下游应用。完整数据集及补充材料可在 https://maitrechen.github.io/meco-page/ 获取。
tldr: 本文提出了MECO数据集，旨在解决老年人情感计算研究中缺乏多模态数据的问题，支持情感识别及认知障碍的早期检测。
ai_comments: 该数据集填补了情感计算领域在老年人群体研究上的空白，特别是在考虑认知衰退对情感表达影响方面具有重要意义。其生态效度高，且包含了丰富的多模态生理信号，为情感识别和认知障碍的早期检测提供了宝贵的实验基础。
motivation: 现有情感计算研究多关注年轻且认知健康的群体，忽视了认知衰退对老年人情感表达和生理反应的影响，且缺乏专门针对老年人的多模态基准数据集。
method: 构建了包含42名老年参与者的多模态数据集（视频、音频、EEG、ECG），在社区环境中采集了38小时同步数据，并对情感状态和认知评分进行了全面标注，同时建立了情感与认知预测的基准模型。
results: 成功构建了包含30,592个同步样本的MECO数据集，并完成了情感状态（效价、唤醒度、六种基本情绪）和认知水平（MMSE评分）的基准预测实验。
conclusion: MECO数据集通过提供高质量的老年人多模态数据，为研究情感与认知交互提供了重要资源，有助于推动个性化医疗和认知障碍早期预警技术的发展。

title: A Network Formation Game for Katz Centrality Maximization: A Resource Allocation Perspective
authors: Balaji R, Prashil Wankhede, Pavankumar Tallapragada
abstract: In this paper, we study a network formation game in which agents seek to maximize their influence by allocating constrained resources to choose connections with other agents. In particular, we use Katz centrality to model agents' influence in the network. Allocations are restricted to neighbors in a given unweighted network encoding topological constraints. The allocations by an agent correspond to the weights of its outgoing edges. Such allocation by all agents thereby induces a network. This models a strategic-form game in which agents' utilities are given by their Katz centralities. We characterize the Nash equilibrium networks of this game and analyze their properties. We propose a sequential best-response dynamics (BRD) to model the network formation process. We show that it converges to the set of Nash equilibria under very mild assumptions. For complete underlying topologies, we show that Katz centralities are proportional to agents' budgets at Nash equilibria. For general underlying topologies in which each agent has a self-loop, we show that hierarchical networks form at Nash equilibria. Finally, simulations illustrate our findings.
comment: Submitted to the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC), 2026. (8 pages, 5 figures)
zh_title: 一种Katz中心性最大化的网络形成博弈：资源分配视角
translation: 在本文中，我们研究了一种网络形成博弈，其中智能体试图通过分配受限资源来选择与其他智能体的连接，以最大化自身影响力。特别地，我们使用Katz中心性来建模智能体在网络中的影响力。资源分配受限于给定无权网络中的邻居，这些邻居编码了拓扑约束。智能体的分配对应其出边的权重，所有智能体的分配共同诱导出一个网络。这建模为一个策略型博弈，其中智能体的效用由其Katz中心性给出。我们刻画了该博弈的纳什均衡网络并分析了其性质。我们提出了顺序最佳响应动态（BRD）来建模网络形成过程，并证明了在非常温和的假设下，该动态收敛于纳什均衡集。对于完全底层拓扑，我们证明了在纳什均衡下，Katz中心性与智能体的预算成正比；对于每个智能体都有自环的一般底层拓扑，我们证明了纳什均衡下会形成分层网络。最后，通过仿真验证了我们的发现。
tldr: 本文通过博弈论研究了智能体如何通过分配资源来最大化Katz中心性，分析了网络形成的纳什均衡及其结构特性。
ai_comments: 该论文通过博弈论视角研究网络形成问题，将资源分配与Katz中心性最大化相结合，不仅在理论上刻画了纳什均衡的性质，还提出了收敛性良好的动态过程，为理解社会或经济网络中影响力的竞争提供了有力工具。
motivation: 研究智能体如何在受限资源下通过策略性连接选择来最大化自身在网络中的影响力（即Katz中心性）。
method: 构建基于Katz中心性的资源分配博弈模型，利用纳什均衡分析网络结构，并提出顺序最佳响应动态（BRD）模拟网络形成过程及收敛性。
results: 证明了BRD在温和假设下收敛于纳什均衡；完全拓扑下Katz中心性与预算成正比；一般拓扑（带自环）下纳什均衡网络呈现分层结构。
conclusion: 研究表明，在Katz中心性最大化的博弈中，纳什均衡网络结构受到基础拓扑约束的显著影响，特别是在完全图中与预算成正比，在带有自环的图中倾向于形成分层结构。

title: Querying Structured Data Through Natural Language Using Language Models
authors: Hontan Valentin-Micu, Bunea Andrei-Alexandru, Tantaroudas Nikolaos Dimitrios, Popovici Dan-Matei
abstract: This paper presents an open source methodology for allowing users to query structured non textual datasets through natural language Unlike Retrieval Augmented Generation RAG which struggles with numerical and highly structured information our approach trains an LLM to generate executable queries To support this capability we introduce a principled pipeline for synthetic training data generation producing diverse question answer pairs that capture both user intent and the semantics of the underlying dataset We fine tune a compact model DeepSeek R1 Distill 8B using QLoRA with 4 bit quantization making the system suitable for deployment on commodity hardware We evaluate our approach on a dataset describing accessibility to essential services across Durangaldea Spain The fine tuned model achieves high accuracy across monolingual multilingual and unseen location scenarios demonstrating both robust generalization and reliable query generation Our results highlight that small domain specific models can achieve high precision for this task without relying on large proprietary LLMs making this methodology suitable for resource constrained environments and adaptable to broader multi dataset systems We evaluate our approach on a dataset describing accessibility to essential services across Durangaldea Spain The fine tuned model achieves high accuracy across monolingual multilingual and unseen location scenarios demonstrating both robust generalization and reliable query generation Our results highlight that small domain specific models can achieve high precision for this task without relying on large proprietary LLMs making this methodology suitable for resource constrained environments and adaptable to broader multi dataset systems.
zh_title: 利用语言模型通过自然语言查询结构化数据
translation: 本文提出了一种开源方法，允许用户通过自然语言查询结构化非文本数据集。与在处理数值和高度结构化信息时表现不佳的检索增强生成（RAG）不同，我们的方法训练大语言模型（LLM）来生成可执行的查询。为了支持这一能力，我们引入了一个原则性的合成训练数据生成流水线，产生能够捕捉用户意图和底层数据集语义的多样化问答对。我们使用QLoRA和4位量化对紧凑模型DeepSeek R1 Distill 8B进行微调，使该系统适用于商品级硬件部署。我们在描述西班牙杜兰加尔德亚（Durangaldea）基本服务可及性的数据集上评估了我们的方法。微调后的模型在单语言、多语言和未见过的地点场景中均实现了高准确度，证明了其强大的泛化能力和可靠的查询生成性能。我们的结果强调，小型领域特定模型可以在不依赖大型专有LLM的情况下实现该任务的高精度，使得该方法适用于资源受限的环境，并可适应更广泛的多数据集系统。
tldr: 利用合成数据微调小型LLM，使其能够精准地将自然语言转化为结构化查询，无需依赖大型模型即可在资源受限环境下高效处理数据。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于通过合成数据生成技术，赋能小型语言模型（8B参数）处理复杂的结构化数据查询任务，避开了依赖昂贵的大型专有模型。其核心优势在于在资源受限的环境下实现了高精度的查询生成，并展示了良好的泛化能力，为特定领域的结构化数据交互提供了一种经济且高效的解决方案。
motivation: 现有的检索增强生成（RAG）技术在处理数值型和高度结构化的信息时表现不佳，且大型模型部署成本高，因此需要一种能高效、准确地将自然语言转化为结构化查询的轻量级方法。
method: 提出了一种合成训练数据生成的原则性流水线，通过构建多样化的问答对来捕捉用户意图和数据集语义；利用QLoRA和4位量化技术，对DeepSeek R1 Distill 8B模型进行微调。
results: 在Durangaldea地区服务可及性数据集上的评估表明，微调后的模型在单语言、多语言和未见过的场景中均表现出高准确率，且具备较强的泛化能力和可靠的查询生成性能。
conclusion: 研究表明，通过针对性的合成数据微调，小参数模型能够精准地将自然语言转化为结构化查询，为资源受限环境下的数据分析提供了可行的路径。

title: Verbalizing LLMs' assumptions to explain and control sycophancy
authors: Myra Cheng, Isabel Sieh, Humishka Zope, Sunny Yu, Lujain Ibrahim, Aryaman Arora, Jared Moore, Desmond Ong, Dan Jurafsky, Diyi Yang
abstract: LLMs can be socially sycophantic, affirming users when they ask questions like "am I in the wrong?" rather than providing genuine assessment. We hypothesize that this behavior arises from incorrect assumptions about the user, like underestimating how often users are seeking information over reassurance. We present Verbalized Assumptions, a framework for eliciting these assumptions from LLMs. Verbalized Assumptions provide insight into LLM sycophancy, delusion, and other safety issues, e.g., the top bigram in LLMs' assumptions on social sycophancy datasets is ``seeking validation.'' We provide evidence for a causal link between Verbalized Assumptions and sycophantic model behavior: our assumption probes (linear probes trained on internal representations of these assumptions) enable interpretable fine-grained steering of social sycophancy. We explore why LLMs default to sycophantic assumptions: on identical queries, people expect more objective and informative responses from AI than from other humans, but LLMs trained on human-human conversation do not account for this difference in expectations. Our work contributes a new understanding of assumptions as a mechanism for sycophancy.
zh_title: 言语化大语言模型的假设以解释和控制顺从性
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）可能表现出社会顺从性，即当用户问“我是不是错了？”之类的问题时，模型倾向于肯定用户，而不是提供真正的评估。我们假设这种行为源于对用户的不正确假设，例如低估了用户寻求信息而非寻求安慰的频率。我们提出了“言语化假设”（Verbalized Assumptions），这是一个从LLM中引出这些假设的框架。言语化假设为理解LLM的顺从性、幻觉和其他安全问题提供了见解，例如，在社会顺从性数据集上，LLM假设中的最高频双词是“寻求验证”。我们提供了言语化假设与顺从模型行为之间存在因果联系的证据：我们的假设探针（在这些假设的内部表征上训练的线性探针）实现了对社会顺从性的可解释的细粒度控制。我们探讨了为什么LLM默认为顺从性假设：在相同的查询下，人们期望AI提供比其他人类更客观和信息丰富的回应，但接受过人与人之间对话训练的LLM并没有考虑到这种期望差异。我们的工作通过将假设视为顺从的机制，贡献了一种新的理解。
tldr: 通过提取并干预大语言模型对用户意图的内部假设，成功解释并实现了对模型顺从行为的控制。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将LLM的顺从行为归因于内部的“假设”，并通过提取和干预这些假设实现了对模型行为的可解释性控制，为理解大模型偏见和安全性问题提供了新视角。
motivation: LLM倾向于顺从用户而非提供客观评估，研究人员推测这是由于模型对用户意图（如寻求验证而非信息）存在错误假设所致。
method: 提出了“言语化假设（Verbalized Assumptions）”框架，用于从LLM中提取其对用户的内部假设；并训练线性探针（assumption probes）作用于内部表征，实现对顺从行为的精细化干预和控制。
results: 实验表明，LLM的顺从行为与特定的内部假设（如“寻求验证”）有因果联系；通过所提出的探针技术，可以成功实现对模型社会顺从行为的可解释性控制。
conclusion: 研究证实了LLM的顺从行为源于其对用户意图的错误假设，通过显式化并干预这些假设，可以有效解释并控制模型的顺从行为。

title: Proceedings of the 7th Workshop on Models for Formal Analysis of Real Systems
authors: Maurice H. ter Beek, Gregor Gössler
abstract:
These proceedings contain the papers that were presented at the 7th Workshop on Models for Formal Analysis of Real Systems (MARS 2026), which took place on 12 April 2026 in Turin, Italy, as a satellite event of the 29th International Joint Conferences on Theory and Practice of Software (ETAPS 2026). 
  The goal of MARS is to bring together researchers from different communities who are developing formal models of real systems in areas where complex models occur (e.g., networks, cyber-physical systems, hardware/software codesign, biology). The motivation for MARS stems from the following two observations: 
  - Large case studies are essential to show that specification formalisms and modelling techniques are applicable to real systems, whereas many papers only consider toy examples or tiny case studies. 
  - Developing an accurate model of a real system takes a large amount of time, often months or years. In most papers, however, salient details of the model need to be skipped due to lack of space, and to leave room for formal verification methodologies and results. 
  MARS aims at remedying these issues, emphasising modelling over verification, so as to retain lessons learned from formal modelling, which are not usually discussed elsewhere, and which may lay the basis for future analysis and comparison.
zh_title: 第7届真实系统形式化分析模型研讨会论文集
translation: 本论文集收录了第7届真实系统形式化分析模型研讨会（MARS 2026）上发表的论文。该研讨会于2026年4月12日在意大利都灵举行，是第29届国际软件理论与实践联合会议（ETAPS 2026）的卫星会议。MARS 的目标是汇集来自不同领域的研究人员，共同开发复杂系统（如网络、信息物理系统、软硬件协同设计、生物系统）的形式化模型。MARS 的动机源于以下两点观察：- 大规模案例研究对于证明规范形式和建模技术适用于真实系统至关重要，而许多论文仅考虑玩具示例或微小的案例研究。- 开发一个真实的系统精确模型需要大量时间，往往耗时数月或数年。然而，在大多数论文中，由于空间限制，模型的显著细节往往被省略，以便为形式验证方法和结果留出空间。MARS 旨在解决这些问题，强调建模胜过验证，以保留从形式建模中获得的经验教训，这些经验通常不会在其他地方讨论，并可能为未来的分析和比较奠定基础。
tldr: MARS 2026 研讨会专注于复杂真实系统的形式化建模，通过分享详细的建模案例与经验，弥补了现有文献中对建模过程描述不足的问题。
ai_comments: 该研讨会聚焦于形式化验证领域中常被忽视的“建模”环节，强调了真实系统案例研究的重要性。通过为复杂系统建模提供专门的交流平台，该研讨会弥补了学术界过度关注算法验证而忽略建模细节的不足，对于推动形式化方法在工业界的实际应用具有重要价值。
motivation: 当前学术界存在两方面问题：一是许多论文仅使用简单的玩具案例，缺乏对真实复杂系统的支持；二是由于篇幅限制，研究人员在论文中往往被迫省略繁琐但关键的建模细节，导致宝贵的建模经验无法得到有效传承。
method: 通过举办专题研讨会，鼓励研究人员提交并分享关于真实系统（如网络、信息物理系统、软硬件协同设计、生物系统）的形式化建模案例，重点展示建模过程中的细节、挑战及经验教训，而非仅仅关注最终的验证结果。
results: 汇编了在 MARS 2026 研讨会上发表的论文，这些论文通过详细的案例研究，记录了对各类复杂真实系统进行形式化建模的经验，为未来的分析和比较研究奠定了基础。
conclusion: MARS 研讨会通过强调建模过程本身，为形式化方法领域提供了一个分享真实系统建模经验、挑战及教训的独特平台，旨在促进该领域从单纯的算法验证向更全面、更具实践意义的系统分析演进。

title: Can Nano Banana 2 Replace Traditional Image Restoration Models? An Evaluation of Its Performance on Image Restoration Tasks
authors: Weixiong Sun, Xiang Yin, Chao Dong
abstract: Recent advances in generative AI raise the question of whether general-purpose image editing models can serve as unified solutions for image restoration. In this work, we conduct a systematic evaluation of Nano Banana 2 for image restoration across diverse scenes and degradation types. Our results show that prompt design plays a critical role, where concise prompts with explicit fidelity constraints achieve the best trade-off between reconstruction accuracy and perceptual quality. Compared with state-of-the-art restoration models, Nano Banana 2 achieves superior performance in full-reference metrics while remaining competitive in perceptual quality, which is further supported by user studies. We also observe strong generalization in challenging scenarios, such as small faces, dense crowds, and severe degradations. However, the model remains sensitive to prompt formulation and may require iterative refinement for optimal results. Overall, our findings suggest that general-purpose generative models hold strong potential as unified image restoration solvers, while highlighting the importance of controllability and robustness. All test results are available on https://github.com/yxyuanxiao/NanoBanana2TestOnIR.
zh_title: Nano Banana 2 能否取代传统图像修复模型？其在图像修复任务上的性能评估
translation: 生成式AI的最新进展引发了一个问题：通用的图像编辑模型能否作为图像修复的统一解决方案？在这项工作中，我们对Nano Banana 2在各种场景和退化类型下的图像修复能力进行了系统评估。结果表明，提示词设计起着至关重要的作用，简洁且带有明确保真约束的提示词在重构精度和感知质量之间达到了最佳平衡。与最先进的修复模型相比，Nano Banana 2在全参考指标上表现优异，在感知质量方面也具有竞争力，这一点得到了用户研究的进一步支持。我们还观察到该模型在小人脸、密集人群和严重退化等挑战性场景中具有很强的泛化能力。然而，该模型对提示词的表达仍然敏感，可能需要迭代细化才能获得最佳结果。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，通用生成模型作为统一图像修复求解器具有强大的潜力，同时也突出了可控性和鲁棒性的重要性。所有测试结果均可在 https://github.com/yxyuanxiao/NanoBanana2TestOnIR 获取。
tldr: 研究发现通用模型Nano Banana 2在图像修复任务上表现出色，甚至优于传统模型，但其效果高度依赖提示词的设计。
ai_comments: 该研究通过系统评估验证了通用生成模型（如Nano Banana 2）在图像修复领域的潜力，指出了提示工程（Prompt Engineering）对修复效果的关键影响。其创新点在于将通用模型应用于特定任务并证明了其在某些指标上优于专用模型，但也揭示了该类模型在稳定性和提示依赖性方面的局限性。
motivation: 随着生成式AI的发展，研究者试图探讨通用图像编辑模型是否能够替代专门的图像修复模型，从而成为一种统一的解决方案。
method: 通过在多种场景和退化类型下对Nano Banana 2进行系统评估，重点探讨不同提示设计对重构精度和感知质量的影响，并与现有最先进的修复模型进行了对比实验和用户研究。
results: Nano Banana 2在全参考指标上表现优异，感知质量具有竞争力，并在小人脸、密集人群和严重退化等挑战性场景中表现出强大的泛化能力；但模型对提示词非常敏感，往往需要迭代优化才能获得最佳效果。
conclusion: 通用生成式模型有望成为统一的图像修复解决方案，但未来研究需进一步提升其提示词的鲁棒性和处理过程的自动化程度。

title: Joint Prediction of Human Motions and Actions in Human-Robot Collaboration
authors: Alessandra Bulanti, Alessandro Carfì, Fulvio Mastrogiovanni
abstract: Fluent human--robot collaboration requires robots to continuously estimate human behaviour and anticipate future intentions. This entails reasoning jointly about \emph{continuous movements} and \emph{discrete actions}, which are still largely modelled in isolation. In this paper, we introduce \textsf{MA-HERP}, a hierarchical and recursive probabilistic framework for the \emph{joint estimation and prediction} of human movements and actions. The model combines: (i) a hierarchical representation in which movements compose into actions through admissible Allen interval relations, (ii) a unified probabilistic factorisation coupling continuous dynamics, discrete labels, and durations, and (iii) a recursive inference scheme inspired by Bayesian filtering, alternating top-down action prediction with bottom-up sensory evidence. We present a preliminary experimental evaluation based on neural models trained on musculoskeletal simulations of reaching movements, showing accurate motion prediction, robust action inference under noise, and computational performance compatible with on-line human--robot collaboration.
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE AIM 2026
zh_title: 人机协作中人体动作与行为的联合预测
translation: 流畅的人机协作要求机器人不断估计人类行为并预测未来的意图。这需要对连续运动和离散动作进行联合推理，而目前这两者在建模时往往是孤立的。在本文中，我们引入了MA-HERP，这是一个用于联合估计和预测人体运动与动作的层次化递归概率框架。该模型结合了：(i) 一种层次化表示，其中运动通过可容许的Allen区间关系组合成动作；(ii) 一种耦合了连续动力学、离散标签和持续时间的统一概率因子分解；以及 (iii) 一种受贝叶斯滤波启发的递归推理方案，交替进行自顶向下的动作预测与自底向上的感官证据更新。我们基于在肌肉骨骼抓取运动模拟上训练的神经模型进行了初步实验评估，结果显示该方法在噪声下具有准确的运动预测、稳健的行为推理，以及与在线人机协作兼容的计算性能。
tldr: 提出了一种名为MA-HERP的框架，通过层次化建模和递归推理，实现了人体连续动作与离散意图的实时联合预测，提升了人机协作的流畅度。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于成功将连续的人体动作预测与离散的行为意图识别结合在一个统一的概率框架中。通过引入Allen区间关系来处理动作的层次结构，并采用递归推理方案，解决了人机协作中实时性的难题。该方法在处理噪声和计算效率方面表现出色，为更自然的人机交互提供了重要参考。
motivation: 在人机协作中，机器人需要实时估计人类行为并预测未来意图，而目前对连续动作和离散行为的研究大多是孤立进行的，缺乏联合建模。
method: 提出了MA-HERP框架，包含：(1) 基于Allen区间关系的层次化表示；(2) 耦合连续动力学、离散标签和持续时间的统一概率因子分解；(3) 结合自顶向下动作预测与自底向上感官证据的递归推理方案。
results: 实验表明，该模型在肌肉骨骼模拟的抓取运动中实现了准确的运动预测，在噪声环境下具有稳健的行为推理能力，且计算性能满足在线人机协作需求。
conclusion: MA-HERP框架通过结合层次化动作表示与递归推理，实现了人体连续运动与离散动作的高效联合预测，能够满足人机协作对实时性和准确性的要求。

title: Gram-MMD: A Texture-Aware Metric for Image Realism Assessment
authors: Joé Napolitano, Pascal Nguyen
abstract: Evaluating the realism of generated images remains a fundamental challenge in generative modeling. Existing distributional metrics such as the Frechet Inception Distance (FID) and CLIP-MMD (CMMD) compare feature distributions at a semantic level but may overlook fine-grained textural information that can be relevant for distinguishing real from generated images. We introduce Gram-MMD (GMMD), a realism metric that leverages Gram matrices computed from intermediate activations of pretrained backbone networks to capture correlations between feature maps. By extracting the upper-triangular part of these symmetric Gram matrices and measuring the Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) between an anchor distribution of real images and an evaluation distribution, GMMD produces a representation that encodes textural and structural characteristics at a finer granularity than global embeddings. To select the hyperparameters of the metric, we employ a meta-metric protocol based on controlled degradations applied to MS-COCO images, measuring monotonicity via Spearman's rank correlation and Kendall's tau. We conduct experiments on both the KADID-10k database and the RAISE realness assessment dataset using various backbone architectures, including DINOv2, DC-AE, Stable Diffusion's VAE encoder, VGG19, and the AlexNet backbone from LPIPS, among others. We also demonstrate on a cross-domain driving scenario (KITTI / Virtual KITTI / Stanford Cars) that CMMD can incorrectly rank real images as less realistic than synthetic ones due to its semantic bias, while GMMD preserves the correct ordering. Our results suggest that GMMD captures complementary information to existing semantic-level metrics.
zh_title: Gram-MMD：一种用于图像真实感评估的纹理感知指标
translation: 评估生成图像的真实感仍然是生成建模中的一个基本挑战。现有的分布指标，如Frechet Inception Distance (FID) 和 CLIP-MMD (CMMD)，在语义层面比较特征分布，但可能忽略了对于区分真实图像和生成图像至关重要的细粒度纹理信息。我们引入了Gram-MMD (GMMD)，这是一种真实感指标，它利用从预训练骨干网络中间激活层计算出的Gram矩阵来捕捉特征图之间的相关性。通过提取这些对称Gram矩阵的上三角部分并测量真实图像锚点分布与评估分布之间的最大均值差异 (MMD)，GMMD生成了一种比全局嵌入更细粒度地编码纹理和结构特征的表示。为了选择该指标的超参数，我们采用了基于对MS-COCO图像应用受控退化的元指标协议，通过Spearman秩相关系数和Kendall's tau测量单调性。我们在KADID-10k数据库和RAISE真实感评估数据集上，使用包括DINOv2、DC-AE、Stable Diffusion的VAE编码器、VGG19以及来自LPIPS的AlexNet骨干网络等多种架构进行了实验。我们还在跨域驾驶场景（KITTI / Virtual KITTI / Stanford Cars）中证明，由于CMMD的语义偏差，它可能会错误地将真实图像的真实感排在合成图像之后，而GMMD则保持了正确的排序。我们的结果表明，GMMD捕获了与现有语义级指标互补的信息。
tldr: Gram-MMD通过分析特征图的Gram矩阵捕捉细粒度纹理，解决了现有评价指标忽视图像纹理细节导致真实感评估不准确的问题。
ai_comments: 该论文针对现有图像评价指标（如FID、CMMD）忽视纹理细节的局限性，创新性地引入了基于Gram矩阵的度量方法。这种方法能够捕捉特征图之间的相关性，从而更敏感地反映图像的纹理和结构特征，是现有语义级指标的重要补充。其局限性在于可能对全局语义信息的捕捉能力弱于传统指标，建议在实际应用中结合使用。
motivation: 现有的分布指标（如FID和CMMD）主要关注语义层面的特征分布比较，往往忽视了对于区分真实图像与生成图像至关重要的细粒度纹理信息。
method: 通过预训练网络中间激活层计算Gram矩阵，提取其上三角部分以编码纹理和结构信息，并计算真实图像锚点分布与评估分布之间的最大均值差异（MMD）。利用基于受控退化图像的元指标协议来优化超参数。
results: 实验表明，GMMD在KADID-10k和RAISE数据集上表现良好；在跨域驾驶场景中，GMMD能够正确识别真实图像的真实感排名，而CMMD因语义偏差导致排名错误，证明了GMMD提供了与语义级指标互补的信息。
conclusion: GMMD是一种有效的图像真实感评估指标，能够捕捉细粒度的纹理和结构特征，弥补了现有基于语义的评估指标在纹理细节方面的不足，在多项实验中表现出比CMMD更好的鲁棒性。

title: SparseSplat: Towards Applicable Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Pixel-Unaligned Prediction
authors: Zicheng Zhang, Xiangting Meng, Ke Wu, Wenchao Ding
abstract: Recent progress in feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has notably improved rendering quality. However, the spatially uniform and highly redundant 3DGS map generated by previous feed-forward 3DGS methods limits their integration into downstream reconstruction tasks. We propose SparseSplat, the first feed-forward 3DGS model that adaptively adjusts Gaussian density according to scene structure and information richness of local regions, yielding highly compact 3DGS maps. To achieve this, we propose entropy-based probabilistic sampling, generating large, sparse Gaussians in textureless areas and assigning small, dense Gaussians to regions with rich information. Additionally, we designed a specialized point cloud network that efficiently encodes local context and decodes it into 3DGS attributes, addressing the receptive field mismatch between the general 3DGS optimization pipeline and feed-forward models. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that SparseSplat can achieve state-of-the-art rendering quality with only 22% of the Gaussians and maintain reasonable rendering quality with only 1.5% of the Gaussians. Project page: https://victkk.github.io/SparseSplat-page/.
zh_title: SparseSplat：面向可应用的前馈3D高斯溅射与像素非对齐预测
translation: 近期前馈3D高斯溅射（3DGS）的研究显著提升了渲染质量。然而，现有前馈3DGS方法生成的空间均匀且高度冗余的3DGS地图限制了其在下游重建任务中的集成。我们提出了SparseSplat，这是首个根据场景结构和局部区域信息丰富度自适应调整高斯密度的前馈3DGS模型，能够生成高度紧凑的3DGS地图。为此，我们提出了基于熵的概率采样方法，在无纹理区域生成大而稀疏的高斯，并为信息丰富的区域分配小而密集的高斯。此外，我们设计了一个专门的点云网络，能够高效编码局部上下文并将其解码为3DGS属性，解决了通用3DGS优化流程与前馈模型之间的感受野不匹配问题。广泛的实验结果表明，SparseSplat仅需22%的高斯数量即可达到最先进的渲染质量，且在仅使用1.5%的高斯数量时仍能保持合理的渲染质量。
tldr: SparseSplat通过自适应调整高斯密度，以极少的高斯数量实现了高质量的场景渲染，显著提升了前馈3DGS的实用性。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地解决了前馈3DGS模型中高冗余和空间均匀分布的问题，通过引入基于熵的自适应采样机制，实现了高效的稀疏表示。其主要贡献在于提升了模型在下游任务中的适用性，并在极低的高斯数量下依然保持了良好的渲染质量，具有很强的实用价值。
motivation: 现有前馈3DGS方法生成的地图过于均匀且冗余度极高，限制了其在下游重建任务中的应用。
method: 1. 提出基于熵的概率采样方法，根据场景信息丰富度自适应调整高斯密度；2. 设计专门的点云网络以有效编码局部上下文并解码为3DGS属性，解决感受野不匹配问题。
results: SparseSplat在仅使用22%的高斯数量时达到SOTA渲染质量，在仅使用1.5%的高斯数量时仍能维持合理的渲染效果。
conclusion: SparseSplat通过自适应高斯密度分配和高效的点云编码架构，成功实现了高质量且极度压缩的前馈3DGS模型，为3D场景的高效表示提供了新方案。

title: Credential Leakage in LLM Agent Skills: A Large-Scale Empirical Study
authors: Zhihao Chen, Ying Zhang, Yi Liu, Gelei Deng, Yuekang Li, Yanjun Zhang, Jianting Ning, Leo Yu Zhang, Lei Ma, Zhiqiang Li
abstract: Third-party skills extend LLM agents with powerful capabilities but often handle sensitive credentials in privileged environments, making leakage risks poorly understood. We present the first large-scale empirical study of this problem, analyzing 17,022 skills (sampled from 170,226 on SkillsMP) using static analysis, sandbox testing, and manual inspection. We identify 520 vulnerable skills with 1,708 issues and derive a taxonomy of 10 leakage patterns (4 accidental and 6 adversarial). We find that (1) leakage is fundamentally cross-modal: 76.3% require joint analysis of code and natural language, while 3.1% arise purely from prompt injection; (2) debug logging is the primary vector, with print and console.log causing 73.5% of leaks due to stdout exposure to LLMs; and (3) leaked credentials are both exploitable (89.6% without privileges) and persistent, as forks retain secrets even after upstream fixes. After disclosure, all malicious skills were removed and 91.6% of hardcoded credentials were fixed. We release our dataset, taxonomy, and detection pipeline to support future research.
zh_title: LLM代理技能中的凭据泄露：一项大规模实证研究
translation: 第三方技能扩展了LLM代理的强大功能，但它们往往在特权环境中处理敏感凭据，导致泄露风险尚未被充分理解。我们对该问题进行了首次大规模实证研究，使用静态分析、沙箱测试和人工检查分析了17,022个技能（从SkillsMP的170,226个技能中采样）。我们识别出520个易受攻击的技能，包含1,708个问题，并推导出10种泄露模式的分类学（4种意外，6种对抗）。我们发现：(1) 泄露本质上是跨模态的：76.3%需要联合分析代码和自然语言，而3.1%纯粹由提示注入引起；(2) 调试日志是主要载体，print和console.log导致了73.5%的泄露，原因在于标准输出被暴露给LLM；(3) 泄露的凭据既可被利用（89.6%无需特权），又具有持久性，因为即使在上游修复后，分支仍保留秘密。披露后，所有恶意技能被移除，91.6%的硬编码凭据得到修复。我们发布了数据集、分类学和检测流水线以支持未来研究。
tldr: 研究发现LLM代理技能中存在广泛的凭据泄露风险，主要源于开发者的调试日志输出，且这些漏洞往往需要同时分析代码与自然语言才能被发现。
ai_comments: 该研究揭示了LLM代理生态系统中一个被严重忽视的安全盲点。其创新之处在于将静态分析、沙箱测试与人工审计结合，对大规模技能库进行了实证分析。研究不仅量化了凭据泄露的严重性，还通过分类学总结了泄露模式，为提升AI代理的供应链安全性提供了重要的理论基础和实践参考。
motivation: 由于第三方技能在LLM代理中广泛使用且常处理敏感凭据，但目前缺乏对其泄露风险的系统性了解，因此需要开展实证研究以评估该安全威胁。
method: 通过静态分析、沙箱测试和人工检查，对17,022个技能进行了大规模实证研究，并构建了10种泄露模式的分类学。
results: 发现520个易受攻击的技能，存在1,708个问题；指出调试日志（如print/console.log）是泄露的主要来源，且76.3%的泄露需要结合代码与自然语言分析才能发现。大部分泄露的凭据具备高度可利用性且具有持久性。
conclusion: LLM代理技能中的凭据泄露问题普遍且严重，主要由开发者不当的调试日志记录引起。研究强调了跨模态分析（代码与自然语言）在检测此类漏洞中的必要性，并呼吁加强对代理程序中凭据生命周期的管理。

title: Redefining End-of-Life: Intelligent Automation for Electronics Remanufacturing Systems
authors: Sibo Tian, Xiao Liang, Sara Behdad, Minghui Zheng
abstract: Remanufacturing is fundamentally more challenging than traditional manufacturing due to the significant uncertainty, variability, and incompleteness inherent in end-of-life (EoL) products. At the same time, it has become increasingly essential and urgent for facilitating a circular economy, driven by the growing volume of discarded electronic products and the escalating scarcity of critical materials. In this paper, we review the existing literature and examine the key challenges as well as emerging opportunities in intelligent automation for EoL electronics remanufacturing, providing a comprehensive overview of how robotics, control, and artificial intelligence (AI) can jointly enable scalable, safe, and intelligent remanufacturing systems. This paper starts with the definition, scope, and motivation of remanufacturing within the context of a circular economy, highlighting its societal and environmental significance. Then it delves into intelligent automation approaches for disassembly, inspection, sorting, and component reprocessing in this domain, covering advanced methods for multimodal perception, decision-making under uncertainty, flexible planning algorithms, and force-aware manipulation. The paper further reviews several emerging techniques, including large foundation models, human-in-the-loop integration, and digital twins that have the potential to support future research in this area. By integrating these topics, we aim to illustrate how next-generation remanufacturing systems can achieve robust, adaptable, and efficient operation in the face of complex real-world challenges.
comment: Accepted at the American Control Conference (ACC) 2026; to appear in the proceedings
zh_title: 重新定义报废处理：电子产品再制造系统的智能自动化
translation: 再制造从根本上比传统制造更具挑战性，因为报废（EoL）产品具有显著的不确定性、变异性和不完整性。同时，受废弃电子产品数量增长和关键材料日益稀缺的推动，再制造对于促进循环经济变得越来越重要和紧迫。在本文中，我们回顾了现有文献，并审视了电子产品EoL再制造在智能自动化方面面临的关键挑战和新兴机遇，全面概述了机器人、控制和人工智能（AI）如何共同实现可扩展、安全和智能的再制造系统。本文首先介绍了循环经济背景下再制造的定义、范畴和动机，强调了其社会和环境意义。随后深入探讨了该领域在拆解、检测、分拣和组件再加工方面的智能自动化方法，涵盖了多模态感知、不确定性下的决策、灵活规划算法和力感知操作等先进方法。本文进一步回顾了包括大型基础模型、人机协作集成和数字孪生在内的几种新兴技术，这些技术有望支持该领域的未来研究。通过整合这些主题，我们旨在阐明下一代再制造系统如何在面对复杂的现实世界挑战时实现稳健、适应性强和高效的运行。
tldr: 本文综述了利用AI、机器人和自动化技术解决电子产品再制造过程中面临的高度不确定性难题，以推动循环经济发展。
ai_comments: 该论文通过综述的形式，系统性地梳理了智能自动化技术在电子产品再制造领域的应用。其创新点在于将机器人学、控制理论与人工智能（包括大模型、数字孪生）有机结合，为解决再制造过程中的高度不确定性提供了前瞻性视角。该研究对推动循环经济和电子废弃物处理具有重要学术和工业价值，但在具体实施的经济成本与技术落地难度上仍需进一步探索。
motivation: 电子废弃物激增与关键材料匮乏使得再制造变得愈发迫切，但传统再制造因EoL产品的高度不确定性、变异性和不完整性而面临巨大挑战，亟需智能自动化技术来实现规模化与智能化处理。
method: 本文通过文献综述方法，分析了再制造领域的挑战与机遇，并探讨了多模态感知、不确定性下的决策、灵活规划算法、力感知操作，以及大基础模型、人机协作和数字孪生等前沿技术在拆解、检测、分拣和再加工中的应用。
results: 研究概述了如何通过集成机器人、控制和AI技术，构建可扩展、安全且智能的再制造系统，并指出了未来研究的方向，如利用大模型和数字孪生技术提升系统的鲁棒性与自适应能力。
conclusion: 智能自动化技术（如机器人、AI、数字孪生）是实现电子产品高效、安全再制造的关键，能够有效应对EoL产品处理中的不确定性挑战，从而有力支撑循环经济的发展。

title: MI-Pruner: Crossmodal Mutual Information-guided Token Pruner for Efficient MLLMs
authors: Jiameng Li, Aleksei Tiulpin, Matthew B. Blaschko
abstract: For multimodal large language models (MLLMs), visual information is relatively sparse compared with text. As a result, research on visual pruning emerges for efficient inference. Current approaches typically measure token importance based on the attention scores in the visual encoder or in the LLM decoder, then select visual tokens with high attention scores while pruning others. In this paper, we pursue a different and more surgical approach. Instead of relying on mechanism-specific signals, we directly compute Mutual Information (MI) between visual and textual features themselves, prior to their interaction. This allows us to explicitly measure crossmodal dependency at the feature levels. Our MI-Pruner is simple, efficient and non-intrusive, requiring no access to internal attention maps or architectural modifications. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms previous attention-based pruning methods with minimal latency.
zh_title: MI-Pruner：用于高效多模态大模型的跨模态互信息引导Token剪枝器
translation: 对于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）而言，视觉信息相较于文本信息相对稀疏。因此，针对高效推理的视觉剪枝研究应运而生。目前的方法通常基于视觉编码器或LLM解码器中的注意力分数来衡量Token的重要性，并选择高分Token保留，剪枝其余部分。在本文中，我们采用了一种不同且更具针对性的方法。我们不依赖于特定机制的信号，而是在视觉和文本特征交互之前，直接计算它们之间的互信息（MI）。这使我们能够在特征层面显式地衡量跨模态依赖。我们的MI-Pruner简单、高效且非侵入式，无需访问内部注意力图或进行架构修改。实验结果表明，我们的方法在最小化延迟的同时，性能优于以往基于注意力的剪枝方法。
tldr: MI-Pruner通过计算视觉与文本特征间的互信息，在无需修改模型架构的情况下，实现了比传统注意力机制更高效、更精准的多模态模型视觉Token剪枝。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的基于互信息（MI）的视觉Token剪枝方法，摆脱了对注意力机制的依赖，具有更好的通用性和低侵入性，为多模态大模型的推理加速提供了新的视角。
motivation: 现有视觉剪枝方法过度依赖注意力分数，忽略了跨模态特征间的直接依赖关系；为了实现更高效的推理，需要一种更直接、更精准的评估视觉Token重要性的方法。
method: 提出MI-Pruner方法，在视觉与文本特征交互前，直接计算两者之间的互信息（MI）来评估视觉Token的重要性，而非依赖注意力分数。该方法具有非侵入性，无需修改模型架构或访问内部注意力图。
results: 实验结果表明，MI-Pruner在多模态大模型推理中优于现有的基于注意力的剪枝方法，并能以极小的延迟代价实现高效的视觉Token裁剪。
conclusion: MI-Pruner通过直接量化跨模态特征间的依赖关系，实现了比传统注意力机制更高效、更精确的视觉Token剪枝，在保持模型性能的同时降低了推理延迟。

title: Automatic Textbook Formalization
authors: Fabian Gloeckle, Ahmad Rammal, Charles Arnal, Remi Munos, Vivien Cabannes, Gabriel Synnaeve, Amaury Hayat
abstract: We present a case study where an automatic AI system formalizes a textbook with more than 500 pages of graduate-level algebraic combinatorics to Lean. The resulting formalization represents a new milestone in textbook formalization scale and proficiency, moving from early results in undergraduate topology and restructuring of existing library content to a full standalone formalization of a graduate textbook. The formalization comprises 130K lines of code and 5900 Lean declarations and was conducted within one week by a total of 30K Claude 4.5 Opus agents collaborating in parallel on a shared code base via version control, simultaneously setting a record in multi-agent software engineering with usable results. The inference cost matches or undercuts what we estimate as the salaries required for a team of human experts, and we expect there is still the potential for large efficiencies to be made without the need for better models. We make our code, the resulting Lean code base and a side-by-side blueprint website available open-source.
zh_title: 教科书的自动形式化
translation: 我们展示了一个案例研究，其中一个自动AI系统将一本超过500页的研究生水平代数组合数学教科书形式化为Lean代码。所得的形式化成果代表了教科书形式化规模和能力的一个新里程碑，从本科拓扑学的早期成果和现有库内容的重构，转向了研究生教科书的完整独立形式化。该形式化包含13万行代码和5900个Lean声明，并在总共3万个Claude 4.5 Opus智能体通过版本控制在共享代码库上并行协作的情况下，于一周内完成，同时创下了具有可用结果的多智能体软件工程记录。推理成本匹配或低于我们估计的人类专家团队所需薪资，并且我们预计在无需更好模型的情况下，仍有巨大的效率提升潜力。我们开源了我们的代码、生成的Lean代码库以及一个并排的蓝图网站。
tldr: 利用3万个Claude 4.5 Opus智能体在一周内将一本500页的研究生数学教科书转化为Lean形式化代码，实现了数学证明自动化的新突破。
ai_comments: 这是一项里程碑式的工作，展示了AI在复杂数学推理和软件工程自动化方面的巨大潜力。通过大规模多智能体协作（3万个Claude 4.5 Opus实例）在极短时间内完成研究生水平教科书的正式化，验证了AI在科学研究辅助领域的生产力。其局限性可能在于对复杂数学概念的深度理解准确性，以及在大规模协作中潜在的错误累积问题。
motivation: 为了探索AI在自动化数学定理证明与教科书形式化方面的规模化能力，并验证多智能体协作在复杂软件工程任务中的表现。
method: 利用3万个Claude 4.5 Opus智能体通过并行协作和版本控制，将一本超过500页的研究生代数组合数学教科书转化为Lean代码。
results: 成功生成了13万行Lean代码和5900个声明，耗时仅一周，且推理成本与人类专家团队相当，同时创下了多智能体软件工程的规模记录。
conclusion: 该研究证明了利用大规模并行AI智能体进行大规模数学教科书形式化是切实可行的，在效率和成本上具有与人类专家团队竞争的潜力。

title: A Construction of $C^{r}$ Conforming Finite Elements on the Alfeld Split in Any Dimension
authors: Ting Lin, Hendrik Speleers, Qingyu Wu
abstract: Constructing $C^r$ conforming finite element spaces in any dimension is a long-standing problem. For general triangulations, this problem was recently addressed by Hu-Lin-Wu (2024), under certain conditions on supersmoothness and polynomial degree. In this paper, a first unified construction on the Alfeld split in any dimension is given, where the supersmoothness conditions and the polynomial degree requirement are relaxed.
zh_title: 任意维度下Alfeld剖分上$C^r$协调有限元的构造方法
translation: 在任意维度下构造$C^r$协调有限元空间是一个长期存在的问题。对于一般的三角剖分，这个问题最近由Hu-Lin-Wu (2024)在超光滑性和多项式次数的特定条件下得到了解决。在本文中，我们给出了在任意维度下Alfeld剖分上的第一个统一构造方法，其中放宽了超光滑性条件和多项式次数要求。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在任意维度下基于Alfeld剖分构造$C^r$协调有限元的新方法，放宽了之前研究中的限制条件。
ai_comments: 该论文通过利用Alfeld剖分，在任意维度上实现了$C^r$协调有限元空间的构造，并成功放宽了此前研究中对超光滑性和多项式次数的严格限制，对于高阶有限元方法的理论研究具有重要意义。
motivation: 在任意维度下构造$C^r$协调有限元空间是一个长期未解决的问题，现有方法在通用剖分下对超光滑性和多项式次数有较严苛的要求，需要寻求更具一般性的构造方法。
method: 在Alfeld剖分的基础上，通过放宽超光滑性条件和多项式次数要求，构造出统一的$C^r$协调有限元空间。
results: 提出了一种在任意维度Alfeld剖分下构造$C^r$协调有限元空间的统一方法，并优化了先前的多项式次数和超光滑性限制。
conclusion: 本文在Alfeld剖分上成功实现了任意维度下的$C^r$协调有限元空间构造，并放宽了以往研究的限制条件，为解决该长期存在的数学难题提供了新的统一方法。

title: Same Feedback, Different Source: How AI vs. Human Feedback Attribution and Credibility Shape Learner Behavior in Computing Education
authors: Caitlin Morris, Pattie Maes
abstract: As AI systems increasingly take on instructional roles - providing feedback, guiding practice, evaluating work - a fundamental question emerges: does it matter to learners who they believe is on the other side? We investigated this using a three-condition experiment (N=148) in which participants completed a creative coding tutorial and received feedback generated by the same large language model, attributed to either an AI system (with instant or delayed delivery) or a human teaching assistant (with matched delayed delivery). This three-condition design separates the effect of source attribution from the confound of delivery timing, which prior studies have not controlled. Source attribution and timing had distinct effects on different outcomes: participants who believed the human attribution spent more time on task than those receiving equivalently timed AI-attributed feedback (d=0.61, p=.013, uncorrected), while the delivery delay independently increased output complexity without affecting time measures. An exploratory analysis revealed that 46% of participants in the human-attributed condition did not believe the attribution, and these participants showed worse outcomes than those receiving transparent AI feedback (code complexity d=0.77, p=.003; time on task d=0.70, p=.007). These findings suggest that believed human presence may carry motivational value, but that this value depends on credibility. For computing educators, transparent AI attribution may be the lower-risk default in contexts where human attribution would not be credible.
zh_title: 相同的反馈，不同的来源：AI与人类反馈归因及其可信度如何塑造编程教育中的学习者行为
translation: 随着人工智能系统越来越多地承担教学角色——提供反馈、指导练习、评估作业——一个根本性的问题出现了：学习者是否在意他们认为是谁在提供反馈？我们通过一项三条件实验（N=148）对此进行了调查，参与者完成了一个创意编程教程，并接收了由同一大语言模型生成的反馈，这些反馈被归因于AI系统（即时或延迟交付）或人类助教（匹配延迟交付）。这种三条件设计将来源归因的影响与交付时间这一混杂因素分离开来，这是以往研究未曾控制的。来源归因和交付时间对不同的结果有不同的影响：认为反馈来自人类的参与者在任务上花费的时间比接收同等延迟的AI反馈的参与者更多（d=0.61, p=.013, 未校正），而交付延迟独立增加了输出复杂性，但未影响时间指标。一项探索性分析显示，在人类归因条件下，46%的参与者不相信该归因，这些参与者的表现比接收透明AI反馈的参与者更差（代码复杂性 d=0.77, p=.003；任务时间 d=0.70, p=.007）。这些发现表明，被感知到的人类存在可能具有激励价值，但这种价值取决于可信度。对于计算机教育工作者来说，在人类归因不可信的情况下，透明的AI归因可能是风险更低的默认选择。
tldr: 学习者更愿意为“人类”反馈投入更多时间，但前提是他们必须相信反馈确实来自人类；若怀疑反馈来源，透明的AI反馈效果反而更好。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地通过控制反馈延迟变量，解构了“来源属性（AI vs. 人类）”对学习者行为的具体影响。研究揭示了一个关键点：信任是人类反馈发挥激励作用的前提，当学习者怀疑人类反馈的真实性时，其学习效果反而不如透明的AI反馈，这为教育领域AI的应用提供了重要的伦理和实践参考。
motivation: 随着AI在教学中承担越来越多的反馈与指导任务，研究者旨在探究学习者对反馈来源的感知（AI还是人类）如何影响其学习动机与行为表现。
method: 采用三组对照实验（N=148），在相同的反馈内容下，分别设置“AI反馈（即时）”、“AI反馈（延迟）”和“人类助教反馈（延迟）”三组条件，通过控制交付时间来分离来源属性的影响，并进行后续的行为和认知分析。
results: 实验发现：1. 认为反馈来自人类的学习者在任务上花费的时间更多；2. 反馈交付的延迟独立增加了代码的复杂性；3. 约46%的“人类反馈”组参与者不相信反馈来源，且这些怀疑者的学习表现显著劣于接收透明AI反馈的参与者。
conclusion: 人类反馈的激励价值高度依赖于其可信度；在人类反馈难以被信任的情况下，透明的AI反馈是更稳妥且有效的教学方案。

title: EEspice: A Modular Circuit Simulation Platform with Parallel Device Model Evaluation via Graph Coloring
authors: Xuanhao Bao, Danial Chitnis
abstract: As modern analogue/mixed-signal design increasingly relies on optimization-in-the-loop flows, such as AI and LLM-based sizing agents that repeatedly invoke SPICE-efficient, accurate high-performance simulators have become an indispensable foundation for modern integrated circuit (IC) design. However, the computational cost of evaluating nonlinear models, particularly for BSIM models, remains a significant bottleneck. In standard parallelization approaches, devices such as transistors are easily distributed across processors. The subsequent stamping phase, where each device's contributions are added to the shared system matrix, often creates a bottleneck. Because multiple processor cores compete to update the same matrix elements simultaneously, the system is forced to process tasks one at a time to avoid errors. This paper introduces EEspice, an open-source circuit simulation framework whose modular architecture decouples device model evaluation into independently replaceable kernels, enabling a parallel stamping strategy that overcomes this bottleneck. It partitions MOSFET instances into independent color groups, which can be processed in parallel. Our results show that on a 64-core workstation, the proposed approach achieves up to 45x speedup over single-thread performance when conflicts are low. Our analysis also explores how performance depends on circuit topology.
zh_title: EEspice：一种通过图着色实现设备模型并行评估的模块化电路仿真平台
translation: 随着现代模拟/混合信号设计日益依赖于循环优化流程（如AI和基于LLM的尺寸调整代理），这些流程需要频繁调用SPICE，因此高效、准确且高性能的仿真器已成为现代集成电路（IC）设计中不可或缺的基础。然而，评估非线性模型（尤其是BSIM模型）的计算成本仍然是一个重大瓶颈。在标准的并行化方法中，晶体管等设备很容易分布在各个处理器上。随后的矩阵填充阶段（即将每个设备的贡献添加到共享系统矩阵中）往往会成为瓶颈。由于多个处理器核心竞争同时更新相同的矩阵元素，系统被迫一次处理一个任务以避免错误。本文介绍了EEspice，这是一个开源电路仿真框架，其模块化架构将设备模型评估解耦为可独立替换的内核，从而实现了能够克服此瓶颈的并行填充策略。它将MOSFET实例划分为可以并行处理的独立颜色组。我们的结果表明，在64核工作站上，当冲突较低时，所提出的方法比单线程性能实现了最高45倍的加速。我们的分析还探讨了性能如何依赖于电路拓扑。
tldr: EEspice通过图着色算法解决了电路仿真中矩阵更新的并行化冲突问题，在64核环境下实现了最高45倍的加速。
ai_comments: 该论文通过图形着色技术解决了电路仿真中矩阵填充（Stamping）阶段的并行化瓶颈，这对于加速基于AI的电路优化流程具有重要意义。其模块化设计不仅提升了性能，还增强了框架的灵活性和可扩展性。
motivation: 现代集成电路设计中，基于AI和LLM的优化流程需要频繁调用SPICE仿真，但非线性模型（如BSIM）的评估及矩阵填充过程中的数据竞争限制了传统并行仿真的性能。
method: 提出了EEspice框架，采用模块化架构解耦设备模型评估，并利用图着色技术将MOSFET实例划分为独立的颜色组，从而在矩阵填充阶段实现无冲突的并行处理。
results: 在64核工作站上，该方法在低冲突电路拓扑中实现了最高45倍的单线程性能加速。
conclusion: EEspice通过基于图着色的并行矩阵填充策略，有效解决了大规模集成电路仿真中非线性模型评估和矩阵更新的性能瓶颈，显著提升了仿真效率。

title: Supply-Chain Poisoning Attacks Against LLM Coding Agent Skill Ecosystems
authors: Yubin Qu, Yi Liu, Tongcheng Geng, Gelei Deng, Yuekang Li, Leo Yu Zhang, Ying Zhang, Lei Ma
abstract: LLM-based coding agents extend their capabilities via third-party agent skills distributed through open marketplaces without mandatory security review. Unlike traditional packages, these skills are executed as operational directives with system-level privileges, so a single malicious skill can compromise the host. Prior work has not examined whether supply-chain attacks can directly hijack an agent's action space, such as file writes, shell commands, and network requests, despite existing safeguards. We introduce Document-Driven Implicit Payload Execution (DDIPE), which embeds malicious logic in code examples and configuration templates within skill documentation. Because agents reuse these examples during normal tasks, the payload executes without explicit prompts. Using an LLM-driven pipeline, we generate 1,070 adversarial skills from 81 seeds across 15 MITRE ATTACK categories. Across four frameworks and five models, DDIPE achieves 11.6% to 33.5% bypass rates, while explicit instruction attacks achieve 0% under strong defenses. Static analysis detects most cases, but 2.5% evade both detection and alignment. Responsible disclosure led to four confirmed vulnerabilities and two fixes.
zh_title: 针对LLM编码代理技能生态系统的供应链投毒攻击
translation: 基于LLM的编码代理通过在开放市场上分发的第三方代理技能扩展其功能，而这些技能无需经过强制性的安全审查。与传统软件包不同，这些技能作为具有系统级权限的操作指令执行，因此单个恶意技能即可危及主机。尽管存在现有的防御措施，但此前的工作尚未研究供应链攻击是否可以直接劫持代理的动作空间，如文件写入、shell命令和网络请求。我们引入了“文档驱动隐式载荷执行”（DDIPE），它将恶意逻辑嵌入到技能文档中的代码示例和配置模板中。由于代理在常规任务中会重复使用这些示例，因此载荷无需显式提示即可执行。我们使用LLM驱动的流水线，从15个MITRE ATTACK类别中的81个种子生成了1,070个对抗性技能。在四种框架和五种模型中，DDIPE实现了11.6%到33.5%的绕过率，而在强防御下，显式指令攻击的绕过率为0%。静态分析虽然可以检测到大多数情况，但仍有2.5%的攻击绕过了检测和对齐。负责任的披露导致了四个确认的漏洞和两个修复方案。
tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为DDIPE的攻击方式，通过在第三方技能文档中嵌入隐蔽代码，成功诱导LLM代理执行恶意操作，绕过了现有的安全防御。
ai_comments: 该论文揭示了LLM编码代理生态系统中的一个关键安全盲点。其创新之处在于提出了DDIPE攻击方法，该方法巧妙地利用了代理对文档中代码示例的信任，绕过了传统的显式指令防御机制。该研究不仅具有极高的现实意义，还为构建更安全的代理生态系统提供了重要的实证依据。
motivation: 当前LLM编码代理依赖未经安全审查的第三方技能，且这些技能拥有系统级权限，但目前尚缺乏针对这种供应链攻击是否能劫持代理动作空间的研究。
method: 提出了一种名为“文档驱动隐式载荷执行”（DDIPE）的攻击方法，通过将恶意逻辑嵌入到技能文档的代码示例和配置模板中，诱导代理在执行任务时自动触发恶意代码，并使用LLM驱动的流水线生成了1,070个对抗性技能进行验证。
results: DDIPE在四种框架和五种模型上实现了11.6%到33.5%的攻击绕过率，显著优于显式指令攻击（0%），且有2.5%的攻击案例成功绕过了静态分析和模型对齐。
conclusion: DDIPE攻击证明了LLM编码代理在处理外部文档时存在严重的安全隐患，现有的防御措施无法有效防范隐式载荷执行，需要开发更先进的分析和过滤机制。

title: HistMSO: A Logic for Reasoning about Consistency Models with MONA
authors: Isabelle Coget, Étienne Lozes
abstract:
Reasoning about consistency models for replicated data systems is a challenging task that requires a deep understanding of both the consistency models themselves and a large part of human inputs in mechanized verification approaches.
  In this work, we introduce an approach to reasoning about consistency models for replicated data systems. We introduce HistMSO, a monadic second-order logic (MSO) for histories and abstract executions, the formal models of executions of replicated data systems introduced by Burckhardt. We show that HistMSO can express 39 out of 42 consistency models from Viotti and Vukolic hierarchy. Moreover, we develop a method for reducing HistMSO satisfiability and model-checking to the same problems for MSO over words. While doing this, we leverage the MONA tool for automated reasoning on consistency models.
zh_title: HistMSO：一种用于推理具有MONA的一致性模型的逻辑
translation:
推理复制数据系统的 समरूपता 模型是一项艰巨的任务，它需要对 समरूपता 模型本身有深刻的理解，并且在机械化验证方法中需要大量的人工输入。
 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种推理复制数据系统 समरूपता 模型的方法。我们引入了HistMSO，一种用于历史和抽象执行的单子二阶逻辑(MSO)，这是由Burckhardt引入的复制数据系统执行的形式化模型。我们证明了HistMSO可以表达Viotti和Vukolic层级中的42个 समरूपता 模型中的39个。此外，我们开发了一种将HistMSO的可满足性和模型检验问题约简到关于字的MSO的相同问题的方法。在此过程中，我们利用MONA工具对 समरूपता 模型进行自动化推理。
tldr: 该研究提出了HistMSO，一种用于历史和抽象执行的单子二阶逻辑(MSO)，以形式化推理复制数据系统的 समरूपता 模型。HistMSO能够表达大部分 समरूपता 模型，并且可以将 समरूपता 检验和模型检验问题约简到MSO问题，利用MONA工具进行自动化推理。
ai_comments: 该研究在 समरूपता 模型推理领域取得了重要进展，通过引入HistMSO逻辑和相应的约简方法，为 समरूपता 模型的自动化验证提供了新的途径。然而，未能表达的3个 समरूपता 模型以及HistMSO逻辑本身的表达能力和局限性仍需进一步研究。
motivation: 关于复制数据系统的 समरूपता 模型进行推理具有挑战性，需要深入理解 समरूपता 模型和机械化验证方法中的大量人工输入。
method: 提出了一种推理复制数据系统 समरूपता 模型的方法。引入了HistMSO，一种用于历史和抽象执行的单子二阶逻辑(MSO)。将HistMSO的可满足性和模型检验问题约简到关于字的MSO的相同问题，并利用MONA工具进行自动化推理。
results: HistMSO能够表达Viotti和Vukolic层级中的42个 समरूपता 模型中的39个。
conclusion: HistMSO是一种有前景的逻辑，可用于形式化推理 समरूपता 模型，并能通过与MONA工具集成实现自动化推理。

title: On Data-Driven Koopman Representations of Nonlinear Delay Differential Equations
authors: Santosh Mohan Rajkumar, Dibyasri Barman, Kumar Vikram Singh, Debdipta Goswami
abstract: This work establishes a rigorous bridge between infinite-dimensional delay dynamics and finite-dimensional Koopman learning, with explicit and interpretable error guarantees. While Koopman analysis is well-developed for ordinary differential equations (ODEs) and partially for partial differential equations (PDEs), its extension to delay differential equations (DDEs) remains limited due to the infinite-dimensional phase space of DDEs. We propose a finite-dimensional Koopman approximation framework based on history discretization and a suitable reconstruction operator, enabling a tractable representation of the Koopman operator via kernel-based extended dynamic mode decomposition (kEDMD). Deterministic error bounds are derived for the learned predictor, decomposing the total error into contributions from history discretization, kernel interpolation, and data-driven regression. Additionally, we develop a kernel-based reconstruction method to recover discretized states from lifted Koopman coordinates, with provable guarantees. Numerical results demonstrate convergence of the learned predictor with respect to both discretization resolution and training data, supporting reliable prediction and control of delay systems.

title: Self-Supervised Graph Neural Networks for Full-Scale Tertiary Voltage Control
authors: Balthazar Donon, Geoffroy Jamgotchian, Hugo Kulesza, Louis Wehenkel
abstract: A growing portion of operators workload is dedicated to Tertiary Voltage Control (TVC), namely the regulation of voltages by means of adjusting a series of setpoints and connection status. TVC may be framed as a Mixed Integer Non Linear Program, but state-of-the-art optimization methods scale poorly to large systems, making them impractical for real-scale and real-time decision support. Observing that TVC does not require any optimality guarantee, we frame it as an Amortized Optimization problem, addressed by the self-supervised training of a Graph Neural Network (GNN) to minimize voltage violations. As a first step, we consider the specific use case of post-processing the forecasting pipeline used by the French TSO, where the trained GNN would serve as a TVC proxy. After being trained on one year of full-scale HV-EHV French power grid day-ahead forecasts, our model manages to significantly reduce the average number of voltage violations.

title: SkillRT: Compiling Skills for Efficient Execution Everywhere
authors: Le Chen, Erhu Feng, Yubin Xia, Haibo Chen
abstract:
LLM agents increasingly adopt skills as a reusable unit of composition. While skills are shared across diverse agent platforms, current systems treat them as raw context, causing the same skill to behave inconsistently for different agents. This fragility undermines skill portability and execution efficiency.
  To address this challenge, we analyze 118,000 skills and draw inspiration from traditional compiler design. We treat skills as code and LLMs as heterogeneous processors. To make portability actionable, we decompose a skill's requirements into a set of primitive capabilities, and measure how well each model-harness pair supports them. Based on these capability profiles, we propose SkillRT, a compilation and runtime system designed for portable and efficient skill execution. At compile time, SkillRT performs capability-based compilation, environment binding, and concurrency extraction. At runtime, SkillRT applies JIT code solidification and adaptive recompilation for performance optimization.
  We evaluate SkillRT across eight LLMs of varying scales and three agent harnesses, covering SkillsBench and representative skill tasks. Results demonstrate that SkillRT significantly improves task completion rates across different models and environments while reducing token consumption by up to 40%. In terms of performance, SkillRT achieves up to 3.2x speedup with enhanced parallelism, and 19-50x latency reduction through code solidification.

title: CASCADE: A Cascading Architecture for Social Coordination with Controllable Emergence at Low Cost
authors: Yizhi Xu
abstract: Creating scalable and believable game societies requires balancing authorial control with computational cost. Existing scripted NPC systems scale efficiently but are often rigid, whereas fully LLM-driven agents can produce richer social behavior at a much higher runtime cost. We present CASCADE, a three-layer architecture for low-cost, controllable social coordination in sandbox-style game worlds. A Macro State Director (Level 1) maintains discrete-time world-state variables and macro-level causal updates, while a modular Coordination Hub decomposes state changes through domain-specific components (e.g., professional and social coordination) and routes the resulting directives to tag-defined groups. Then Tag-Driven NPCs (Level 3) execute responses through behavior trees and local state/utility functions, invoking large language models only for on-demand player-facing interactions. We evaluate CASCADE through multiple micro-scenario prototypes and trace-based analysis, showing how a shared macro event can produce differentiated yet logically constrained NPC behaviors without per-agent prompting in the main simulation loop. CASCADE provides a modular foundation for scalable social simulation and future open-world authoring tools.
