zh_title: 测量无法调查的：LLM 作为劳动经济学中潜在认知变量的工具
translation:
本文为使用大型语言模型（LLMs）作为潜在经济变量的测量工具奠定了理论和实践基础——特别是那些描述职业任务认知内容的变量，其粒度是现有调查工具无法实现的。我形式化了LLM生成的分数构成有效工具的四个条件：语义外生性、结构相关性、单调性和模型不变性。然后，我将此框架应用于增强人力资本指数（AHC_o），该指数由Claude Haiku 4.5对18,796个O*NET任务陈述进行评分构建，并针对六个现有AI暴露指数进行验证。该指数显示出强大的收敛效度（与Eloundou GPT-gamma相关系数r = 0.85，与Felten AIOE相关系数r = 0.79）和判别效度。
主成分分析证实，AI相关的职业测量涵盖两个不同的维度——增强和替代。两个LLM模型间的评估者间信度（n = 3,666对分数）产生Pearson r = 0.76和Krippendorff's alpha = 0.71。对四种替代框架的提示敏感性分析表明，任务级别的排名是稳健的。明显相关工具变量（ORIV）估计恢复的系数比OLS大25%，这与经典测量误差衰减一致。该方法论可以推广到劳动经济学之外的任何需要大规模量化语义内容的领域。
tldr: 本文提出并验证了使用大型语言模型（LLMs）作为测量潜在经济变量的工具，特别是针对职业任务的认知内容，并构建了增强人力资本指数。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于提出了使用LLM作为测量工具来量化传统方法难以捕捉的潜在认知变量，并为此建立了一套严谨的理论和实证验证框架。其重要性在于为劳动经济学乃至更广泛的社会科学领域提供了一种新的、可扩展的数据收集和分析方法，尤其是在理解AI对劳动力市场影响方面具有重要意义。通过定义有效性的四个条件和多维度的验证，增加了方法论的可信度。
motivation: 现有调查工具无法以足够的粒度测量职业任务的认知内容，需要一种新的方法来量化大规模的语义内容。
method: 本文形式化了LLM生成分数作为有效测量工具的四个条件：语义外生性、结构相关性、单调性和模型不变性。作者将此框架应用于由Claude Haiku 4.5对18,796个O*NET任务陈述评分构建的增强人力资本指数（AHC_o），并与现有AI暴露指数进行验证。进行了主成分分析、评估了两个LLM模型间的评估者间信度，并进行了提示敏感性分析和明显相关工具变量（ORIV）估计。
results: 增强人力资本指数（AHC_o）显示出强大的收敛效度（与Eloundou GPT-gamma相关系数r = 0.85，与Felten AIOE相关系数r = 0.79）和判别效度。主成分分析证实AI相关的职业测量涵盖增强和替代两个维度。两个LLM模型间的评估者间信度为Pearson r = 0.76，Krippendorff's alpha = 0.71。提示敏感性分析表明任务级别排名具有鲁棒性。ORIV估计恢复的系数比OLS大25%，这与经典测量误差衰减一致。
conclusion: LLMs可以作为测量潜在经济变量的有效工具，特别是对于现有调查方法难以捕捉的职业任务认知内容。该方法可以推广到任何需要大规模量化语义内容的领域。

title: Managing Diabetic Retinopathy with Deep Learning: A Data Centric Overview
authors: Shramana Dey, Zahir Khan, T. A. PramodKumar, B. Uma Shankar, Ashis K. Dhara, Ramachandran Rajalakshmi, Rajiv Raman, Sushmita Mitra
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a serious microvascular complication of diabetes, and one of the leading causes of vision loss worldwide. Although automated detection and grading, with Deep Learning (DL), can reduce the burden on ophthalmologists, it is constrained by the limited availability of high-quality datasets. Existing repositories often remain geographically narrow, contain limited samples, and exhibit inconsistent annotations or variable image quality; thereby, restricting their clinical reliability. This paper presents a comprehensive review and comparative analysis of fundus image datasets used in the management of DR. The study evaluates their usability across key tasks, including binary classification, severity grading, lesion localization, and multi-disease screening. It also categorizes the datasets by size, accessibility, and annotation type (such as image-level, lesion-level, and multi-disease). Finally, a recently published dataset is presented as a case study to illustrate broader challenges in dataset curation and usage. The review consolidates current knowledge while highlighting persistent gaps such as the lack of standardized lesion-level annotations and longitudinal data. It also outlines recommendations for future dataset development to support clinically reliable and explainable solutions in DR screening.
zh_title: 利用深度学习管理糖尿病视网膜病变：以数据为中心的综述
translation: 糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）是糖尿病的一种严重微血管并发症，也是全球视力丧失的主要原因之一。虽然利用深度学习（DL）进行自动化检测和分级可以减轻眼科医生的负担，但它受到高质量数据集可用性有限的制约。现有的数据库往往地理范围狭窄、样本量有限，且存在标注不一致或图像质量参差不齐的问题，从而限制了它们的临床可靠性。本文对用于DR管理的眼底图像数据集进行了全面综述和比较分析。研究评估了它们在关键任务中的可用性，包括二分类、严重程度分级、病灶定位和多疾病筛查。此外，本文还根据规模、可访问性和标注类型（如图像级、病灶级和多疾病）对数据集进行了分类。最后，本文以一个最新发布的数据集作为案例研究，说明了数据集策划和使用中的更广泛挑战。该综述整合了当前知识，同时强调了持续存在的缺口，例如缺乏标准化的病灶级标注和纵向数据。文章还为未来的数据集开发提出了建议，以支持在DR筛查中实现临床可靠和可解释的解决方案。
tldr: 本文综述了糖尿病视网膜病变数据集的现状，指出数据质量与标准化不足是制约深度学习临床应用的关键瓶颈，并提出了未来数据集建设的改进方向。
ai_comments: 该论文通过“以数据为中心”的视角切入，指出了当前深度学习在糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）应用中的瓶颈在于数据质量而非算法本身。其创新之处在于系统性梳理了现有的眼底图像数据集，并针对临床可靠性提出了具体的改进建议，对推动医学影像AI的落地具有重要参考价值。
motivation: 尽管深度学习在DR检测和分级中展现潜力，但现有数据集存在地理分布局限、样本量小、标注不一致及图像质量参差不齐等问题，严重限制了模型的临床可靠性。
method: 对现有的糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）眼底图像数据集进行了全面的综述与比较分析，从规模、可访问性、标注类型（图像级、病灶级等）等维度进行分类，并结合案例研究分析了数据集策划与使用的挑战。
results: 研究识别了现有数据集在临床应用中的局限性，特别指出缺乏标准化的病灶级标注和纵向数据是当前的主要缺口，并为未来数据集的开发提供了改进建议。
conclusion: 当前DR领域的深度学习研究受限于数据集的质量与多样性，未来需重点解决标注标准化与纵向数据缺失问题，以实现更具临床可靠性和可解释性的筛查方案。

title: A Multimodal Vision Transformer-based Modeling Framework for Prediction of Fluid Flows in Energy Systems
authors: Kiran Yalamanchi, Shivam Barwey, Ibrahim Jarrah, Pinaki Pal
abstract: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations of complex fluid flows in energy systems are prohibitively expensive due to strong nonlinearities and multiscale-multiphysics interactions. In this work, we present a transformer-based modeling framework for prediction of fluid flows, and demonstrate it for high-pressure gas injection phenomena relevant to reciprocating engines. The approach employs a hierarchical Vision Transformer (SwinV2-UNet) architecture that processes multimodal flow datasets from multi-fidelity simulations. The model architecture is conditioned on auxiliary tokens explicitly encoding the data modality and time increment. Model performance is assessed on two different tasks: (1) spatiotemporal rollouts, where the model autoregressively predicts the flow state at future times; and (2) feature transformation, where the model infers unobserved fields/views from observed fields/views. We train separate models on multimodal datasets generated from in-house CFD simulations of argon jet injection into a nitrogen environment, encompassing multiple grid resolutions, turbulence models, and equations of state. The resulting data-driven models learn to generalize across resolutions and modalities, accurately forecasting the flow evolution and reconstructing missing flow-field information from limited views. This work demonstrates how large vision transformer-based models can be adapted to advance predictive modeling of complex fluid flow systems.
zh_title: 一种基于多模态视觉Transformer的能源系统流体流动预测建模框架
translation: 能源系统中复杂流体流动的计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟由于其强非线性和多尺度-多物理场相互作用，计算成本极其高昂。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于Transformer的流体流动预测建模框架，并将其应用于与往复式发动机相关的高压气体喷射现象中。该方法采用了一种分层视觉Transformer（SwinV2-UNet）架构，处理来自多保真度模拟的多模态流数据。模型架构基于显式编码数据模态和时间增量的辅助标记进行条件化。模型性能在两项不同任务上进行了评估：（1）时空展开，即模型自回归地预测未来时刻的流体状态；以及（2）特征转换，即模型从观测场/视图中推断出未观测到的场/视图。我们在内部CFD模拟生成的、涵盖多种网格分辨率、湍流模型和状态方程的氩气喷射入氮气环境的多模态数据集上训练了独立模型。由此产生的数据驱动模型学会了跨分辨率和模态的泛化，能够准确预测流动演化并从有限视图中重构缺失的流场信息。这项工作展示了如何调整大型视觉Transformer模型以推进复杂流体流动系统的预测建模。
tldr: 通过引入视觉Transformer架构，本研究实现了对能源系统复杂流体流动的快速、准确预测与缺失场重构，有效解决了传统CFD模拟高昂的计算成本问题。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将Vision Transformer（特别是SwinV2-UNet）应用于计算流体动力学（CFD）领域，并引入了多模态辅助标记来处理多保真度数据。其重要性在于通过数据驱动的方法有效缓解了复杂能源系统CFD模拟计算成本高昂的问题，为流体动力学的预测建模提供了一种高效的替代方案。局限性在于该方法目前主要在特定的高压气体喷射场景下进行了验证，其泛化到更广泛、更复杂的湍流场景的能力仍需进一步探索。
motivation: 能源系统中的复杂流体流动由于其强非线性、多尺度和多物理场相互作用，导致传统的计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟计算成本极其高昂，难以满足快速预测的需求。
method: 提出了一种基于分层视觉Transformer（SwinV2-UNet）的建模框架，通过引入显式编码数据模态和时间增量的辅助标记来处理多保真度CFD数据，并针对时空演化预测和特征转换（缺失场重构）两类任务进行训练。
results: 所提出的模型在处理不同网格分辨率、湍流模型和状态方程的多模态数据集上表现良好，能够准确预测流体随时间的演化，并成功从有限的观测场中重构出缺失的流场信息。
conclusion: 本研究证实了基于Transformer的多模态架构在处理复杂流体动力学预测任务中的有效性，能够实现跨分辨率和跨模态的准确预测与重建，为能源系统的高效预测建模开辟了新路径。

title: Optimal Projection-Free Adaptive SGD for Matrix Optimization
authors: Dmitry Kovalev
abstract: Recently, Jiang et al. [2026] developed Leon, a practical variant of One-sided Shampoo [Xie et al., 2025a, An et al., 2025] algorithm for online convex optimization, which does not require computing a costly quadratic projection at each iteration. Unfortunately, according to the existing analysis, Leon requires tuning an additional hyperparameter in its preconditioner and cannot achieve dimension-independent convergence guarantees for convex optimization problems beyond the bounded gradients assumption. In this paper, we resolve this issue by proving certain stability properties of Leon's preconditioner. Using our improved analysis, we show that tuning the extra hyperparameter can be avoided and, more importantly, develop the first practical variant of One-sided Shampoo with Nesterov acceleration, which does not require computing projections at each iteration. As a side contribution, we obtain improved dimension-independent rates in the non-smooth non-convex setting and develop a unified analysis of the proposed algorithm, which yields accelerated projection-free adaptive SGD with (block-)diagonal preconditioners.
zh_title: 面向矩阵优化的最优无投影自适应SGD
translation: 最近，Jiang等人 [2026] 开发了Leon，这是一种用于在线凸优化的One-sided Shampoo [Xie et al., 2025a, An et al., 2025] 算法的实用变体，它不需要在每次迭代时计算昂贵的二次投影。遗憾的是，根据现有分析，Leon需要在其预处理器中调整一个额外的超参数，并且在有界梯度假设之外的凸优化问题中无法实现与维度无关的收敛保证。在本文中，我们通过证明Leon预处理器的某些稳定性属性解决了这个问题。利用我们改进的分析，我们证明了可以避免调整额外的超参数，更重要的是，开发了第一个带Nesterov加速的One-sided Shampoo实用变体，它不需要在每次迭代时计算投影。作为一项附带贡献，我们在非平滑非凸设置中获得了改进的维度无关速率，并开发了所提出算法的统一分析，从而产生了具有（块）对角预处理器的加速无投影自适应SGD。
tldr: 提出了一种无需投影且带Nesterov加速的改进版One-sided Shampoo算法，消除了超参数调优需求并提升了收敛性能。
ai_comments: 该论文通过提升Leon算法预处理器的稳定性分析，成功移除了多余的超参数调优需求，并首次实现了带Nesterov加速且无需投影的One-sided Shampoo变体，在理论和实践上均有显著突破。
motivation: 现有的Leon算法需要额外调优超参数，且在非有界梯度假设下无法获得与维度无关的收敛保证，限制了其在复杂矩阵优化问题中的应用。
method: 通过证明Leon算法预处理器的稳定性，移除了超参数需求；结合Nesterov加速技术，设计了无需投影的One-sided Shampoo变体；并提供了针对非平滑非凸设置的统一分析框架。
results: 消除了额外超参数调优，实现了首个带Nesterov加速的无投影One-sided Shampoo算法，并在非平滑非凸场景下获得了改进的维度无关收敛率。
conclusion: 本文通过改进的稳定性分析，实现了无需投影且具备Nesterov加速的自适应SGD算法，提升了算法在矩阵优化中的效率与收敛性能。

title: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback: A Statistical Perspective
authors: Pangpang Liu, Chengchun Shi, Will Wei Sun
abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as a central framework for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. Despite its practical success, RLHF raises fundamental statistical questions because it relies on noisy, subjective, and often heterogeneous feedback to learn reward models and optimize policies. This survey provides a statistical perspective on RLHF, focusing primarily on the LLM alignment setting. We introduce the main components of RLHF, including supervised fine-tuning, reward modeling, and policy optimization, and relate them to familiar statistical ideas such as Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) model, latent utility estimation, active learning, experimental design, and uncertainty quantification. We review methods for learning reward functions from pairwise preference data and for optimizing policies through both two-stage RLHF pipelines and emerging one-stage approaches such as direct preference optimization. We further discuss recent extensions including reinforcement learning from AI feedback, inference-time algorithms, and reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, as well as benchmark datasets, evaluation protocols, and open-source frameworks that support RLHF research. We conclude by highlighting open challenges in RLHF. An accompanying GitHub demo https://github.com/Pangpang-Liu/RLHF_demo illustrates key components of the RLHF pipeline.
zh_title: 人类反馈强化学习：统计学视角
translation: 人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）已成为将大语言模型（LLM）与人类偏好对齐的核心框架。尽管RLHF取得了实际成功，但它提出了基本的统计学问题，因为它依赖于含噪、主观且通常是异质的反馈来学习奖励模型并优化策略。本综述提供了RLHF的统计学视角，主要关注LLM对齐设置。我们介绍了RLHF的主要组成部分，包括监督微调、奖励建模和策略优化，并将它们与熟悉的统计学思想（如Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) 模型、潜变量效用估计、主动学习、实验设计和不确定性量化）联系起来。我们回顾了从成对偏好数据学习奖励函数以及通过两阶段RLHF流水线和诸如直接偏好优化等新兴一阶段方法优化策略的方法。我们进一步讨论了最近的扩展，包括来自AI反馈的强化学习、推理时算法和来自可验证奖励的强化学习，以及支持RLHF研究的基准数据集、评估协议和开源框架。最后，我们重点指出了RLHF中面临的公开挑战。随附的GitHub演示（https://github.com/Pangpang-Liu/RLHF_demo）说明了RLHF流水线的关键组件。
tldr: 本文从统计学角度系统梳理了RLHF（人类反馈强化学习），探讨了其如何利用含噪的人类偏好数据实现大语言模型的对齐，并联系了Bradley-Terry-Luce模型等经典理论。
ai_comments: 该综述文章极具价值，因为它将目前流行的RLHF技术置于严谨的统计学框架下进行审视，有助于研究人员从数学本质上理解模型对齐的机制，而非仅仅将其视为经验性的工程实践。其局限性在于作为综述，更多是梳理现有方法，而非提出全新的算法。
motivation: 尽管RLHF在LLM对齐中取得了巨大成功，但其依赖于含噪、主观且异质的人类反馈，缺乏统一的统计学理解，因此需要从统计学角度对其进行理论框架的梳理与分析。
method: 通过综述视角，将RLHF的各组成部分（监督微调、奖励建模、策略优化）与统计学概念（Bradley-Terry-Luce模型、潜变量效用估计、主动学习、不确定性量化）进行映射和理论联系，并对比了从两阶段RLHF到直接偏好优化（DPO）等多种方法。
results: 文章系统地梳理了RLHF的理论基础、主流实现路径（包括两阶段和一阶段方法）、相关扩展技术（如AI反馈、推理时算法），并总结了当前评价协议及面临的开放性挑战。
conclusion: RLHF不仅是一个工程上的成功，更是一个复杂的统计推断问题。通过将RLHF与经典的统计模型（如BTL模型）和学习范式（如主动学习）联系起来，可以更好地理解其局限性并推动未来算法的改进。

title: Sparse Bayesian Learning Algorithms Revisited: From Learning Majorizers to Structured Algorithmic Learning using Neural Networks
authors: Rushabha Balaji, Kuan-Lin Chen, Danijela Cabric, Bhaskar D. Rao
abstract: Sparse Bayesian Learning is one of the most popular sparse signal recovery methods, and various algorithms exist under the SBL paradigm. However, given a performance metric and a sparse recovery problem, it is difficult to know a-priori the best algorithm to choose. This difficulty is in part due to a lack of a unified framework to derive SBL algorithms. We address this issue by first showing that the most popular SBL algorithms can be derived using the majorization-minimization (MM) principle, providing hitherto unknown convergence guarantees to this class of SBL methods. Moreover, we show that the two most popular SBL update rules not only fall under the MM framework but are both valid descent steps for a common majorizer, revealing a deeper analytical compatibility between these algorithms. Using this insight and properties from MM theory we expand the class of SBL algorithms, and address finding the best SBL algorithm via data within the MM framework. Second, we go beyond the MM framework by introducing the powerful modeling capabilities of deep learning to further expand the class of SBL algorithms, aiming to learn a superior SBL update rule from data. We propose a novel deep learning architecture that can outperform the classical MM based ones across different sparse recovery problems. Our architecture's complexity does not scale with the measurement matrix dimension, hence providing a unique opportunity to test generalization capability across different matrices. For parameterized dictionaries, this invariance allows us to train and test the model across different parameter ranges. We also showcase our model's ability to learn a functional mapping by its zero-shot performance on unseen measurement matrices. Finally, we test our model's performance across different numbers of snapshots, signal-to-noise ratios, and sparsity levels.
zh_title: 稀疏贝叶斯学习算法再探讨：从学习主要子到使用神经网络的结构化算法学习
translation: 稀疏贝叶斯学习（SBL）是目前最流行的稀疏信号恢复方法之一，SBL范式下存在多种算法。然而，针对给定的性能指标和稀疏恢复问题，很难先验地知道选择哪种算法最好。这种困难部分归因于缺乏推导SBL算法的统一框架。我们首先证明了最流行的SBL算法可以通过极大化-极小化（MM）原则推导出来，从而为这类SBL方法提供了迄今为止未知的收敛保证，以此解决了这个问题。此外，我们证明了两种最流行的SBL更新规则不仅属于MM框架，而且都是公共主要子的有效下降步骤，揭示了这些算法之间更深层次的分析兼容性。利用这一见解和MM理论的特性，我们扩展了SBL算法的类别，并在MM框架内通过数据寻找最佳SBL算法。其次，我们通过引入深度学习的强大建模能力超越了MM框架，旨在从数据中学习更优的SBL更新规则。我们提出了一种新颖的深度学习架构，可以在不同的稀疏恢复问题上超越传统的基于MM的算法。我们的架构复杂度不随测量矩阵维度的增加而扩展，因此为测试不同矩阵的泛化能力提供了独特的机会。对于参数化字典，这种不变性允许我们在不同的参数范围内训练和测试模型。我们还通过模型在未见过的测量矩阵上的零样本性能，展示了其学习函数映射的能力。最后，我们测试了我们的模型在不同快拍数、信噪比和稀疏度水平下的性能。
tldr: 通过MM框架统一SBL算法，并引入深度学习提升其在稀疏恢复中的性能与泛化能力。
ai_comments: 该论文通过统一的MM框架深入剖析了稀疏贝叶斯学习（SBL），不仅填补了算法选择的理论空白，还将深度学习与传统优化框架结合，展现了极强的泛化能力和创新性。
motivation: SBL算法众多，但缺乏统一框架，导致在特定问题下难以选择最优算法；且传统算法在复杂场景下的性能有待提升。
method: 1. 利用极大化-极小化（MM）原则统一推导主流SBL算法并提供收敛性保证；2. 揭示主流更新规则的分析兼容性；3. 提出一种新型深度学习架构，通过数据学习优化的SBL更新规则，且不随测量矩阵维度缩放。
results: 提出的深度学习架构在不同稀疏恢复问题上均优于基于传统MM的算法，并具备良好的泛化能力，支持零样本学习，在不同信噪比、快拍数和稀疏度下表现稳健。
conclusion: 本文成功构建了SBL算法的统一框架，并通过深度学习实现了SBL更新规则的自适应学习，在多种稀疏恢复任务中表现出优于传统方法的性能。

title: Financial Anomaly Detection for the Canadian Market
authors: Luigi Caputi, Nicholas Meadows
abstract: In this work we evaluate the performance of three classes of methods for detecting financial anomalies: topological data analysis (TDA), principal component analyis (PCA), and Neural Network-based approaches. We apply these methods to the TSX-60 data to identify major financial stress events in the Canadian stock market. We show how neural network-based methods (such as GlocalKD and One-Shot GIN(E)) and TDA methods achieve the strongest performance. The effectiveness of TDA in detecting financial anomalies suggests that global topological properties are meaningful in distinguishing financial stress events.
zh_title: 加拿大市场的金融异常检测
translation: 在这项工作中，我们评估了三类检测金融异常的方法的性能：拓扑数据分析（TDA）、主成分分析（PCA）和基于神经网络的方法。我们将这些方法应用于TSX-60数据，以识别加拿大股票市场的主要金融压力事件。我们展示了基于神经网络的方法（如GlocalKD和One-Shot GIN(E)）以及TDA方法如何实现最强的性能。TDA在检测金融异常方面的有效性表明，全局拓扑属性在区分金融压力事件方面具有重要意义。
tldr: 本文通过对比实验发现，TDA和神经网络在检测加拿大股市金融异常方面优于PCA，且拓扑特征对识别金融压力事件非常有效。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将拓扑数据分析（TDA）与神经网络模型（如GlocalKD和One-Shot GIN(E)）结合用于加拿大金融市场异常检测。其局限性在于未提及对其他市场或更广泛金融数据的泛化能力，且未详细对比各方法在计算复杂度上的差异。
motivation: 旨在探索和评估不同技术（特别是TDA和神经网络）在识别加拿大股票市场金融压力事件中的有效性。
method: 对比了三种方法：拓扑数据分析（TDA）、主成分分析（PCA）以及神经网络方法（包括GlocalKD和One-Shot GIN(E)），并应用于TSX-60数据集。
results: 神经网络方法（GlocalKD, One-Shot GIN(E)）和拓扑数据分析方法表现最强，证明了全局拓扑属性在区分金融压力事件中的有效性。
conclusion: 基于拓扑数据分析和特定神经网络的方法在检测加拿大金融市场异常事件方面表现优异，证明了全局拓扑特征在识别金融压力事件中的重要价值。

title: AQVolt26: High-Temperature r$^2$SCAN Halide Dataset for Universal ML Potentials and Solid-State Batteries
authors: Jiyoon Kim, Chuhong Wang, Aayush R. Singh, Tyler Sours, Shivang Agarwal, AJ Nish, Paul Abruzzo, Ang Xiao, Omar Allam
abstract: The demand for safe, high-energy-density batteries has spotlighted halide solid-state electrolytes, which offer the potential for enhanced ionic mobility, electrochemical stability, and interfacial deformability. Accelerating their discovery requires extensive molecular dynamics, which has been increasingly enabled by universal machine learning interatomic potentials trained on foundational datasets. However, the dynamic softness of halides poses a stringent test of whether general-purpose models can reliably replace first-principles calculations under the highly distorted, elevated-temperature regimes necessary to probe ion transport. Here, we present AQVolt26, a dataset of 322,656 r$^2$SCAN single-point calculations for lithium halides, generated via high-temperature configurational sampling across $\sim$5K structures. We demonstrate that foundational datasets provide a strong baseline for stable halide chemistries and transfer local forces well, however absolute energy predictions degrade in distorted higher-temperature regimes. Co-training with AQVolt26 resolves this blind spot. Furthermore, incorporating Materials Project relaxation data improves near-equilibrium performance but degrades extreme-strain robustness without enhancing high-temperature force accuracy. These results demonstrate that domain-specific configurational sampling is essential for the reliable dynamic screening of halide electrolytes. Furthermore, our findings suggest that while foundational models provide a robust base, they are most effective for dynamically soft solid-state chemistries when augmented with targeted, high-temperature data. Finally, we show that near-equilibrium relaxation data serves as a task-specific complement rather than a universally beneficial addition.
zh_title: AQVolt26：用于通用机器学习势函数和固态电池的高温r$^2$SCAN卤化物数据集
translation: 对安全、高能量密度电池的需求使卤化物固态电解质备受关注，它们具有增强离子迁移率、电化学稳定性和界面变形性的潜力。加速其发现需要大量的分子动力学模拟，而基于基础数据集训练的通用机器学习原子间势函数已日益推动了这一进程。然而，卤化物的动态柔软性对通用模型在探测离子传输所需的高度畸变、高温状态下是否能可靠地替代第一性原理计算提出了严峻考验。在此，我们提出了AQVolt26，这是一个包含322,656个锂卤化物r$^2$SCAN单点计算的数据集，通过对约5000种结构进行高温配置采样生成。我们证明，基础数据集为稳定的卤化物化学提供了强大的基准，并能很好地传递局部力，但在畸变的高温状态下，绝对能量预测会下降。与AQVolt26进行协同训练解决了这一盲点。此外，整合Materials Project的弛豫数据虽改善了近平衡性能，但降低了极端应变下的鲁棒性，且并未提高高温下的力精度。这些结果表明，领域特定的配置采样对于卤化物电解质的可靠动态筛选至关重要。此外，我们的研究结果表明，虽然基础模型提供了一个稳健的基础，但当它们辅以有针对性的高温数据时，对于动态软固态化学最为有效。最后，我们表明近平衡弛豫数据是一种任务特定的补充，而非普遍有益的添加。
tldr: 针对现有机器学习势函数在卤化物高温模拟中的精度缺陷，本文发布了AQVolt26数据集，证明了通过高温配置采样补充训练可显著提升模型在极端条件下的动态筛选能力。
ai_comments: 该论文深入探讨了通用机器学习势函数在处理卤化物这种“动态柔软”材料时的局限性，特别是在高温高畸变条件下的性能衰减。研究强调了领域特定配置采样（domain-specific configurational sampling）对于提升模型在极端条件下的预测精度至关重要，为高性能固态电解质的筛选提供了重要的方法论指导。
motivation: 卤化物固态电解质是未来高能量密度电池的关键材料，但现有的通用机器学习势函数在处理卤化物这种高温、高畸变动态环境时，往往无法达到足够的预测精度，限制了其在离子传输研究中的应用。
method: 通过高温配置采样生成了包含约5000种结构、共计322,656个r$^2$SCAN单点计算数据的AQVolt26数据集，并将其与通用基准数据集进行协同训练，对比了不同训练策略在极端应变和高温下的预测准确性。
results: 研究发现通用数据集虽然能提供良好的基准，但在高温扭曲状态下绝对能量预测会下降；AQVolt26数据集的引入有效解决了这一盲点；此外，添加近平衡态弛豫数据虽能改善近平衡性能，但会降低极端应变下的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 通用机器学习势函数在处理卤化物等动态软物质时，需要补充针对性的高温数据进行协同训练，仅靠近平衡态的弛豫数据不足以覆盖极端条件下的物理特性。

title: Neural posterior estimation for scalable and accurate inverse parameter inference in Li-ion batteries
authors: Malik Hassanaly, Corey R. Randall, Peter J. Weddle, Paul J. Gasper, Conlain Kelly, Tanvir R. Tanim, Kandler Smith
abstract: Diagnosing the internal state of Li-ion batteries is critical for battery research, operation of real-world systems, and prognostic evaluation of remaining lifetime. By using physics-based models to perform probabilistic parameter estimation via Bayesian calibration, diagnostics can account for the uncertainty due to model fitness, data noise, and the observability of any given parameter. However, Bayesian calibration in Li-ion batteries using electrochemical data is computationally intensive even when using a fast surrogate in place of physics-based models, requiring many thousands of model evaluations. A fully amortized alternative is neural posterior estimation (NPE). NPE shifts the computational burden from the parameter estimation step to data generation and model training, reducing the parameter estimation time from minutes to milliseconds, enabling real-time applications. The present work shows that NPE calibrates parameters equally or more accurately than Bayesian calibration, and we demonstrate that the higher computational costs for data generation are tractable even in high-dimensional cases (ranging from 6 to 27 estimated parameters), but the NPE method can lead to higher voltage prediction errors. The NPE method also offers several interpretability advantages over Bayesian calibration, such as local parameter sensitivity to specific regions of the voltage curve. The NPE method is demonstrated using an experimental fast charge dataset, with parameter estimates validated against measurements of loss of lithium inventory and loss of active material. The implementation is made available in a companion repository (https://github.com/NatLabRockies/BatFIT).
zh_title: 用于锂离子电池可扩展且精确逆参数推断的神经后验估计
translation: 诊断锂离子电池的内部状态对于电池研究、实际系统运行以及剩余寿命的预测评估至关重要。通过使用基于物理的模型进行贝叶斯校准的概率参数估计，诊断过程可以解释由模型拟合度、数据噪声以及参数可观测性带来的不确定性。然而，即使使用快速替代模型代替基于物理的模型，利用电化学数据进行锂电池贝叶斯校准的计算量仍然非常大，需要数千次模型评估。一种完全摊销的替代方案是神经后验估计（NPE）。NPE将计算负担从参数估计步骤转移到数据生成和模型训练上，将参数估计时间从分钟级减少到毫秒级，从而支持实时应用。本工作表明，NPE校准参数的准确性与贝叶斯校准相当甚至更高，我们证明了高维情况（6到27个估计参数）下数据生成的较高计算成本是可控的，但NPE方法可能导致更高的电压预测误差。NPE方法还提供了优于贝叶斯校准的几种可解释性优势，例如对电压曲线特定区域的局部参数灵敏度。该方法通过实验性快速充电数据集进行了验证，参数估计值与锂库存损失和活性材料损失的测量值进行了比对。相关代码已在开源仓库（https://github.com/NatLabRockies/BatFIT）中提供。
tldr: 提出了一种基于NPE的锂电池参数推断方法，将计算时间从分钟级降低至毫秒级，实现高效、高维的实时电池诊断。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入神经后验估计（NPE）解决了锂电池参数推断中计算效率低下的瓶颈，实现了从分钟级到毫秒级的推断速度，非常适合实时应用。虽然该方法在预测电压时可能存在更高的误差，但其在参数敏感性分析和高维参数估计方面的优势使其成为电池诊断领域极具潜力的工具。
motivation: 传统的基于物理模型的贝叶斯校准方法在锂电池参数估计中计算成本过高，难以满足实时诊断和大规模参数评估的需求。
method: 提出使用神经后验估计（NPE）方法进行参数推断。该方法通过在离线阶段进行大量数据生成和模型训练，实现对模型参数后验分布的完全摊销估计，从而在推理阶段将计算时间缩短至毫秒级。
results: NPE在参数估计精度上与传统贝叶斯校准相当甚至更优，且能够处理6到27个参数的高维情况。该方法显著缩短了计算时间，并提供了更好的参数灵敏度解释性，但在电压预测上可能会产生更高的误差。
conclusion: NPE是一种高效、可扩展且具备解释性的锂电池参数推断方法，虽然在电压预测精度上略有牺牲，但其显著的计算速度提升使其在实时电池诊断和健康状态评估中具有极高的应用价值。

title: Why Invariance is Not Enough for Biomedical Domain Generalization and How to Fix It
authors: Sebo Diaz, Polina Golland, Elfar Adalsteinsson, Neel Dey
abstract: We present DropGen, a simple and theoretically-grounded approach for domain generalization in 3D biomedical image segmentation. Modern segmentation models degrade sharply under shifts in modality, disease severity, clinical sites, and other factors, creating brittle models that limit reliable deployment. Existing domain generalization methods rely on extreme augmentations, mixing domain statistics, or architectural redesigns, yet incur significant implementation overhead and yield inconsistent performance across biomedical settings. DropGen instead proposes a principled learning strategy with minimal overhead that leverages both source-domain image intensities and domain-stable foundation model representations to train robust segmentation models. As a result, DropGen achieves strong gains in both fully supervised and few-shot segmentation across a broad range of shifts in biomedical studies. Unlike prior approaches, DropGen is architecture- and loss-agnostic, compatible with standard augmentation pipelines, computationally lightweight, and tackles arbitrary anatomical regions. Our implementation is freely available at https://github.com/sebodiaz/DropGen.
zh_title: 为什么不变性对于生物医学领域泛化是不够的以及如何修复它
translation: 我们提出了DropGen，一种针对3D生物医学图像分割领域泛化的简单且具有理论依据的方法。现代分割模型在模态、疾病严重程度、临床站点及其他因素发生变化时，性能会急剧下降，导致模型脆弱，限制了可靠部署。现有的领域泛化方法依赖于极端的增强、混合域统计信息或架构重设计，但会产生显著的实现开销，且在生物医学场景中表现不一致。相比之下，DropGen提出了一种具有极低开销的原则性学习策略，利用源域图像强度和领域稳定的基础模型表示来训练鲁棒的分割模型。结果表明，DropGen在广泛的生物医学偏移研究中，在全监督和少样本分割任务上都取得了显著提升。与先前的方法不同，DropGen与架构和损失函数无关，兼容标准增强流水线，计算轻量，并适用于任意解剖区域。我们的实现代码已在 https://github.com/sebodiaz/DropGen 开源。
tldr: DropGen是一种轻量级、架构无关的生物医学图像分割泛化方法，通过结合原始强度与基础模型表示，有效提升了模型在多变临床环境下的鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地指出仅靠不变性学习在生物医学领域泛化中的局限性，并提出了DropGen这一架构无关且轻量级的解决方案。其重要性在于为临床部署高可靠性模型提供了实用且高效的路径，克服了现有方法实现复杂且性能不稳定的缺点。
motivation: 现有生物医学分割模型在面对模态、疾病严重程度及临床站点等变化时性能下降严重，而现有的领域泛化方法往往实现复杂且效果不稳定。
method: 提出DropGen框架，利用源域图像强度信息与领域稳定的基础模型表示进行训练，该方法具有架构无关、损失函数无关、计算轻量且兼容标准增强流程的特点。
results: 在多种生物医学研究的分布偏移场景下，DropGen在全监督和少样本分割任务中均取得了显著的性能提升。
conclusion: DropGen通过结合源域图像强度与领域稳定的基础模型表示，为生物医学图像分割提供了一种通用、鲁棒且高效的领域泛化方案。

title: Learning interacting particle systems from unlabeled data
authors: Viska Wei, Fei Lu
abstract: Learning the potentials of interacting particle systems is a fundamental task across various scientific disciplines. A major challenge is that unlabeled data collected at discrete time points lack trajectory information due to limitations in data collection methods or privacy constraints. We address this challenge by introducing a trajectory-free self-test loss function that leverages the weak-form stochastic evolution equation of the empirical distribution. The loss function is quadratic in potentials, supporting parametric and nonparametric regression algorithms for robust estimation that scale to large, high-dimensional systems with big data. Systematic numerical tests show that our method outperforms baseline methods that regress on trajectories recovered via label matching, tolerating large observation time steps. We establish the convergence of parametric estimators as the sample size increases, providing a theoretical foundation for the proposed approach.
zh_title: 从无标记数据中学习相互作用粒子系统
translation: 学习相互作用粒子系统的势函数是各科学领域的一项基础任务。一个主要挑战是，由于数据收集方法的限制或隐私约束，在离散时间点收集的无标记数据缺乏轨迹信息。我们通过引入一种轨迹无关的自测试损失函数来应对这一挑战，该函数利用了经验分布的弱形式随机演化方程。该损失函数关于势函数呈二次型，支持参数化和非参数化回归算法，能够对大规模、高维系统进行稳健估计。系统的数值测试表明，我们的方法优于基于轨迹匹配回归的基准方法，并且能够容忍较大的观测时间步长。我们建立了参数估计量随样本量增加的收敛性，为所提出的方法提供了理论基础。
tldr: 提出了一种无需轨迹信息的学习框架，通过弱形式随机演化方程高效推断相互作用粒子系统的势函数。
ai_comments: 该研究成功解决了在缺乏轨迹信息（非标记数据）的情况下推断粒子系统势函数的难题。其创新点在于利用经验分布的弱形式随机演化方程构建无轨迹自测试损失函数，不仅降低了计算复杂度，还提升了对大时间步长的鲁棒性，具有很高的科学应用价值。
motivation: 解决在数据收集限制或隐私约束下，仅有离散时间点数据而缺乏轨迹信息时，难以学习相互作用粒子系统势函数的问题。
method: 引入了一种无轨迹自测试损失函数，该函数利用经验分布的弱形式随机演化方程，并通过二次型形式支持参数化和非参数化回归算法。
results: 数值实验表明，该方法在处理大时间步长数据时优于基于轨迹恢复的基准方法，且参数估计量随样本量增加而收敛，具备良好的扩展性。
conclusion: 本文提出了一种基于弱形式随机演化方程的无轨迹学习方法，通过二次损失函数实现了对相互作用粒子系统势函数的高效、鲁棒估计，并提供了理论收敛性支持。

title: Wavelength-multiplexed massively parallel diffractive optical information storage and image projection
authors: Che-Yung Shen, Yuhang Li, Cagatay Isil, Jingxi Li, Leon Lenk, Tianyi Gan, Guangdong Ma, Fazil Onuralp Ardic, Mona Jarrahi, Aydogan Ozcan
abstract: We introduce a wavelength-multiplexed massively parallel diffractive information storage platform composed of dielectric surfaces that are structurally optimized at the wavelength scale using deep learning to store and project thousands of distinct image patterns, each assigned to a unique wavelength. Through numerical simulations in the visible spectrum, we demonstrated that our wavelength-multiplexed diffractive system can store and project over 4,000 independent desired images/patterns within its output field-of-view, with high image quality and minimal crosstalk between spectral channels. Furthermore, in a proof-of-concept experiment, we demonstrated a two-layer diffractive design that stored six distinct patterns and projected them onto the same output field of view at six different wavelengths (500, 548, 596, 644, 692, and 740 nm). This diffractive architecture is scalable and can operate at various parts of the electromagnetic spectrum without the need for material dispersion engineering or redesigning its optimized diffractive layers. The demonstrated storage capacity, reconstruction image fidelity, and wavelength-encoded massively parallel read-out of our diffractive platform offer a compact and fast-access solution for large-scale optical information storage, image projection applications.
zh_title: 波长复用的大规模并行衍射光学信息存储与图像投影
translation: 我们介绍了一种波长复用的大规模并行衍射信息存储平台，该平台由介质表面组成，这些表面使用深度学习在波长尺度上进行结构优化，以存储和投影数千种不同的图像模式，每种模式都被分配到一个独特的波长。通过可见光谱中的数值模拟，我们证明了我们的波长复用衍射系统可以在其输出视场内存储和投影超过4,000个独立的期望图像/模式，具有高质量的图像和光谱通道之间极小的串扰。此外，在概念验证实验中，我们展示了一个双层衍射设计，它存储了六个不同的模式，并将它们以六个不同的波长（500、548、596、644、692和740 nm）投影到同一个输出视场上。这种衍射架构是可扩展的，并且可以在电磁波谱的各个部分运行，而无需材料色散工程或重新设计其优化的衍射层。我们衍射平台所展示的存储容量、重建图像保真度和波长编码的大规模并行读取，为大规模光学信息存储和图像投影应用提供了一种紧凑且快速访问的解决方案。
tldr: 利用深度学习优化衍射面，实现了单一紧凑系统内通过不同波长并行存储与投影数千幅图像，具有高容量和低串扰优势。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种利用深度学习优化介质表面以实现波长复用衍射存储的新颖方法。其创新点在于实现了高容量的并行信息存储与投影，且具备良好的可扩展性，无需进行复杂的材料色散工程。这在光学数据存储和全息显示领域具有重要的应用前景。
motivation: 为了解决大规模光学信息存储和图像投影中对高容量、高保真度及紧凑系统设计的需求，克服传统光学元件在多通道并行处理上的限制。
method: 利用深度学习技术对介质表面进行波长尺度的结构优化，构建波长复用的衍射光学系统，通过不同波长通道实现独立图像的并行存储与投影。
results: 数值模拟显示该系统可存储并投影超过4000幅独立图像，且具有高图像质量和极低的通道串扰。实验验证了六层波长复用设计的可行性，展示了其在不同波长下投影独立图案的能力。
conclusion: 该研究证明了利用波长复用技术和深度学习优化的衍射面，能够在大规模光学信息存储和图像投影中实现高容量、高保真度及快速读取，为未来紧凑型光学系统提供了高效的解决方案。

title: Structure-Preserving Multi-View Embedding Using Gromov-Wasserstein Optimal Transport
authors: Rafael Pereira Eufrazio, Eduardo Fernandes Montesuma, Charles Casimiro Cavalcante
abstract: Multi-view data analysis seeks to integrate multiple representations of the same samples in order to recover a coherent low-dimensional structure. Classical approaches often rely on feature concatenation or explicit alignment assumptions, which become restrictive under heterogeneous geometries or nonlinear distortions. In this work, we propose two geometry-aware multi-view embedding strategies grounded in Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) optimal transport. The first, termed Mean-GWMDS, aggregates view-specific relational information by averaging distance matrices and applying GW-based multidimensional scaling to obtain a representative embedding. The second strategy, referred to as Multi-GWMDS, adopts a selection-based paradigm in which multiple geometry-consistent candidate embeddings are generated via GW-based alignment and a representative embedding is selected. Experiments on synthetic manifolds and real-world datasets show that the proposed methods effectively preserve intrinsic relational structure across views. These results highlight GW-based approaches as a flexible and principled framework for multi-view representation learning.
comment: This manuscript is currently under review for possible publication in the journal Signal Processing (ELSEVIER)
zh_title: 基于Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输的结构保持多视图嵌入
translation: 多视图数据分析旨在整合同一样本的多种表示，以恢复一致的低维结构。传统方法通常依赖特征拼接或显式的对齐假设，这在异构几何或非线性扭曲下会受到限制。在这项工作中，我们提出了两种基于Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) 最优传输的几何感知多视图嵌入策略。第一种称为 Mean-GWMDS，通过平均距离矩阵并应用基于GW的多维尺度分析来聚合视图特定的关系信息，从而获得代表性嵌入。第二种策略称为 Multi-GWMDS，采用基于选择的范式，通过基于GW的对齐生成多个几何一致的候选嵌入，并选择一个代表性嵌入。在合成流形和真实数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法有效地保留了跨视图的内在关系结构。这些结果突显了基于GW的方法作为多视图表示学习的灵活且有原则的框架。
tldr: 提出两种利用Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输的策略，以解决多视图数据中的异构几何结构整合问题，有效实现了结构保持的低维嵌入。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于利用Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输理论处理异构几何结构的多视图数据，克服了传统方法对特征对齐的强假设限制。其重要性在于提供了一种更具普适性和几何一致性的多视图嵌入框架，局限性在于计算复杂度可能随数据规模增加而提升。
motivation: 传统的多视图数据分析方法通常依赖特征拼接或显式的对齐假设，在面对异构几何结构或非线性扭曲时存在局限性，因此需要一种能更好地保持内在几何结构的整合方法。
method: 提出了两种策略：1. Mean-GWMDS：通过对视图距离矩阵取平均，并应用基于GW的多维尺度分析（MDS）来获取代表性嵌入；2. Multi-GWMDS：通过基于GW的对齐生成多个几何一致的候选嵌入，并从中选择一个代表性嵌入。
results: 在合成流形和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，所提方法能有效保留跨视图的内在关系结构，表现优于传统方法。
conclusion: 基于Gromov-Wasserstein的最优传输方法能够有效整合多视图数据，在保留内在几何结构的同时实现鲁棒的低维嵌入，为多视图表示学习提供了一种灵活且有原则的框架。

title: State estimations and noise identifications with intermittent corrupted observations via Bayesian variational inference
authors: Peng Sun, Ruoyu Wang, Xue Luo
abstract: This paper focuses on the state estimation problem in distributed sensor networks, where intermittent packet dropouts, corrupted observations, and unknown noise covariances coexist. To tackle this challenge, we formulate the joint estimation of system states, noise parameters, and network reliability as a Bayesian variational inference problem, and propose a novel variational Bayesian adaptive Kalman filter (VB-AKF) to approximate the joint posterior probability densities of the latent parameters. Unlike existing AKF that separately handle missing data and measurement outliers, the proposed VB-AKF adopts a dual-mask generative model with two independent Bernoulli random variables, explicitly characterizing both observable communication losses and latent data authenticity. Additionally, the VB-AKF integrates multiple concurrent multiple observations into the adaptive filtering framework, which significantly enhances statistical identifiability. Comprehensive numerical experiments verify the effectiveness and asymptotic optimality of the proposed method, showing that both parameter identification and state estimation asymptotically converge to the theoretical optimal lower bound with the increase in the number of sensors.
zh_title: 基于变分贝叶斯推断的间歇性破坏观测下的状态估计与噪声识别
translation: 本文关注分布式传感器网络中的状态估计问题，其中间歇性丢包、观测数据被破坏以及未知噪声协方差并存。为应对这一挑战，我们将系统状态、噪声参数和网络可靠性的联合估计建模为贝叶斯变分推断问题，并提出了一种新型变分贝叶斯自适应卡尔曼滤波（VB-AKF）来近似潜在参数的联合后验概率密度。与现有分别处理缺失数据和测量异常值的自适应卡尔曼滤波（AKF）不同，所提出的VB-AKF采用了一个具有两个独立伯努利随机变量的双掩码生成模型，明确表征了可观测的通信丢失和潜在的数据真实性。此外，VB-AKF将多个并发观测集成到自适应滤波框架中，显著增强了统计可识别性。综合数值实验验证了所提方法的有效性和渐近最优性，表明随着传感器数量的增加，参数识别和状态估计均渐近收敛于理论最优下界。
tldr: 提出了一种新型VB-AKF算法，通过双掩码模型联合解决分布式网络中的丢包、观测异常及未知噪声问题，实现了高精度的状态估计。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个双掩码生成模型，能够同时处理通信丢失和观测值异常，并将多个同步观测集成到自适应滤波框架中，有效提升了统计可识别性。局限性在于未提及在非线性系统中的表现。
motivation: 在分布式传感器网络中，通信丢包、观测异常（被破坏）以及噪声协方差未知等复杂情况共存，导致传统状态估计方法难以有效应用。
method: 提出了一种变分贝叶斯自适应卡尔曼滤波（VB-AKF），采用双掩码生成模型（两个独立的伯努利随机变量）来建模通信丢失和数据真实性，并通过变分贝叶斯推断联合估计系统状态、噪声参数和网络可靠性。
results: 数值实验表明，该方法能够实现参数识别和状态估计，且随着传感器数量的增加，估计结果渐近收敛于理论最优下界。
conclusion: 研究证明了所提VB-AKF方法在处理复杂噪声和观测干扰环境下的有效性，且随着传感器数量的增加，其估计精度趋于最优下界。

title: Transfer Learning for Meta-analysis Under Covariate Shift
authors: Zilong Wang, Ali Abdeen, Turgay Ayer
abstract: Randomized controlled trials often do not represent the populations where decisions are made, and covariate shift across studies can invalidate standard IPD meta-analysis and transport estimators. We propose a placebo-anchored transport framework that treats source-trial outcomes as abundant proxy signals and target-trial placebo outcomes as scarce, high-fidelity gold labels to calibrate baseline risk. A low-complexity (sparse) correction anchors proxy outcome models to the target population, and the anchored models are embedded in a cross-fitted doubly robust learner, yielding a Neyman-orthogonal, target-site doubly robust estimator for patient-level heterogeneous treatment effects when target treated outcomes are available. We distinguish two regimes: in connected targets (with a treated arm), the method yields target-identified effect estimates; in disconnected targets (placebo-only), it reduces to a principled screen--then--transport procedure under explicit working-model transport assumptions. Experiments on synthetic data and a semi-synthetic IHDP benchmark evaluate pointwise CATE accuracy, ATE error, ranking quality for targeting, decision-theoretic policy regret, and calibration. Across connected settings, the proposed method is best or near-best and improves substantially over proxy-only, target-only, and transport baselines at small target sample sizes; in disconnected settings, it retains strong ranking performance for targeting while pointwise accuracy depends on the strength of the working transport condition.
comment: Accepted to IEEE ICHI 2026 Early Bird Track (Oral Presentation)
zh_title: 基于协变量偏移的元分析迁移学习
translation: 随机对照试验往往不能代表实际决策的群体，且研究间的协变量偏移可能导致标准的个体数据（IPD）元分析和运输估计失效。我们提出了一个安慰剂锚定运输框架，将源试验结果视为丰富的代理信号，将目标试验的安慰剂结果视为稀缺、高保真的金标准标签，以校准基准风险。一种低复杂度的（稀疏）校正将代理结果模型锚定到目标群体，并将这些锚定模型嵌入到交叉拟合的双重稳健学习器中，从而为目标人群中存在治疗结果的情况，产生一种Neyman正交的、针对目标站点的双重稳健异质性治疗效果估计量。我们区分了两种情况：在连接目标（有治疗臂）中，该方法产生目标识别的效应估计；在断开目标（仅安慰剂）中，它在明确的工作模型运输假设下简化为一个原则性的筛选-然后-运输过程。在合成数据和半合成IHDP基准测试上的实验评估了逐点CATE准确性、ATE误差、目标排序质量、决策理论政策遗憾和校准。在连接设置中，该方法表现最好或接近最好，并在小目标样本量下显著优于仅代理、仅目标和运输基准；在断开设置中，它保持了强大的目标排序性能，而逐点准确性取决于工作运输条件的强度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用安慰剂作为锚点来校准跨研究差异的迁移学习框架，显著提升了小样本下对异质性治疗效果的估计能力。
ai_comments: 该研究巧妙地利用了安慰剂臂作为“锚点”来解决源域和目标域之间的协变量偏移问题，这在医疗决策中具有很高的实用价值。其创新点在于结合了代理信号和高保真金标准标签，并利用双重稳健学习框架提高了估计的鲁棒性。局限性在于在无治疗臂的目标域中，其点估计精度高度依赖于工作模型的运输假设。
motivation: 随机对照试验的样本群体往往无法代表实际决策人群，且研究间的协变量偏移会导致标准的个体数据（IPD）元分析及运输估计失效。
method: 提出了一个安慰剂锚定运输框架（placebo-anchored transport framework），利用源试验结果作为代理信号，目标试验安慰剂结果作为锚点进行基准风险校准，并通过交叉拟合的双重稳健学习器（doubly robust learner）进行估计。
results: 在合成数据和IHDP基准测试中，该方法在小样本目标人群下表现优异，显著优于仅使用代理数据、仅使用目标数据或传统运输基准；在有治疗臂的场景下提升了估计准确性，在无治疗臂场景下保持了良好的排序性能。
conclusion: 该研究提出了一种有效的迁移学习框架，通过锚定安慰剂效应，显著改善了小样本目标人群下的异质性治疗效果估计和决策质量。

title: Eligibility-Aware Evidence Synthesis: An Agentic Framework for Clinical Trial Meta-Analysis
authors: Yao Zhao, Zhiyue Zhang, Yanxun Xu
abstract: Clinical evidence synthesis requires identifying relevant trials from large registries and aggregating results that account for population differences. While recent LLM-based approaches have automated components of systematic review, they do not support end-to-end evidence synthesis. Moreover, conventional meta-analysis weights studies by statistical precision without considering clinical compatibility reflected in eligibility criteria. We propose EligMeta, an agentic framework that integrates automated trial discovery with eligibility-aware meta-analysis, translating natural-language queries into reproducible trial selection and incorporating eligibility alignment into study weighting to produce cohort-specific pooled estimates. EligMeta employs a hybrid architecture separating LLM-based reasoning from deterministic execution: LLMs generate interpretable rules from natural-language queries and perform schema-constrained parsing of trial metadata, while all logical operations, weight computations, and statistical pooling are executed deterministically to ensure reproducibility. The framework structures eligibility criteria and computes similarity-based study weights reflecting population alignment between target and comparator trials. In a gastric cancer landscape analysis, EligMeta reduced 4,044 candidate trials to 39 clinically relevant studies through rule-based filtering, recovering all 13 guideline-cited trials. In an olaparib adverse events meta-analysis across four trials, eligibility-aware weighting shifted the pooled risk ratio from 2.18 (95% CI: 1.71-2.79) under conventional Mantel-Haenszel estimation to 1.97 (95% CI: 1.76-2.20), demonstrating quantifiable impact of incorporating eligibility alignment. EligMeta bridges automated trial discovery with eligibility-aware meta-analysis, providing a scalable and reproducible framework for evidence synthesis in precision medicine.
zh_title: 资格感知证据合成：一种用于临床试验荟萃分析的代理框架
translation: 临床证据合成需要从大型注册库中识别相关试验，并整合考虑了人群差异的结果。尽管近期基于LLM的方法已经实现了系统综述部分流程的自动化，但它们尚不支持端到端的证据合成。此外，传统的荟萃分析根据统计精度对研究进行加权，而未考虑资格准则所反映的临床兼容性。我们提出了EligMeta，一个集成了自动化试验发现与资格感知荟萃分析的代理框架，它将自然语言查询转化为可重复的试验选择，并将资格对齐纳入研究加权，以生成特定队列的汇总估计值。EligMeta采用了一种将基于LLM的推理与确定性执行相分离的混合架构：LLM从自然语言查询中生成可解释的规则并执行试验元数据的模式约束解析，而所有逻辑操作、权重计算和统计汇总均以确定性方式执行以确保可重复性。该框架结构化了资格准则，并计算基于相似性的研究权重，以反映目标试验与比较试验之间的人群对齐情况。在胃癌景观分析中，EligMeta通过基于规则的过滤将4044项候选试验减少至39项临床相关研究，并找回了所有13项指南引用的试验。在四项试验的奥拉帕利不良事件荟萃分析中，资格感知加权将传统Mantel-Haenszel估计下的风险比从2.18（95% CI: 1.71-2.79）调整为1.97（95% CI: 1.76-2.20），证明了将资格对齐纳入考量的量化影响。EligMeta架起了自动化试验发现与资格感知荟萃分析之间的桥梁，为精准医疗中的证据合成提供了一个可扩展且可重复的框架。
tldr: EligMeta通过结合大模型推理与确定性统计，实现了临床试验的自动筛选与考虑受试者资格差异的精准荟萃分析。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的代理框架，通过将大语言模型的推理能力与确定性统计计算相结合，有效解决了临床荟萃分析中“临床兼容性”被忽视的问题，为精准医疗下的循证医学提供了可重复的自动化路径。
motivation: 现有基于LLM的系统综述自动化工具无法支持端到端的证据合成，且传统荟萃分析仅依赖统计精度加权，忽略了不同试验间受试者资格准则的临床差异。
method: 提出EligMeta框架，采用混合架构：利用LLM进行自然语言查询的规则生成及元数据解析，利用确定性算法进行逻辑运算、权重计算（基于受试者资格相似度）及统计汇总。
results: 在胃癌景观分析中，从4044项试验中筛选出39项相关研究，涵盖了所有指南引用试验；在奥拉帕利不良事件荟萃分析中，通过资格感知加权，使风险比从2.18调整为1.97，证明了资格对齐对结果的量化影响。
conclusion: EligMeta框架成功实现了从临床试验自动发现到考虑受试者资格差异的加权荟萃分析的闭环，不仅提高了证据合成的效率，还显著提升了结果的临床相关性与可重复性。

title: MatClaw: An Autonomous Code-First LLM Agent for End-to-End Materials Exploration
authors: Chenmu Zhang, Boris I. Yakobson
abstract: Existing LLM agents for computational materials science are constrained by pipeline-bounded architectures tied to specific simulation codes and by dependence on manually written tool functions that grow with task scope. We present MatClaw, a code-first agent that writes and executes Python directly, composing any installed domain library to orchestrate multi-code workflows on remote HPC clusters without predefined tool functions. To sustain coherent execution across multi-day workflows, MatClaw uses a four-layer memory architecture that prevents progressive context loss, and retrieval-augmented generation over domain source code that raises per-step API-call accuracy to ${\sim}$99 %. Three end-to-end demonstrations on ferroelectric CuInP2S6 (machine-learning force field training via active learning, Curie temperature prediction, and heuristic parameter-space search) reveal that the agent handles code generation reliably but struggles with tacit domain knowledge. The missing knowledge, such as appropriate simulation timescales, equilibration protocols, and sampling strategies, is the kind that researchers accumulate through experience but rarely formalize. Two lightweight interventions, literature self-learning and expert-specified constraints, bridge these gaps, defining a guided autonomy model in which the researcher provides high-level domain knowledge while the agent handles workflow execution. Our results demonstrate that the gap between guided and fully autonomous computational materials research is narrower than ever before: LLMs already handle code generation and scientific interpretation reliably, and the rapid improvement in their capabilities will accelerate materials discovery beyond what manual workflows can achieve. All code and benchmarks are open-source.
zh_title: MatClaw：一种用于端到端材料探索的自主代码优先LLM代理
translation: 现有的计算材料科学LLM代理受限于绑定特定模拟代码的流水线架构，以及随着任务范围扩大而不断增加的手动编写工具函数。我们提出了MatClaw，这是一个代码优先的代理，它直接编写并执行Python代码，组合任何已安装的领域库，在无需预定义工具函数的情况下编排远程HPC集群上的多代码工作流。为了维持跨多天工作流的连贯执行，MatClaw使用了四层内存架构来防止上下文逐渐丢失，并通过对领域源代码进行检索增强生成，将每一步的API调用准确率提高到约99%。在铁电材料CuInP2S6上的三个端到端演示（通过主动学习进行机器学习力场训练、居里温度预测以及启发式参数空间搜索）表明，该代理能可靠地处理代码生成，但在隐性领域知识方面存在困难。缺失的知识，如适当的模拟时间尺度、平衡协议和采样策略，是研究人员通过经验积累但很少形式化的知识。文献自学习和专家指定约束这两项轻量级干预措施弥补了这些差距，定义了一种引导式自主模型，其中研究人员提供高层领域知识，而代理处理工作流执行。我们的结果表明，引导式计算材料研究与完全自主计算材料研究之间的差距比以往任何时候都更小：LLM已经能够可靠地处理代码生成和科学解释，其能力的快速提升将加速材料发现，超越手动工作流所能达到的水平。所有代码和基准测试均已开源。
tldr: MatClaw是一款无需预定义工具、通过直接生成代码来执行复杂材料科学模拟的LLM代理，结合了先进的内存架构和引导式自主模式，显著提升了科研自动化水平。
ai_comments: MatClaw的创新之处在于其“代码优先”的架构，摆脱了对预定义工具函数的依赖，极大地提升了灵活性。其四层内存架构和基于领域源码的RAG技术显著提升了长期任务的稳定性和API调用准确率。局限性在于对隐性领域知识（如模拟参数设置）的缺乏，但通过引入文献自学习和专家约束，成功展示了人机协作在材料科学研究中的潜力。
motivation: 现有的材料科学LLM代理受限于特定的模拟代码和繁琐的手动工具函数，难以处理复杂、长期的多代码工作流。
method: 提出MatClaw架构，利用Python代码直接执行任务；采用四层内存架构管理长期记忆；通过对领域源代码进行检索增强生成（RAG）提升API调用准确性；引入文献自学习和专家约束作为辅助干预手段。
results: MatClaw在铁电材料CuInP2S6的三个端到端任务中表现稳健，API调用准确率达到约99%，验证了其在复杂科学任务中的可靠性，并展示了通过引导式自主（Guided Autonomy）弥补隐性领域知识差距的可能性。
conclusion: MatClaw证明了LLM已具备处理复杂材料科学工作流的能力，通过Guided Autonomy模式，LLM能够在人类专家的指导下高效完成端到端的材料探索任务，加速发现进程。

title: A Canonical Structure for Constructing Projected First-Order Algorithms With Delayed Feedback
authors: Mengmou Li, Yu Zhou, Xun Shen, Masaaki Nagahara
abstract: This work introduces a canonical structure for a broad class of unconstrained first-order algorithms that admit a Lur'e representation, including systems with relative degree greater than one, e.g., systems with delayed gradient feedback. The proposed canonical structure is obtained through a simple linear transformation. It enables a direct extension from unconstrained optimization algorithms to set-constrained ones through projection in a Lyapunov-induced norm. The resulting projected algorithms attain the optimal solution while preserving the convergence rates of their unconstrained counterparts.
zh_title: 一种用于构建具有延迟反馈的投影一阶算法的规范结构
translation: 本文介绍了一种针对广泛类别的一阶无约束算法的规范结构，这些算法允许Lur'e表示，包括相对度大于一的系统（例如具有延迟梯度反馈的系统）。所提出的规范结构是通过简单的线性变换获得的。它使得通过Lyapunov诱导范数中的投影，实现从无约束优化算法到集约束优化算法的直接扩展。所得的投影算法在保持其无约束对应算法收敛速度的同时，达到了最优解。
tldr: 提出了一种统一的规范结构，通过线性变换和Lyapunov投影，使具有延迟反馈的一阶算法能高效处理带约束的优化问题。
ai_comments: 该研究通过线性变换统一了具有Lur'e表示的一阶算法框架，巧妙地解决了带延迟反馈系统的投影约束问题，理论价值较高，为算法设计提供了更普适的范式。
motivation: 旨在解决现有无约束一阶算法（如具有延迟反馈的系统）难以直接应用于带约束优化问题，且缺乏统一分析框架的问题。
method: 通过简单的线性变换构建规范结构，利用Lyapunov诱导范数进行投影，从而将无约束算法扩展至集约束优化问题。
results: 构建的规范结构能够实现向集约束问题的直接扩展，在保证收敛到最优解的同时，有效保留了原无约束算法的收敛速率。
conclusion: 本文提出的规范结构成功地将无约束优化算法的理论扩展到了带约束场景，同时保持了算法的收敛速度，为处理复杂延迟系统提供了有效的数学工具。

title: Parity $\notin$ QAC0 $\iff$ QAC0 is Fourier-Concentrated
authors: Lucas Gretta, Meghal Gupta, Malvika Raj Joshi
abstract:
A major open problem in understanding shallow quantum circuits (QAC$^0$) is whether they can compute Parity. We show that this question is solely about the Fourier spectrum of QAC$^0$: any QAC$^0$ circuit with non-negligible high-level Fourier mass suffices to exactly compute PARITY in QAC$^0$. Thus, proving a quantum analog of the seminal LMN theorem for AC$^0$ is necessary to bound the quantum circuit complexity of PARITY.
  In the other direction, LMN does not fully capture the limitations of AC$^0$. For example, despite MAJORITY having $99\%$ of its weight on low-degree Fourier coefficients, no AC$^0$ circuit can non-trivially correlate with it. In contrast, we provide a QAC$^0$ circuit that achieves $(1-o(1))$ correlation with MAJORITY, establishing the first average-case decision separation between AC$^0$ and QAC$^0$. This suggests a uniquely quantum phenomenon: unlike in the classical setting, Fourier concentration may largely characterize the power of QAC$^0$.
  PARITY is also known to be equivalent in QAC$^0$ to inherently quantum tasks such as preparing GHZ states to high fidelity. We extend this equivalence to a broad class of state-synthesis tasks. We demonstrate that existing metrics such as trace distance, fidelity, and mutual information are insufficient to capture these states and introduce a new measure, felinity. We prove that preparing any state with non-negligible felinity, or derived states such as poly(n)-weight Dicke states, implies PARITY $\in$ QAC$^0$.
zh_title:
偶数性 $
otin$ QAC0 $\iff$ QAC0 是傅立叶集中的
translation:
浅层量子电路（QAC$^0$）能否计算偶数性是一个重大的未解之谜。我们证明了这个问题完全取决于QAC$^0$的傅立叶谱：任何具有不可忽略的高层傅立叶质量的QAC$^0$电路都足以在QAC$^0$中精确计算PARITY。因此，证明AC$^0$的量子类比的开创性LMN定理对于限制PARITY的量子电路复杂度是必要的。
另一方面，LMN并未完全捕捉AC$^0$的局限性。例如，尽管MAJORITY函数将99%的权重集中在低度傅立叶系数上，但没有AC$^0$电路可以非平凡地与它相关联。相比之下，我们提供了一个QAC$^0$电路，可以实现与MAJORITY的（1-o(1)）相关性，从而建立了AC$^0$和QAC$^0$之间的首次平均情况决策分离。这表明了一种独特的量子现象：与经典情况不同，傅立叶集中度在很大程度上可以表征QAC$^0$的能力。

title: Task-Guided Prompting for Unified Remote Sensing Image Restoration
authors: Wenli Huang, Yang Wu, Xiaomeng Xin, Zhihong Liu, Jinjun Wang, Ye Deng
abstract: Remote sensing image restoration (RSIR) is essential for recovering high-fidelity imagery from degraded observations, enabling accurate downstream analysis. However, most existing methods focus on single degradation types within homogeneous data, restricting their practicality in real-world scenarios where multiple degradations often across diverse spectral bands or sensor modalities, creating a significant operational bottleneck. To address this fundamental gap, we propose TGPNet, a unified framework capable of handling denoising, cloud removal, shadow removal, deblurring, and SAR despeckling within a single, unified architecture. The core of our framework is a novel Task-Guided Prompting (TGP) strategy. TGP leverages learnable, task-specific embeddings to generate degradation-aware cues, which then hierarchically modulate features throughout the decoder. This task-adaptive mechanism allows the network to precisely tailor its restoration process for distinct degradation patterns while maintaining a single set of shared weights. To validate our framework, we construct a unified RSIR benchmark covering RGB, multispectral, SAR, and thermal infrared modalities for five aforementioned restoration tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that TGPNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on both unified multi-task scenarios and unseen composite degradations, surpassing even specialized models in individual domains such as cloud removal. By successfully unifying heterogeneous degradation removal within a single adaptive framework, this work presents a significant advancement for multi-task RSIR, offering a practical and scalable solution for operational pipelines. The code and benchmark will be released at https://github.com/huangwenwenlili/TGPNet.
zh_title: 用于统一遥感图像恢复的任务引导提示方法
translation: 遥感图像恢复（RSIR）对于从退化观测中恢复高保真图像至关重要，能够实现准确的下游分析。然而，大多数现有方法侧重于同质数据中的单一退化类型，限制了其在真实场景中的实用性，因为真实场景中往往存在跨多种光谱波段或传感器模态的多种退化，造成了显著的运行瓶颈。为了解决这一根本差距，我们提出了 TGPNet，这是一个能够在一个统一架构内处理去噪、去云、去影、去模糊和 SAR 去斑的统一框架。我们框架的核心是一种新颖的任务引导提示（TGP）策略。TGP 利用可学习的、任务特定的嵌入来生成退化感知线索，然后分层调制整个解码器的特征。这种任务自适应机制允许网络在保持单一共享权重集的同时，为不同的退化模式精确调整其恢复过程。为了验证我们的框架，我们构建了一个统一的 RSIR 基准，涵盖了上述五个恢复任务的 RGB、多光谱、SAR 和热红外模态。实验结果表明，TGPNet 在统一多任务场景和未见过的复合退化方面均达到了最先进的性能，甚至在去云等特定领域超过了专门模型。通过成功地在一个自适应框架内统一异构退化去除，这项工作为多任务 RSIR 带来了重大进展，为操作流水线提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案。代码和基准测试将在 https://github.com/huangwenwenlili/TGPNet 发布。

title: Zero-Freeness of the Hard-Core Model with Bounded Connective Constant
authors: Yuan Chen, Shuai Shao, Ke Shi
abstract: We study the zero-free regions of the partition function of the hard-core model on finite graphs and their implications for the analyticity of the free energy on infinite lattices. Classically, zero-freeness results have been established up to the tree uniqueness threshold $λ_c(Δ-1)$ determined by the maximum degree $Δ$. However, for many graph classes, such as regular lattices, the connective constant $σ$ provides a more precise measure of structural complexity than the maximum degree. While recent approximation algorithms based on correlation decay and Markov chain Monte Carlo have successfully exploited the connective constant to improve the threshold to $λ_c(σ)$, analogous results for complex zero-freeness have been lacking. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing a proper definition of the connective constant for finite graphs based on a lower bound on the number of $k$-depth self-avoiding walks. We prove that for any graph family with a lower connective constant $μ$, the partition function is zero-free in a complex neighborhood of the interval $[0, λ]$ for all $λ< λ_c(μ)$. As a direct consequence, we establish the uniqueness and analyticity of the free energy density for infinite lattices up to the connective constant threshold, extending the known regions derived from maximum degree bounds. Our proof utilizes a block contraction technique that lifts the correlation decay property from a real interval to a strip-like complex neighborhood.
zh_title: 具有界连接常数的硬核模型的零点无迹性
translation: 我们研究了有限图上硬核模型配分函数的零点无迹区域，及其对无限格子上自由能解析性的影响。经典地，零点无迹结果已由最大度数 Δ 确定的树唯一性阈值 λ_c(Δ-1) 建立。然而，对于许多图类（如正则格子），连接常数 σ 比最大度数提供了更精确的结构复杂性度量。虽然近期基于相关衰减和马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛的近似算法已成功利用连接常数将阈值改进至 λ_c(σ)，但类似的复零点无迹结果尚且缺乏。在本文中，我们通过引入基于 k 深度自避路径下界的有限图连接常数的适当定义来弥补这一差距。我们证明，对于任何具有下连接常数 μ 的图族，配分函数在 [0, λ] 的复邻域内对于所有 λ < λ_c(μ) 都是零点无迹的。作为一个直接结果，我们将无限格子的自由能密度的唯一性和解析性建立到了连接常数阈值，扩展了从最大度数界限导出的已知区域。我们的证明利用了一种块收缩技术，将相关衰减性质从实区间提升到了带状复邻域。
tldr: 通过引入连接常数作为结构度量，作者证明了硬核模型配分函数在比传统最大度数阈值更广的范围内是零点无迹的，从而确立了更广范围内的自由能解析性。
ai_comments: 该研究成功将连接常数（connective constant）引入到硬核模型的零点无迹区域分析中，弥补了传统仅依赖最大度数（maximum degree）的局限性，为理解统计物理模型的相变提供了更精确的工具。其方法结合了相关衰减与块收缩技术，具有较强的理论创新性。
motivation: 传统零点无迹结果依赖于最大度数阈值 λ_c(Δ-1)，但在许多图类中，连接常数能更精确地刻画结构复杂性。现有算法已利用连接常数改进了近似算法的阈值，但缺乏相应的复零点无迹理论支持，本文旨在填补这一空白。
method: 引入了基于自避路径下界的有限图连接常数定义，并利用块收缩（block contraction）技术，将相关衰减性质从实数区间推广到了复平面的带状邻域。
results: 对于具有下连接常数 μ 的任何图族，证明了配分函数在 [0, λ] 的复邻域内（对于所有 λ < λ_c(μ)）是零点无迹的，并将无限格子的自由能密度解析性范围从最大度数阈值提升至连接常数阈值。
conclusion: 研究证明了在连接常数阈值 λ_c(μ) 内，硬核模型配分函数在复平面上是零点无迹的，从而确立了该范围内自由能密度的唯一性和解析性。

title: Transfer Learning for Loan Recovery Prediction under Distribution Shifts with Heterogeneous Feature Spaces
authors: Christopher Gerling, Hanqiu Peng, Ying Chen, Stefan Lessmann
abstract:
Accurate forecasting of recovery rates (RR) is central to credit risk management and regulatory capital determination. In many loan portfolios, however, RR modeling is constrained by data scarcity arising from infrequent default events. Transfer learning (TL) offers a promising avenue to mitigate this challenge by exploiting information from related but richer source domains, yet its effectiveness critically depends on the presence and strength of distributional shifts, and on potential heterogeneity between source and target feature spaces.
  This paper introduces FT-MDN-Transformer, a mixture-density tabular Transformer architecture specifically designed for TL in RR forecasting across heterogeneous feature sets. The model produces both loan-level point estimates and portfolio-level predictive distributions, thereby supporting a wide range of practical RR forecasting applications. We evaluate the proposed approach in a controlled Monte Carlo simulation that facilitates systematic variation of covariate, conditional, and label shifts, as well as in a real-world transfer setting using the Global Credit Data (GCD) loan dataset as source and a novel bonds dataset as target.
  Our results show that FT-MDN-Transformer outperforms baseline models when target-domain data are limited, with particularly pronounced gains under covariate and conditional shifts, while label shift remains challenging. We also observe its probabilistic forecasts to closely track empirical recovery distributions, providing richer information than conventional point-prediction metrics alone. Overall, the findings highlight the potential of distribution-aware TL architectures to improve RR forecasting in data-scarce credit portfolios and offer practical insights for risk managers operating under heterogeneous data environments.

title: A polynomial bound for the minimal excluded minors for a surface
authors: Sarah Houdaigoui, Ken-ichi Kawarabayashi
abstract:
As part of the graph minor project, Robertson and Seymour showed in 1990 that the class of graphs that can be embedded in a given surface can be characterized by a finite set of minimal excluded minors. However, their proof, because existential, provides no explicit information about these excluded minors. In 1993, Seymour established the first upper bound on the order of such minimal excluded minors. Very recently, Houdaigoui and Kawarabayashi improved this result by deriving a quasi-polynomial upper bound. Despite this progress, the gap between this bound and the known linear lower bound $Ω(g)$ (where $g$ denotes the genus) remains substantial. In particular, they conjectured that a polynomial upper bound should hold.
  In this paper, we confirm this conjecture by showing that the order of the minimal excluded minors for a surface of genus $g$ is $O(g^{8+\varepsilon})$ for every $\varepsilon >0$. This result significantly narrows the gap between the known lower and upper bounds, bringing the asymptotic behavior much closer to the conjectured optimum.
  Our approach introduces a new forbidden structure of minimal excluded minors. Let $G$ be a minimal excluded minor for a surface of Euler genus $g$. Houdaigoui and Kawarabayashi showed that $G$ contains $O(\log g)$ pairwise disjoint cycles that are contractible and nested in some embedding of $G$. We strengthen this result by proving a separator-based variant: for any contractible subgraph $H \subseteq G$ with a separator of size $s$ (with $H$ completely contained in one side), the subgraph $H$ contains $O(\log s)$ disjoint cycles that are contractible and nested in some embedding of $G$. This allows us to replace a genus-dependent bound with a separator-dependent one, which is the main new ingredient in deriving our polynomial bound.

zh_title: 表面图的最小排除子式的多项式界限
translation: 作为图论项目的一部分，Robertson 和 Seymour 在 1990 年证明了可以嵌入给定表面的图类可以用一组有限的最小排除子式来表征。然而，他们的证明是存在性的，没有提供关于这些排除子式的显式信息。1993 年，Seymour 首次为这类最小排除子式的阶数建立了上界。最近，Houdaigoui 和 Kawarabayashi 通过推导出准多项式上界改进了这一结果。尽管取得了这些进展，但该界限与已知的线性下界 Ω(g)（其中 g 表示亏格）之间的差距仍然很大。特别是，他们推测应该存在一个多项式上界。在本文中，我们通过证明亏格为 g 的表面的最小排除子式的阶数对于每个 ε > 0 都是 O(g^(8+ε)) 来证实这一猜想。这一结果显著缩小了已知下界和上界之间的差距，使渐近行为更接近推测的最佳值。我们的方法引入了一种新的最小排除子式禁止结构。设 G 是亏格为 g 的表面的最小排除子式。Houdaigoui 和 Kawarabayashi 证明了 G 包含 O(log g) 个成对不相交的环，这些环在 G 的某个嵌入中是可收缩和嵌套的。我们通过证明一个基于分离器的变体来加强这一结果：对于任何具有分离器大小为 s 的可收缩子图 H ⊆ G（其中 H 完全包含在一侧），子图 H 包含 O(log s) 个不相交的、可收缩的、嵌套的环在 G 的某个嵌入中。这使我们能够用一个依赖于分离器的界限替换一个依赖于亏格的界限，这是推导我们的多项式界限的主要新成分。
tldr: 图嵌入给定表面的最小排除子式的阶数存在多项式界限，该界限为 O(g^(8+ε))，其中 g 是亏格。
ai_comments: 该研究在图论领域取得了重要进展，通过提供最小排除子式阶数的多项式界限，显著缩小了理论上的差距。新引入的基于分离器的变体是该研究的关键创新点。
motivation: 证明了亏格为 g 的表面的最小排除子式的阶数存在多项式界限，以缩小已知下界和上界之间的差距。
method: 通过引入一种新的最小排除子式禁止结构，并证明了基于分离器的变体，其中任何可收缩子图 H 包含 O(log s) 个不相交的、可收缩的、嵌套的环，其中 s 是分离器的大小。

conclusion: 本文证实了最小排除子式阶数存在多项式界限的猜想，并将已知下界和上界之间的差距大大缩小。

title: High-resolution probabilistic estimation of three-dimensional regional ocean dynamics from sparse surface observations
authors: Niloofar Asefi, Tianning Wu, Ruoying He, Ashesh Chattopadhyay
abstract: The ocean interior regulates Earth's climate but remains sparsely observed due to limited in situ measurements, while satellite observations are restricted to the surface. We present a depth-aware generative framework for reconstructing high-resolution three-dimensional ocean states from extremely sparse surface data. Our approach employs a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) trained on sea surface height and temperature observations with up to 99.9 percent sparsity, without reliance on a background dynamical model. By incorporating continuous depth embeddings, the model learns a unified vertical representation of the ocean states and generalizes to previously unseen depths. Applied to the Gulf of Mexico, the framework accurately reconstructs subsurface temperature, salinity, and velocity fields across multiple depths. Evaluations using statistical metrics, spectral analysis, and heat transport diagnostics demonstrate recovery of both large-scale circulation and multiscale variability. These results establish generative diffusion models as a scalable approach for probabilistic ocean reconstruction in data-limited regimes, with implications for climate monitoring and forecasting.

title: When cooperation is beneficial to all agents
authors: Alessandro Doldi, Marco Frittelli, Marco Maggis
abstract: Within a general semimartingale framework, we study the relationship between collective market efficiency and individual rationality. We derive a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of (possibly zero-sum) exchanges among agents that strictly increase their indirect utilities and characterize this condition in terms of the compatibility between agents' preferences and collective pricing measures. The framework applies to both continuous- and discrete-time models and clarifies when cooperation leads to a strict improvement in each participating agent's indirect utility.

title: Streaming Real-Time Rendered Scenes as 3D Gaussians
authors: Matti Siekkinen, Teemu Kämäräinen
abstract: Cloud rendering is widely used in gaming and XR to overcome limited client-side GPU resources and to support heterogeneous devices. Existing systems typically deliver the rendered scene as a 2D video stream, which tightly couples the transmitted content to the server-rendered viewpoint and limits latency compensation to image-space reprojection or warping. In this paper, we investigate an alternative approach based on streaming a live 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene representation instead of only rendered video. We present a Unity-based prototype in which a server constructs and continuously optimizes a 3DGS model from real-time rendered reference views, while streaming the evolving representation to remote clients using full model snapshots and incremental updates supporting relighting and rigid object dynamics. The clients reconstruct the streamed Gaussian model locally and render their current viewpoint from the received representation. This approach aims to improve viewpoint flexibility for latency compensation and to better amortize server-side scene modeling across multiple users than per-user rendering and video streaming. We describe the system design, evaluate it, and compare it with conventional image warping.

title: Few-Shot Distribution-Aligned Flow Matching for Data Synthesis in Medical Image Segmentation
authors: Jie Yang, Ziqi Ye, Aihua Ke, Jian Luo, Bo Cai, Xiaosong Wang
abstract: Data heterogeneity hinders clinical deployment of medical image analysis models, and generative data augmentation helps mitigate this issue. However, recent diffusion-based methods that synthesize image-mask pairs often ignore distribution shifts between generated and real images across scenarios, and such mismatches can markedly degrade downstream performance. To address this issue, we propose AlignFlow, a flow matching model that aligns with the target reference image distribution via differentiable reward fine-tuning, and remains effective even when only a small number of reference images are provided. Specifically, we divide the training of the flow matching model into two stages: in the first stage, the model fits the training data to generate plausible images; Then, we introduce a distribution alignment mechanism and employ differentiable reward to steer the generated images toward the distribution of the given samples from the target domain. In addition, to enhance the diversity of generated masks, we also design a flow matching based mask generation to complement the diversity in regions of interest. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, i.e., performance improvement by 3.5-4.0% in mDice and 3.5-5.6% in mIoU across a variety of datasets and scenarios.

title: Rethinking Forward Processes for Score-Based Data Assimilation in High Dimensions
authors: Eunbi Yoon, Donghan Kim, Dae Wook Kim
abstract: Data assimilation is the process of estimating the time-evolving state of a dynamical system by integrating model predictions and noisy observations. It is commonly formulated as Bayesian filtering, but classical filters often struggle with accuracy or computational feasibility in high dimensions. Recently, score-based generative models have emerged as a scalable approach for high-dimensional data assimilation, enabling accurate modeling and sampling of complex distributions. However, existing score-based filters often specify the forward process independently of the data assimilation. As a result, the measurement-update step depends on heuristic approximations of the likelihood score, which can accumulate errors and degrade performance over time. Here, we propose a measurement-aware score-based filter (MASF) that defines a measurement-aware forward process directly from the measurement equation. This construction makes the likelihood score analytically tractable: for linear measurements, we derive the exact likelihood score and combine it with a learned prior score to obtain the posterior score. Numerical experiments covering a range of settings, including high-dimensional datasets, demonstrate improved accuracy and stability over existing score-based filters.

title: Lipschitz bounds for integral kernels
authors: Justin Reverdi, Sixin Zhang, Fabrice Gamboa, Serge Gratton
abstract: Feature maps associated with positive definite kernels play a central role in kernel methods and learning theory, where regularity properties such as Lipschitz continuity are closely related to robustness and stability guarantees. Despite their importance, explicit characterizations of the Lipschitz constant of kernel feature maps are available only in a limited number of cases. In this paper, we study the Lipschitz regularity of feature maps associated with integral kernels under differentiability assumptions. We first provide sufficient conditions ensuring Lipschitz continuity and derive explicit formulas for the corresponding Lipschitz constants. We then identify a condition under which the feature map fails to be Lipschitz continuous and apply these results to several important classes of kernels. For infinite width two-layer neural network with isotropic Gaussian weight distributions, we show that the Lipschitz constant of the associated kernel can be expressed as the supremum of a two-dimensional integral, leading to an explicit characterization for the Gaussian kernel and the ReLU random neural network kernel. We also study continuous and shift-invariant kernels such as Gaussian, Laplace, and Matérn kernels, which admit an interpretation as neural network with cosine activation function. In this setting, we prove that the feature map is Lipschitz continuous if and only if the weight distribution has a finite second-order moment, and we then derive its Lipschitz constant. Finally, we raise an open question concerning the asymptotic behavior of the convergence of the Lipschitz constant in finite width neural networks. Numerical experiments are provided to support this behavior.

title: Scalable Mean-Variance Portfolio Optimization via Subspace Embeddings and GPU-Friendly Nesterov-Accelerated Projected Gradient
authors: Yi-Shuai Niu, Yajuan Wang
abstract: We develop a sketch-based factor reduction and a Nesterov-accelerated projected gradient algorithm (NPGA) with GPU acceleration, yielding a doubly accelerated solver for large-scale constrained mean-variance portfolio optimization. Starting from the sample covariance factor $L$, the method combines randomized subspace embedding, spectral truncation, and ridge stabilization to construct an effective factor $L_{eff}$. It then solves the resulting constrained problem with a structured projection computed by scalar dual search and GPU-friendly matrix-vector kernels, yielding one computational pipeline for the baseline, sketched, and Sketch-Truncate-Ridge (STR)-regularized models. We also establish approximation, conditioning, and stability guarantees for the sketching and STR models, including explicit $O(\varepsilon)$ bounds for the covariance approximation, the optimal value error, and the solution perturbation under $(\varepsilon,δ)$-subspace embeddings. Experiments on synthetic and real equity-return data show that the method preserves objective accuracy while reducing runtime substantially. On a 5440-asset real-data benchmark with 48374 training periods, NPGA-GPU solves the unreduced full model in 2.80 seconds versus 64.84 seconds for Gurobi, while the optimized compressed GPU variants remain in the low-single-digit-second regime. These results show that the full dense model is already practical on modern GPUs and that, after compression, the remaining bottleneck is projection rather than matrix-vector multiplication.

title: The Variational Approach in Filtering and Correlated Noise
authors: Sharan Srinivasan, Vijay Gupta, Harsha Honnappa
abstract: The variational formulation of nonlinear filtering due to Mitter and Newton characterizes the filtering distribution as the unique minimizer of a free energy functional involving the relative entropy with respect to the prior and an expected energy. This formulation rests on an absolute continuity condition between the joint path measure and a product reference measure. We prove that this condition necessarily fails whenever the signal and observation diffusions share a common noise source. Specifically we show that the joint and product measures are mutually singular, so no choice of reference measure can salvage the formulation. We then introduce a conditional variational principle that replaces the prior with a reference measure that preserves the noise correlation structure. This generalization recovers the Mitter--Newton formulation as a special case when the noises are independent, and yields an explicit free energy characterization of the filter in the linear correlated-noise setting.

title: Inversion-Free Natural Gradient Descent on Riemannian Manifolds
authors: Dario Draca, Takuo Matsubara, Minh-Ngoc Tran
abstract: The natural gradient method is widely used in statistical optimization, but its standard formulation assumes a Euclidean parameter space. This paper proposes an inversion-free stochastic natural gradient method for probability distributions whose parameters lie on a Riemannian manifold. The manifold setting offers several advantages: one can implicitly enforce parameter constraints such as positive definiteness and orthogonality, ensure parameters are identifiable, or guarantee regularity properties of the objective like geodesic convexity. Building on an intrinsic formulation of the Fisher information matrix (FIM) on a manifold, our method maintains an online approximation of the inverse FIM, which is efficiently updated at quadratic cost using score vectors sampled at successive iterates. In the Riemannian setting, these score vectors belong to different tangent spaces and must be combined using transport operations. We prove almost-sure convergence rates of $O(\log{s}/s^α)$ for the squared distance to the minimizer when the step size exponent $α>2/3$. We also establish almost-sure rates for the approximate FIM, which now accumulates transport-based errors. A limited-memory variant of the algorithm with sub-quadratic storage complexity is proposed. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method relative to its Euclidean counterparts on variational Bayes with Gaussian approximations and normalizing flows.

title: A semicontinuous relaxation of Saito's criterion and freeness as angular minimization
authors: Tomás S. R. Silva
abstract:
We introduce a nonnegative functional on the space of line arrangements in $\mathbb{P}^2$ that vanishes precisely on free arrangements, obtained as a semicontinuous relaxation of Saito's criterion for freeness. Given an arrangement $\mathcal{A}$ of $n$ lines with candidate exponents $(d_1, d_2)$, we parameterize the spaces of logarithmic derivations of degrees $d_1$ and $d_2$ via the null spaces of the associated derivation matrices and express the Saito determinant as a bilinear map into the space of degree $n$ polynomials. The functional then admits a natural geometric interpretation: it measures the squared sine of the angle between the image of this bilinear map and the direction of the defining polynomial $Q(\mathcal{A})$ in coefficient space, and equals zero if and only if its image contains the line spanned by $Q(\mathcal{A})$. This provides a computable measure of how far a given arrangement is from admitting a free basis of logarithmic derivations of the expected degrees.
  Using this functional as a reward signal, we develop a sequential construction procedure in which lines are added one at a time so as to minimize the angular distance to freeness, implemented via reinforcement learning with an adaptive curriculum over arrangement sizes and exponent types.
  Our results suggest that semicontinuous relaxation techniques, grounded in the geometry of polynomial coefficient spaces, offer a viable approach to the computational exploration of freeness in the theory of line arrangements.

title: Spectral Properties of Zero-Divisor Graphs of Truncated Polynomial Rings
authors: Bilal Ahmad Rather
abstract: Let $R$ be a commutative ring with identity and let $Z^{\ast}(R)$ denote the set of nonzero zero-divisors of $R$. The \emph{zero-divisor graph} $ \varGamma(R)$ is the simple graph with vertex set $V( \varGamma(R))=Z^{\ast}(R)$, where two distinct vertices$x,y\in Z^{\ast}(R)$ are adjacent if and only if $xy=0$ in $R$. In this paper we investigate the zero-divisor graph of the truncated polynomial ring $R=\mathbb{Z}_{p}[x]/\langle x^{c}\rangle,$ for $c\in\mathbb{N}.$ We determine the spectrum of the $A_α$-matrix associated with $ \varGamma(R)$, and, as special cases, explicitly obtain both the adjacency spectrum and the signless Laplacian spectrum of $ \varGamma(R)$. Furthermore, we prove that the Laplacian eigenvalues, as well as the distance eigenvalues, of these graphs are all integers.

title: Speaker-Reasoner: Scaling Interaction Turns and Reasoning Patterns for Timestamped Speaker-Attributed ASR
authors: Zhennan Lin, Shuai Wang, Zhaokai Sun, Pengyuan Xie, Chuan Xie, Jie Liu, Qiang Zhang, Lei Xie
abstract: Transcribing and understanding multi-speaker conversations requires speech recognition, speaker attribution, and timestamp localization. While speech LLMs excel at single-speaker tasks, multi-speaker scenarios remain challenging due to overlapping speech, backchannels, rapid turn-taking, and context window constraints. We propose Speaker-Reasoner, an end-to-end Speech LLM with agentic multi-turn temporal reasoning. Instead of single-pass inference, the model iteratively analyzes global audio structure, autonomously predicts temporal boundaries, and performs fine-grained segment analysis, jointly modeling speaker identity, gender, timestamps, and transcription. A speaker-aware cache further extends processing to audio exceeding the training context window. Trained with a three-stage progressive strategy, Speaker-Reasoner achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines on AliMeeting and AISHELL-4 datasets, particularly in handling overlapping speech and complex turn-taking.

title: ARIQA-3DS: A Stereoscopic Image Quality Assessment Dataset for Realistic Augmented Reality
authors: Aymen Sekhri, Seyed Ali Amirshahi, Mohamed-Chaker Larabi
abstract: As Augmented Reality (AR) technologies advance towards immersive consumer adoption, the need for rigorous Quality of Experience (QoE) assessment becomes critical. However, existing datasets often lack ecological validity, relying on monocular viewing or simplified backgrounds that fail to capture the complex perceptual interplay, termed visual confusion, between real and virtual layers. To address this gap, we present ARIQA-3DS, the first large stereoscopic AR Image Quality Assessment dataset. Comprising 1,200 AR viewports, the dataset fuses high-resolution stereoscopic omnidirectional captures of real-world scenes with diverse augmented foregrounds under controlled transparency and degradation conditions. We conducted a comprehensive subjective study with 36 participants using a video see-through head-mounted display, collecting both quality ratings and simulator-sickness indicators. Our analysis reveals that perceived quality is primarily driven by foreground degradations and modulated by transparency levels, while oculomotor and disorientation symptoms show a progressive but manageable increase during viewing. ARIQA-3DS will be publicly released to serve as a comprehensive benchmark for developing next-generation AR quality assessment models.

title: Characterization of Gaussian Universality Breakdown in High-Dimensional Empirical Risk Minimization
authors: Chiheb Yaakoubi, Cosme Louart, Malik Tiomoko, Zhenyu Liao
abstract: We study high-dimensional convex empirical risk minimization (ERM) under general non-Gaussian data designs. By heuristically extending the Convex Gaussian Min-Max Theorem (CGMT) to non-Gaussian settings, we derive an asymptotic min-max characterization of key statistics, enabling approximation of the mean $μ_{\hatθ}$ and covariance $C_{\hatθ}$ of the ERM estimator $\hatθ$. Specifically, under a concentration assumption on the data matrix and standard regularity conditions on the loss and regularizer, we show that for a test covariate $x$ independent of the training data, the projection $\hatθ^\top x$ approximately follows the convolution of the (generally non-Gaussian) distribution of $μ_{\hatθ}^\top x$ with an independent centered Gaussian variable of variance $\text{Tr}(C_{\hatθ}\mathbb{E}[xx^\top])$. This result clarifies the scope and limits of Gaussian universality for ERMs. Additionally, we prove that any $\mathcal{C}^2$ regularizer is asymptotically equivalent to a quadratic form determined solely by its Hessian at zero and gradient at $μ_{\hatθ}$. Numerical simulations across diverse losses and models are provided to validate our theoretical predictions and qualitative insights.

title: Unmixing the Crowd: Learning Mixture-to-Set Speaker Embeddings for Enrollment-Free Target Speech Extraction
authors: FNU Sidharth, Meysam Asgari, Hao-Wen Dong, Dhruv Jain
abstract: Personalized or target speech extraction (TSE) typically needs a clean enrollment -- hard to obtain in real-world crowded environments. We remove the essential need for enrollment by predicting, from the mixture itself, a small set of per-speaker embeddings that serve as the control signal for extraction. Our model maps a noisy mixture directly to a small set of candidate speaker embeddings trained to align with a strong single-speaker speaker-embedding space via permutation-invariant teacher supervision. On noisy LibriMix, the resulting embeddings form a structured and clusterable identity space, outperforming WavLM+K-means and separation-derived embeddings in standard clustering metrics. Conditioning these embeddings into multiple extraction back-ends consistently improves objective quality and intelligibility, and generalizes to real DNS-Challenge recordings.

abstract: Non-contrast chest CTs offer a rich opportunity for both conventional pulmonary and opportunistic extra-pulmonary screening. To ensure computational efficiency, we integrate Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), allowing the model to regress task-specific low-rank weight updates rather than full parameters. title: Efficient Causal Graph Discovery Using Large Language Models
authors: Thomas Jiralerspong, Xiaoyin Chen, Yash More, Vedant Shah, Yoshua Bengio
abstract: We propose a novel framework that leverages LLMs for full causal graph discovery. While previous LLM-based methods have used a pairwise query approach, this requires a quadratic number of queries which quickly becomes impractical for larger causal graphs. In contrast, the proposed framework uses a breadth-first search (BFS) approach which allows it to use only a linear number of queries. We also show that the proposed method can easily incorporate observational data when available, to improve performance. In addition to being more time and data-efficient, the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art results on real-world causal graphs of varying sizes. The results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method in discovering causal relationships, showcasing its potential for broad applicability in causal graph discovery tasks across different domains.

title: Bringing memory to Boolean networks: a unifying framework
authors: Maximilien Gadouleau, Loïc Paulevé, Sara Riva
abstract: Boolean networks are extensively applied as models of complex dynamical systems, aiming at capturing essential features related to causality and synchronicity of the state changes of components along time. Dynamics of Boolean networks result from the application of their Boolean map according to a so-called update mode, specifying the possible transitions between network configurations. In this paper, we explore update modes that possess a memory on past configurations, and provide a generic framework to define them. We show that recently introduced modes such as the most permissive and interval modes can be naturally expressed in this framework, and we propose novel update modes, the history-based, trapping, and subcube-based modes. Building on the unified definitions, we provide a comprehensive comparison of memory-based update modes, resulting in their hierarchy by simulation and weak simulation. Finally, we highlight consequences of introducing memory on the notions of trajectory and attractors.
